chapters.title: Chapter 2330 Chaos III
paragraphs: Above a massive stellar crater that was melting and crystallizing at rapid speeds.
Noah's figure was shrouded by blue flames that were tinged with crimson and silver grandeur at this moment.
Frankly, too many things were currently happening with him as he needed to take even at least a moment to absorb and compartmentalize everything neatly.
There were many new Layers of Boundaries to look over and understand, even if they're just the featured ones that augmented his strength the most right now.
But...he had many bodies and had his Will divided over them just for this purpose.
His main body and other clones would understand the changes occurring as the True Sanguine Clone here...it would continue to act!
And right now, the expanded concept of Providence was telling him to focus on the two Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans before him.
This stemmed from no other reason other than a Featured Boundary of Providence he was also being urged to call out!
It was the 6th Boundary Layer that granted...the Planar Annals of Providence!
His luminous eyes pulled briefly focused on his status panel as under <Boundaries>, he focused on the [Featured Boundaries] of Providence at this moment.

<The Sixth Boundary Layer of Providence>:: A layer meant to illuminate the countless paths before you into a single best one depending on your nature, allowing you to call out the Planar Annals of Providence to guide the way. Your current attributes and quality of Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul have been placed into account when it comes to the cost of calling forth the Planar Annals of Providence and their duration, allowing for this Boundary Layer to be utilized without a true cost when taking into account your Aeonic Soul Values and Aeonic Mana of Extremity. Once cast, it has an unlimited duration due to your rate of regeneration greatly exceeding the cost to cast. The uses and illumination of the Planar Annals of Providence are hard to describe as to experience them, the best way is to call it out and watch it show the path forward...
It was a featured Boundary of Providence that did not truly say what it did, but Noah called it out nonetheless.
<Planar Annals of Providence>.
In the dark skies as the injured Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen bared their fangs towards him, his bodies surrounded by flames released a golden radiance as he spoke out.
And soon after, this radiance expanded to form a dazzling halcyon grimoire of light that shot its rays outwards and erased the darkness!
A golden grimoire that a second later turned into a streak of light that fused into Noah's forehead- causing a faint tattoo to appear at the very center as a stellar golden halo emanated from him.
A halo of Providence.
It covered everything about him as most of all, it covered his eyes.
He blinked a few times to adjust as when he looked at the reality around him once more...it seemed like everything had changed.
He could see countless dim lines that represented paths he could follow, and a few golden lines that represented paths he should follow that were based on his very own aspects of Existence!
Not just this, he was also being fed boundless waves of information as when he gazed at the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen before his eyes...
All of their details rose out.
Their name, Titles, the concepts they controlled, and even how their Values compared to his!

But more than this, he could see multiple points highlighted on their bodies that showed their weakest points he could attack...and exactly what he had to do if he wished to grant the two Leviathans before him True Death!
Thereafter, he would achieve the possibilities shown by the Planar Annals of Providence as what occurred would then be written down on it.

And even further from this, Noah also received information on what he could obtain if these two Leviathans were to be taken down by him as his eyes lit up brightly when he saw the names of new possible Loot he hadn't even grasped before!
With all paths neatly laid out and everything set just for him to choose...
<OOOH!>
He bellowed out gloriously as the surging blue flames tainted by red and silver tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN...began to be sucked towards his body.
More specifically towards his eyes as they're akin to backhoes that swallowed everything rapidly!
What he was doing now...was devouring and concentrating sparse forms of power source into two luminous balls of light.

He gathered his cerulean flames made from singularities and countless Infinity symbols as they're tainted by tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN, these essence mixing in an utterly chaotic and disordered fashion as the result of it...Noah gave it a name for the first time he formulated an ability after the Quintessential Killing Techniques.
<Entropic Ray>.
His voice was light.
But the pressure he emanated...was utterly disastrous as his eyes that devoured everything and shone like ancient Suns...exploded!
'What is he?'
This was a thought that not someone foreign, but a being that had just pledged herself to Noah not too long ago had!
Ophelia gazed at the scene before her with utter awe as she saw a stunning scene.

This Entity she had bound herself to seemed to control the uncontrolled chaotic tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN around them as he absorbed his own flames and these chaotic forces into his eyes, and an instant later...his eyes shone with a blinding light as a ray that caused Ophelia's body to tremble erupted out.
It caused her to tremble because...she could not see it!
She only saw a flash of volatile light as she knew if it hit her, all aspects of her existence would perish.
Wisdom would not be able to save her even if it managed to alert her!
This power...was approaching the stage of the truly powerful Reverends feared across the battlefields of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!
And such a being had only just stepped out from the Barren Lands- a cluster of Minor Planes and one Major Plane outside of the Vaults of Extremity for merely over a day!

chapters.title: Chapter 2331 Chaos IV
paragraphs: Unprecedented danger rang in the souls of the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen.
And how could they not?
Noah...could feel their shock and terror with his eyes the moment he released the volatile rays of light from them!
The utter speed that his eyes released the rays of blue, crimson, and silver was too fast even for him to follow as before the two Leviathans could even move away...
SHIIING!
The two lasers of chaotic glory from his eyes already passed through them as the earth of the crater they were at the bottom of...
CRACK!
Split apart and extended like a fissure towards the inner stellar mountains past the torn veil, a clean cut extending through as everything was crystallized instantly!
And to the shock and awe of all, the massive titanic body of the fearsome Varicella Emperor Kong...split from the forehead and towards its lower torso as crimson red blood gushed out endlessly.
·ƈθm Beside it, the carapace of the Arachnoid Prion Queen also split and was cleanly split apart as countless green vessels could be seen trying to stay together!

They both took great damage as they tried to put their bodies together, but the visage of the Arachnoid Prion Queen trembled in the next instant as its will caught onto a heart shaking phenomenon beside it.
It was on the Varicella Emperor Kong.

The Arachnoid Prion Queen saw the titanic body of its compatriot twist, turn, and implode into itself as the Crimson gold blood leaking from it, its limbs, any parts of soul...anything and everything about it was being drawn towards a golden Singularity that suddenly erupted at the center of its being!
As if it was an inescapable black gold that devoured every part of the remaining life-force and soul of the Varicella Emperor Kong!
The Arachnoid Prion Queen felt great terror at this as it didn't know what such a phenomenon was, but Noah knew it very clearly as this...was the effect of the Ninth Boundary Layer of Loot.

<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Loot>:: Whenever you erase the Aeonic Vitality Values of a target to the extent that they fall below 30% of their Maximum Aeonic Vitality Values, the effect of The Devouring Loot Singularity will be applied as the remaining Aspects of Existence of the target will instantly be devoured and turned into Loot that gets assimilated to you right away- unless you direct it not to. The Devouring Loot Singularity is the current ultimate design of the Boundary of Loot that exceeds Treasure Caches, with their Quantity and Quality Multipliers reaching unrecorded Quintessential levels...
To others, it was a foreign phenomenon.

To Noah, it was the first eruption of the Devouring Loot Singularity as every remaining part of the Varicella Emperor Kong was devoured into a single golden point of light...before it exploded outwards and surged towards his body uncontrollably!
And before Noah's eyes...
<The Source of 2x Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity have been absorbed into your body.>
<The Source of Complete Aeonic Nullity Pearl has been absorbed into your body.>
<The Source of Complete Aeonic Ruin Pearl has been absorbed into your body.>
WAA!
<The Source of 100x Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas have been engrossed into your body.>

Everything that used to be the Varicella Emperor Kong turned into streams of golden light from an exploded Singularity as all beings here watched this light be devoured into his Body entirely as he emanated even greater radiance!
<A deep Understanding of Nullity exceeding the Primitivus and Proficere Stage is being infused into your Soul.>
<A deep Understanding of Ruin exceeding the Primitivus and Proficere Stage is being infused into your Soul.>
A red and silver radiance tinged his soul as his Understanding of Two sources of chaos scaled upwards at a ridiculous speed.

They were rapidly shooting past the Primitivus Stage as they would more than likely also speed past Proficere to enter Terminus soon enough, where at that point in time- the Boundaries of Nullity and Ruin would be for Noah to expand as he would see just what the states of Verisimilitude held.
But more than this there were the new Loot termed Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas directly engrossed by him as at this moment, his First Plane of Extremity pulsed.

Extremely pure essence surged from the very top of his Origin and washed down over his Dimensional Realities as it was akin to a Celestial rain on a dry earth, his Dimensional Realities hungrily devouring everything and rapidly expanding as they took in the Source of an Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan!

A creature who lost more than 70% of his Aeonic Vitality Values as the influence of the Devouring Loot Singularity instantly took out its remaining 30% and turned everything about it into fuel for Noah that was engrossed right away.
It was dreadful, but the Varicella Emperor Kong was lucky to die this way.
It died peacefully and instantly.

It would not be here for the shocking chaos to unfold like all the others as at this moment, Noah called out once more as he lifted his hand towards the Arachnoid Prion Queen that seemed ready to retreat...and then closed his fist.
<Spontaneous Entropic Planar Combustion>.
A planar domain.
A domain that was the 6th Boundary Layer of Entropy as its description....was one of the more fantastical ones that Noah had seen so far!

<The Sixth Boundary Layer of Entropy>:: Termed the Spontaneous Entropic Planar Combustion, this Planar Domain allows you to draw in and compress all Sources of Chaos in nature nearby before releasing it on a specified area in an even more disordered state, such a domain requiring 50% of your Current Aeonic Soul Values to cast. A single cast of this domain will give rise to for all nearby surroundings to enter a state of even greater disorder. Initiate chaos, control chaos, and thrive under the glory of chaos...
Short.
Simple.
But what exactly did it mean?
Noah wanted to find out fully as the moment he closed his fist, it was like all light was extinguished as it surged into his hand.
And when he unfurled his fist...
BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2332 Chaos V
paragraphs: The scene was an ecstatic one to observe.
The visage of Noah closed his fist as an instant later, it seemed like all light was devoured into it.
<Spontaneous Entropic Planar Combustion> was called upon as every trace of sources of chaos nearby disappeared, with others feeling a sense of awe while one creature in particular felt immense dread!
It was the Arachnoid Prion Queen as her many eyes were barely able to gaze over when she saw the fist unfurl.
The fist that devoured all light and was pulsing as if it held all of reality in it!
'Nearby'.

This was the word utilized in the description of the 6th Boundary Layer of Entropy in how vast the area was covered when all Sources of Chaos were drawn in, but everywhere from the outer periphery and the rising ravines of stellar mountains in the distance seemed to turn dark as every single tendril of RUIN and NULLITY were devoured along with multiple other sources of essence.
And then all of this was released the moment Noah's fist unfurled as the designated location...was the body of the Arachnoid Prion Queen!
Ruin coursed over its many eyes as its soul was barely ready to scream out when...everything exploded.
BOOOOM!
As if its body was the center of an Apocalyptic singularity, a force exploded that utterly shredded its Aspects of Existence and caused the activation of the Ninth Boundary Layer of Loot right away!
But this was not all.

With this explosion at the center, effects propagated outwards as horrific shockwaves emanated out, the stellar black earth being scathed and fractured as in the skies...even thicker tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY began to rain down and surge.
Chaos.
The moment that the <Spontaneous Entropic Planar Combustion> was utilized, all nearby chaos would be drawn in and released as thereafter, the affected region would delve into an even greater chaos.
And the more chaos there was...the stronger Noah was!
BZZZT!

Crimson silver thunder and lightning began to roil and wash down from the skies as it even reached the outermost periphery where the vast majority of the armies of the Quasarians, Noblesse, and Ancestral Lernaeans were- chaos unfolding in a stellar fashion as beings moved to protect themselves.

Noah watched all this as his figure floated in the skies above catered mountains and fissured stellar black earth, seeing the radiant golden waves of light from the defeated Arachnoid Prion Queen being devoured by his body as even more prompts came down.
<The Source of 2x Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity have been absorbed into your body.>
<The Source of a Complete Aeonic Nullity Pearl has been absorbed into your body.>
<The Source of a Complete Aeonic Ruin Pearl has been engrossed into your body.>
<The Source of 125x Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas have been absorbed into your body.>
His body took everything and transferred to his main body as the ones bringing him the greatest changes right now were the Nullity and Ruin Pearls, as well as the Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas!
So much so that after devouring an untold billions of years of understanding of these two states of verisimilitude...
<You have crossed the threshold of the Primitivus Stage of Nullity.>I think you should take a look at
<You have crossed the threshold of the Primitivus Stage of Ruin.>
He instantly crossed towards the Proficere Stage as he knew within the next few minutes, he could also exceed the Terminus Stage of these two concepts and expand them to become Boundaries!
Then, there were the Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas.
Their use was singular in nature.

<Obsidian Planar Origin Panacea>:: A type of Aeonic Treasure of Extremity that is the accumulation of countless years of Origin Essence that can be used to elevate your Realm. A single one holds the potential essence to bud to a Minor Plane if left in the outside Reality for a billion years...
A fantastical loot, and it was one that held the potential essence of a budding Minor Plane of Existence.
225 of such Loot were devoured by his body as his Origin...
<Your First Plane of Extremity is experiencing a Quintessential advancement.>

His Origin released radiant waves of light as his Dimensional Realities added land and skies in an utterly glorious manner- stretching out endlessly as he felt all other parts of him undergo changes due to it.

His path continued to flow with a fast pace as he knew he would have even more accomplishments soon, the Realm and Foundation he built being expanded even further as Providence affirmed that the First Plane of Extremity...was on its way towards completion.
Providence affirmed this, and many more other things though.
Like the fact that...
HOOONG!

Noah turned his head around to gaze up towards the massive abyss in the skies that others jumped down in to arrive here as he saw a blazing point of light break through the darkness and stop briefly to gaze around...its form being caught by the most powerful beings here as it ignored the forming tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY!

Noah's actions were taking the spotlight as many eyes were on him before, but the eyes of pertinent Boundary Expansion Realm experts were all drawn towards the newly arriving figure and his dreadfully powerful aura at this moment as they knew him too well!
<It can not be...>
An Elder Ancestor swallowed hard as he had merely taken the aftereffects of an attack from this being before.
Too many chaotic things were happening as for him to be here as well...
Amidst the ever increasing chaotic landscape now becoming filled with tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY, one name was uttered out for the arrival of a single being.
<The Mad Reverend Emperor!>
A Nobless Commander explained as his eyes turned somber!

And even from the Lineage he came from, Reverend Emperor Septimius who was the furthest into the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands turned around to stare at him as a gaze of respect shone in his eyes while he called out this being's name.
<Caesar!>
WAA!

225 of such Loot were devoured by his body as his Origin...
<Your First Plane of Extremity is experiencing a Quintessential advancement.>

His Origin released radiant waves of light as his Dimensional Realities added land and skies in an utterly glorious manner- stretching out endlessly as he felt all other parts of him undergo changes due to it.

His path continued to flow with a fast pace as he knew he would have even more accomplishments soon, the Realm and Foundation he built being expanded even further as Providence affirmed that the First Plane of Extremity...was on its way towards completion.
Providence affirmed this, and many more other things though.
Like the fact that...
HOOONG!

Noah turned his head around to gaze up towards the massive abyss in the skies that others jumped down in to arrive here as he saw a blazing point of light break through the darkness and stop briefly to gaze around...its form being caught by the most powerful beings here as it ignored the forming tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY!

Noah's actions were taking the spotlight as many eyes were on him before, but the eyes of pertinent Boundary Expansion Realm experts were all drawn towards the newly arriving figure and his dreadfully powerful aura at this moment as they knew him too well!
<It can not be...>
An Elder Ancestor swallowed hard as he had merely taken the aftereffects of an attack from this being before.
Too many chaotic things were happening as for him to be here as well...
Amidst the ever increasing chaotic landscape now becoming filled with tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY, one name was uttered out for the arrival of a single being.
<The Mad Reverend Emperor!>
A Nobless Commander explained as his eyes turned somber!

And even from the Lineage he came from, Reverend Emperor Septimius who was the furthest into the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands turned around to stare at him as a gaze of respect shone in his eyes while he called out this being's name.
<Caesar!>
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2333 Chaos VI
paragraphs: Flashes of red and silver light stretched out across the dark skies!

The Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans scrambled as a steady stream continued to rush out from the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, those nearby on tall mountain peaks striking out against beings that tried to go further inland.
But at this moment, the eyes and Wills of all powerful beings were momentarily drawn to the mere appearance of an existence.
Of Caesar!
The Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar had appeared as his figure was only seen by others briefly- and it represented an oncoming change in this region that others weren't prepared for!
It was the change of truly powerful existences making their way over- this being a statement that Providence told Noah among many more things.

Amidst the roiling tendrils of chaos, his eyes that were covered by the golden light of Providence continued to obtain information, where one of the biggest things that showed when he gazed at the dazzling figure of the one known as Caesar...
Providence didn't show any weaknesses.
As if this man's entire body was an impenetrable fortress!

It was enough to caution others and give rise to them to step back, but Noah continued to stare towards this new being coldly as Providence also told him that the level of power this being released...it was something he could attain very soon if he continued to devour bountiful Loot.

So he was unphased as he saw this newly arriving being only give a cursory glance to everyone here before coming to land his eyes on his figure floating amidst the tendrils of chaos, but they did not even stay on him for too long as he ignored all others here and shot towards the inner areas that all organisms here were surging towards in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

There seemed to be something deep within the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands that drew him in, with Noah's eyes also lighting up as he saw a few golden pathways laid out before him along with a stellar multicolored one.

As his body underwent drastic changes from the elevation of Consummate Boundaries, achievement of 9th Boundary Layers in multiple Boundaries, and his Aspects of Existence began their transformation due to Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas...Noah's figure also turned into a glorious amalgamation of flames as he went deeper inland!
Multicolored waves of light and chaos followed him as Ophelia also broke out of her stupor and followed.
It left behind shocked existences that had experienced new waves of power from him, along with a changed landscape.

It was common for the Planar Domains of truly powerful beings to leave their effects in the outside reality, but when others stared at the extreme alteration of the landscape and the tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN...they placed a label on a new mysterious Entity as their focus very quickly returned to the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity and bypassing the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans here!
Above the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity.

Silver gray clouds occupied everything above currently as a silver rain of Nullity cascaded down with glacial coldness, where even amidst all this chaos, even more organisms continued to arrive at this location.I think you should take a look at

This particular party did not seem hurried as if they knew some secrets about inner workings others didn't, their figures actually being many as they formed into a neat legion that floated towards the billowing light of the Abyss and the Leviathans coming out of it!

Their image was pristine as at the very forefront of this Legion, one could see Lifeforms that seemed entirely identical to humans with some variations on their faces that gave out celestial wonder- minute differences like their eyes being multicolored singularities of light, and their strands of hair and skin releasing a stellar Planar light as if it contained the grandeur of countless planes of existence within them!

This Legion alone that was here....only had auras of existences who had achieved the 8th Boundary Layer and above- their people all beings of utmost quality as those who couldn't make waves and survive in the Abyss weren't even taken.
They stemmed from the Fourth and most powerful Lineage in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
The ones that seemed to stay out of conflict between the Noblesse, Quasarians, and the Ancestral Lernaeans over the years as Consummate Boundaries were a very real reality within their Lineage!
It was...the Lineage of the Planeswalkers.
WAA!

Mysterious and terrifying in nature, their most powerful commands among the Legion going towards the Abyss were actually not at the center of attention as beside them, at least 10 exemplary existences releasing a potent aura of Extremity could be seen as this Legion...even seemed to be escorting them.
An escort!

A Legion of Planeswalkers where the weakest were 8th Boundary Layer Commanders and the strongest were Reverends releasing an air of power rivaling Prince Zagugan or exceeding it, with a few auras being as potent if not more than Reverend Emperor Septimius...and they're actually escorting 10 organisms as the Planeswalkers Commanders had their bearing full of pride, yes, but also respect when they gazed at these beings.

One of the 10 exemplary existences being escorted looked at the entrance of the Abyss below as she smiled, this small movement of hers brightening up this whole region as the rain of Nullity stopped momentarily while the glacial freezing cold around them began to melt.

<I've only investigate d the Extremity Vein from our Haven that is almost impossible to make any achievements in after the passage of so many years since its Initiation...so I'm actually looking forward to what the Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution holds!>
Regality and nobility flowed from her as those around her smiled, a dashing man full of power floating beside her as he waved his hands.
<Let's go in. I can already sense others like us approaching as things are bound to get hectic soon.>
Their voices were resonant and full of worries as they seemed to be of organisms that considered themselves to be at the very peak of Existence.
Not because of hubris or arrogance or a wrong sense of displaced pride.
But...they held such a view deeply ingrained in their bones by it being a reality. By it being slowed mere fact!

chapters.title: Chapter 2334 The Concepts You Abandoned! I
paragraphs: Like moths to a raging stellar flame, a great number of organisms came towards the Abyss as the Initiation of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution began.
Initiation.
A stage that only pulled in those below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as it was the ringing of the bells for the start of Extremity Sanctification!

As those seeking the extreme tiers of power and a chance to become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms flocked into the region that hid the entrance of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution, the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans delved out of the Abyss and began to spread outwards from the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity.
They were one of the tools of Extremity Sanctification.
And under their actions, they would ensure that only the strongest survived- with the stronger existences getting ever closer towards Extremity!
It was the survival of the fittest.
But as this chaos and wildness bloomed in these regions, others had their sights set elsewhere entirely.
Towards the domains of the Noblesse.
Within a Chaoticus Behemoth Transporter.
<Oppenheimer, you say?>
Eowyn gritted her teeth as she spat these words out, her golden hair swaying beautifully over her shoulders.
After all, this being had nearly granted her True Death when he was ascending to the seat of the True Emperor of Destiny!
Dimensional Ruler Guinevere and others silently mulled over this word and name as all of them floated in a small isolated domain shining with gold that was born from the essence of Providence.
After all, what they talked about here had to be a secret- otherwise, the being they spoke of may just pick up on something from his own concepts!
Henry, who had enacted the golden domain, gazed at all the Vassals of his father who followed him here as he nodded thoughtfully.

<He will be tricky to catch. I've communicated with my Father, he says that Oppenheimer has obtained the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as only through taking him by surprise do we stand a chance. But...I have a plan.>
WAA!
A devilish smile was et ceterahed on his lips as his eyes saw something else entirely compared to others.
Similar to his father, he had the <Planar Annals of Providence> from the 6th Boundary Layer of Providence as boundless possibilities could be seen by him.
And among all of them...

<The only method that works is actually going to be the full deployment of most of us here. With his means and his control of Destiny, he is extremely slippery. But...I know where he is going, so we can prepare. Let's see, think of him as...a rat.>
Shocking words left his devilishly handsome face as from afar, Kazuhiko and others stared at Henry as if they were looking at another version of Noah! I think you should take a look at

<Think of him as a rat, and we just have to prepare an inescapable trap that even with the means of the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform and Destiny, he will not be able to escape. Our Boundaries are greater, our Layers are greater, and our Destiny...>
HOONG!
He left the last words unsaid.
Their Destiny.
His destiny against the being who took the True Throne of Destiny before his father!
He was curious about the result!
In the Abecedarian Sacrarium.

Bountiful auras of powerful Elder Ancestors or their Aeonic Soul Clones had begun to appear in the last few minutes as this area became of great focus due to the identity of Ophelia and the being she was seen following in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
A being who emanated waves of Consummate Boundaries as Ophelia also showed the same phenomenon soon after.

This was of great interest to the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage as among those here, Elder Ancestor Rodwig came with his main body after rethinking things as he left a proxy to guard the Sacrarium of the Sword.

At this moment, he and a few other important Elder Ancestors in charge of prominent Sacrariums cautiously bypassed the barriers of the Abecedarian Sacrarium to head towards the Crimson Sacrarium Antechamber where organisms were normally received, but they changed their route as soon as their Wills moved across the Sacrarium to notice two particularly resonant auras located at the Abecedarian Observatory.
At the lead beside Elder Ancestor Rodwig were the Aeonic Soul Clones of two Reverend Emperors- one known as Reverend Emperor Osaka and Reverend Emperor Light!

Osaka was an exceedingly handsome woman with a golden blindfold over her eyes as she was one of the more prominent Seers in their Lineage, and Light was a Reverend with four 9th Boundary Layer concepts as he was respected and known within the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage, as well as being one of the few organisms who could contact their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

His coming here showed the importance they placed on this matter when events like the Extremity Sanctification had begun with boundless possibilities presenting themselves at the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
<When we begin discussions, there shall be no outbursts or disruptions. And do not speedily offer your opinions unless called upon.>
Resend Emperor Osaka had the golden light of the Boundary of Judgment surging around her blindfolded eyes as she spoke out coldly towards those around her.
It showed the delicacy of this situation as Elder Ancestor Rodwig locked eyes with the other Ancestors while they proceeded forward.
Their steps were light, but they were powerful existences that could cross a whole Plane in a few moments as they very quickly arrived in the Abecedarian Observatory!

The barrier of the Sacrarium could be seen above them as the scene of stellar Rivers and Havens sparkled beneath them, their gazes all going towards a center point of the Abecedarian Observatory that showed a golden platform made of dreamy gold sand which caused many of them to gaze at with alarm!
If they weren't mistaken...this should be the authority of the Decretum of Dreams that belonged to one of the Nine Minor Planes of Existence in their old home!
Why...was it so easily displayed here at this moment, and why did it emanate the aura of a Boundary?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2335 The Concepts You Abandoned! II
paragraphs: Why was the abundant authority of Dreams so easily displayed here at this moment, and why did it emanate the aura of a Boundary?!

This question should've taken their focus and thoughts, but even this had to be pushed aside momentarily as atop the sandy gold platform of Dreams, they saw a single golden throne rising that one Entity sat atop of, the figure of Ophelia seen to the left of this throne along with the auras of a few other existences they did not know of.

This scene may seem like nothing to others, but to them...they're truly affirming the reality that the one who should have been the Sacrarium Master of the Abecedarian Sacrarium...she was currently standing obediently to the side of another man situated on a throne- a man who dripped of power and regality as he had the same exact devilishly handsome face as the Entity they had just seen rip apart two Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans in the Abyss!
Yet the body he currently held emanated intense waves of Dream Authority that to their immense disbelief- it truly seemed like a potent Boundary.
The over a dozen Elder Ancestors here remembered the words of Reverend Emperor Osaka as they didn't make any outbursts.
They followed the lead of Osaka and Light and floated ever closer, coming to stop a distance away from the beginnings of the dream platform as The True Emperor of Light was the one to speak first.

His figure radiated light and brilliance all around as his beauty as a man lost only to the one they could see on the golden throne, his voice calm and full of grace as he first nodded towards Ophelia before locking his white eyes towards the being on the throne.
<What might be the identity of the one we stand before? I normally like to know who I'm talking to as it makes for a much easier discussion and fewer misunderstandings between us.>
Calmness.
Light.
Power.

These were how his words felt as they had some records of the events after the death of Sacrarium Emperor Vulcan, but this information didn't seem all that trustworthy as they wished to discern the True identity of this being!
But the scene of the authority of Dreams surging as a Boundary before them caused rising skepticism as the being atop the throne didn't keep them in suspense.
<My identity is the same one that I told the last Elder Ancestor that was here. I am the Last True Emperor of the Barren Lands, the True Emperor of Quintessence!>
HUUM!

The moment the word Quintessence was uttered, the surrounding space vibrated as the eyes of Rodwig and others shone with brilliance because they felt the aura of the same Consummate Boundary they had felt in the Abyss!
It proved this being was one and the same, but his words also caused immense silence to descend as it meant too many things!
The Last True Emperor.
The Cataclysm of the Barren Lands.

This information was enough to cause many complications to arise as the True Emperor of Light spoke once more while Reverend Emperor Osaka quietly listened while Judgment swirled around her beautifully.
<You expanded the concept of your Age to a Consummate Boundary...even the First True Emperor was not able to achieve this.>
Light spoke in a matter of fact tone as his eyes released a light of marvel!
He wanted to continue, but he felt the fair hands of Osaka on his right shoulder as he stopped and turned towards her.
Towards one of the more prominent Seers that even he listened to at times- even with his greater power!
Yet her next words caused all the Elder Ancestors here to shift with solemnity.I think you should take a look at
<You...are angry.>
Her golden blindfold was striking as hairs striped white and black cascaded past her shoulders.
Her words caused Noah to tap on his Throne as he asked with a gaze of coldness.

<Am I now? A man tends to get angry when organisms he has never seen before decree his home to be destroyed along with the lives of everyone he loves, and countless others. All because these beings were too damn feeble to figure out the simple usage of Natural Laws.>
WAA!
The Wills of the Elder Ancestors buzzed.
Solemnity and coldness descended as Clarity was gained!
The situation and the mechanics behind it all were slowly unveiled from these words alone as they felt his stance and attitude from his words!
Yet at the same time, he besmirched their own Lineage as some Elder Ancestors nearly erupted with anger.
Some particular Ancestors like Rodwig...clenched their hands as many pieces of the puzzle began to fall into place!
But they knew the current situation.
They remembered the words of Reverend Emperor Osaka!
So immense silence descended as they relied on the Seer of Judgment to navigate this, even the eyes of the True Emperor of Light only squinting hugely as he did not make any moves!
Osaka's blindfold shone with stellar radiance as she moved forward.

She broke away from the delegation of Ancestors behind her as her hand rose to stop them from advancing, her feet coming to land on the dreamy gold platform as her blank gaze momentarily went towards Ophelia.
BZZZT!
Her Judgment and Ophelia's Wisdom interacted and buzzed as from Ophelia...Osaka gained nothing but a calm face that held a smile.
She shook her head with a myriad of emotions as she spoke out.

<It seems we were wrong in the path we took before. Even if we are considered Ancestors, we are also beings just like you. Of the same Lineage and Creed. Of the same home. The same home that a great many deal of beings voted to not face the decree of destruction, but the wrong path was taken in the end. What I wish to do now...is ask for you to hold your anger and see if there is a path of reconciliation between us.>
Reconciliation!
A being capable of delicately handling matters was sent forth as her golden blindfold seemed to obscure her vision and also grant her an immense sight at the same time!

These were how his words felt as they had some records of the events after the death of Sacrarium Emperor Vulcan, but this information didn't seem all that trustworthy as they wished to discern the True identity of this being!
But the scene of the authority of Dreams surging as a Boundary before them caused rising skepticism as the being atop the throne didn't keep them in suspense.
<My identity is the same one that I told the last Elder Ancestor that was here.
I am the Last True Emperor of the Barren Lands, the True Emperor of Quintessence!>
HUUM!

The moment the word Quintessence was uttered, the surrounding space vibrated as the eyes of Rodwig and others shone with brilliance because they felt the aura of the same Consummate Boundary they had felt in the Abyss!
It proved this being was one and the same, but his words also caused immense silence to descend as it meant too many things!
The Last True Emperor.
The Cataclysm of the Barren Lands.

This information was enough to cause many complications to arise as the True Emperor of Light spoke once more while Reverend Emperor Osaka quietly listened while Judgment swirled around her beautifully.
<You expanded the concept of your Age to a Consummate Boundary...even the First True Emperor was not able to achieve this.>
Light spoke in a matter of fact tone as his eyes released a light of marvel!
He wanted to continue, but he felt the fair hands of Osaka on his right shoulder as he stopped and turned towards her.
Towards one of the more prominent Seers that even he listened to at times- even with his greater power!
Yet her next words caused all the Elder Ancestors here to shift with solemnity.I think you should take a look at
<You...are angry.>
Her golden blindfold was striking as hairs striped white and black cascaded past her shoulders.
Her words caused Noah to tap on his Throne as he asked with a gaze of coldness.
<Am I now?
A man tends to get angry when organisms he has never seen before decree his home to be destroyed along with the lives of everyone he loves, and countless others.
All because these beings were too damn feeble to figure out the simple usage of Natural Laws.>
WAA!
The Wills of the Elder Ancestors buzzed.
Solemnity and coldness descended as Clarity was gained!
The situation and the mechanics behind it all were slowly unveiled from these words alone as they felt his stance and attitude from his words!
Yet at the same time, he besmirched their own Lineage as some Elder Ancestors nearly erupted with anger.
Some particular Ancestors like Rodwig...clenched their hands as many pieces of the puzzle began to fall into place!
But they knew the current situation.
They remembered the words of Reverend Emperor Osaka!
So immense silence descended as they relied on the Seer of Judgment to navigate this, even the eyes of the True Emperor of Light only squinting hugely as he did not make any moves!
Osaka's blindfold shone with stellar radiance as she moved forward.

She broke away from the delegation of Ancestors behind her as her hand rose to stop them from advancing, her feet coming to land on the dreamy gold platform as her blank gaze momentarily went towards Ophelia.
BZZZT!
Her Judgment and Ophelia's Wisdom interacted and buzzed as from Ophelia...Osaka gained nothing but a calm face that held a smile.
She shook her head with a myriad of emotions as she spoke out.
<It seems we were wrong in the path we took before.
Even if we are considered Ancestors, we are also beings just like you.
Of the same Lineage and Creed.
Of the same home.
The same home that a great many deal of beings voted to not face the decree of destruction, but the wrong path was taken in the end.
What I wish to do now...is ask for you to hold your anger and see if there is a path of reconciliation between us.>
Reconciliation!
A being capable of delicately handling matters was sent forth as her golden blindfold seemed to obscure her vision and also grant her an immense sight at the same time!

chapters.title: Chapter 2336 The Concepts You Abandoned! III
paragraphs: It took every ounce of their power.
Every single ounce to control themselves and make sure that they did not have any outbursts as Reverend Emperor Osaka commanded.
But some had it much harder than others as Elder Ancestor Rodwig clenched his fists.
He thought of his Son sent as one of the Leaders in charge of overseeing the smoothness of the Cataclysm of the Barren Lands as he connected the dots with his death!
Yet he held it in.
Because the being before them was of the same source as them as he had enacted a Consummate Boundary! His feelings...were superseded by his duty to his bloodline as he didn't utter a word.
He only raised his head to lock his eyes onto the existence that a unique Seer of their Lineage had asked for the calming of his anger as she thought of a pathway of reconciliation.
Obtaining a Consummate Boundary was that important!
And his reply to such a question...
<Reconciliation, huh?> He tapped on the golden throne he sat on as his gaze went from Osaka to the True Emperor of Light, his voice continuing.

<There is but a simple path of reconciliation between me and those who decreed my death not too long ago...the leaders of the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage are weak and ineffective as they make such choices as to destroy their own homes, so I simply need to sit above them to make sure such organisms do not have a say in the future.>
His words seemingly brought all of the spacetime continuum to a halt.
An eerie silence descended as the Elder Ancestors confirmed whether they heard correctly!
And after a nanosecond...HOONG!
Waves of Wills erupted and buzzed with incredulity!
This being before them...actually dared to say such things?
For him to depose those leading the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage due to the verdict of destruction of the Barren Lands?!
Many Elder Ancestors wanted to erupt with their own words as before they could do this, even more shocking words came down that caused them to question their current reality.
It was five words that actually stemmed from Reverend Emperor Osaka as her blindfold released eye-catching waves of radiance.
<It's not an impossibility.>
BOOOM!
Utterly shocking words reverberated out.

Words that were very quickly followed with a buzzing rebuttal of Wills from the Elder Ancestors behind, but the True Emperor of Light blazed with a shocking radiance that blinded everyone behind him as he bellowed out!
<Quiet!>
WAA!
Silence descended.
Time slowed as every second seemed infinitely precious.
Light's body shone with power as he stared at Osaka gravely.
He was someone of great standing and power as he oversaw the workings of a Cluster of nearby Sacrariums near the border between their Lineage and the Qusarians.I think you should take a look at
He was one of the very few that were even granted the authority to contact the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Ancestral Lerneans Lineage!
He...wanted to hear exactly where Reverend Emperor Osaka was going with a statement that actually agreed with words of rebellion!
And her words continued to be just as explosive.

<Power is ultimately what decided the path we took in the past. No matter the votes cast, word came from our Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to simply be rid of the Natural Laws if they're going to bind themselves to us again. So long as you can exceed our power and the power of the Ancestral Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, there will be no opposition to electing you the Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor.>
<This...!>
BOOOM!
The mouths of most of the Elder Ancestors were agape.
<Preposterous!>
Many could not control themselves any longer as their voices erupted out.
<Rebellion!>
<Emperor Osaka!>
<Such words have immeasurable consequences!>
Booms and rebuttals bellowed out from all around as once more, the True Emperor of Light released a raging blinding radiance while turning around to lock his gaze onto all the Elder Ancestors here.
<The next person to voice their opinions will be stripped of their positions and lose their seat!>
A terrifying air of power reverberated out as silence descended again.
The cold eyes of the True Emperor of Light filled with radiance locked onto all Elder Ancestors behind him before he turned around and stepped forward.
A single step took him onto the golden platform as he turned to face Reverend Emperor Osaka calmly.
He looked at her eye-catching blindfolded face as he recalled countless instances in the past billions of years where she and other Seers had led them towards victory and treasures.
He had never rejected her words before.
But what she uttered now...
She spoke of things that would not normally ever be talked about!
She spoke of the authority of the Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor!
A personage so far away and so important that even Light dared to not have any designs on such a being.
Only endless respect!
And now...he measured all of this with the nature and weight of a Seer that was more often than not right on most things!

He paused in what move he should make, but in this silence, boisterous laughter erupted out as the True Emperor of Quintessence upon the golden throne seemed to enjoy the unfolding show, his visage rising from the vibrant throne.

Haki began to surge and coagulate around him like a multicolored shawl, the potent aura of the Consummate Boundary of Quintessence erupting out fully and pressing upon everything as he spoke with a diabolical smile.

<Power, power, and more power. I've heard a lot and experienced a lot more with this concept recently. After all, there is only one reason you lot are standing before me right now. Not because you suddenly came to your senses that the Cataclysm of the Barren Lands and killing me and all others within it was wrong, but because I have a Consummate Boundary that you now desire to leech off of. To get that, you would bow your head and seek reconciliation. You're right though...with enough power, I can depose the Kings and Emperors overseeing the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage. But I can do that myself just fine. I truly do not see what there is to gain from a so called reconciliation with the weakest Lineage in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!>
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2337 The Concepts You Abandoned! IV
paragraphs: <...I truly do not see what there is to gain from a so called reconciliation with the weakest Lineage in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!>
His voice emanated grand Haki and pressure that spread the grandeur of The Consummate Boundary emanating from his very skin!
Against beings that the Dimensional Rulers revered as Ancestors, he spoke with grandness and regality.
Against those who had lived for billions of years, he spoke against them with no terror as the scene was exceedingly quiet!
The task of communicating was left to the Seer.
Reverend Emperor Osaka had her blindfolded gaze on the daunting figure of the standing Noah as even amidst all this, she kept her calm while replying.

<The Vaults of Extremity are unimaginably vast, and our Lineage is very weak. You are part of that Lineage. Part of those stemming from the same Planes of Existence as you even bore the weight of a True Emperor like many others before you. As someone seeking to effect change in our path and leadership, I would only seek for you to share your Quintessence with the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage so that we gain an even greater fighting chance even in our Haven of Dissolution.>
A fighting chance.

Against the mysterious Planeswalkers, the brutal Noblesse, and the steadfast Quasarians...where were they going to be when the unfolding process of Extremity Sanctification truly kicked into high gear?
They needed something like a Consummate Boundary.
They needed this being standing before them!

The scale of time didn't even matter in this as among the many tools their Lineage had, there were the means of the Boundary of Sacrifice born from an Apex Aeonic Lifeform Lernaean that allowed one to sacrifice all the Layers of two identical Boundaries to grasp the Layers of a single one.

It was inefficient, but some organisms utilized it greatly as they advanced two Planar Boundaries to a high Boundary Layer for the sole purpose of sacrificing them for the progression of a single Innate Boundary.
So long as they could gain the authority to the Consummate Boundary of Quintessence this being held...the power of their Reverends would be revolutionized so long as they sacrificed something for it!
So Osaka spoke of their Lineage and their home plane they all stemmed from as even though she uttered these words, Judgment already told her their results.
But she still uttered them because the words to come out of the True Emperor of Quintessence next...

<The only Lineage I am a part of that matters is the Quintessential Kainos Emperor Lineage. And any organisms wishing to even touch my Consummate Boundaries...there is only one pathway in doing so. It can only be those I consider my Vassals!>
BOOM!
A deafening silence cascaded down as the eyes of many Elder Ancestors gazed forward with hidden anger and burning pride.
Who were they?
Rulers of Sacrariums!
Beings that this True Emperor before them were Ancestors of!
The being himself in question was also someone that should have been their descendent.
Yet he was actually voicing out such incredulous words as they only had to listen?!
Their regal eyes full of power turned towards the True Emperor of Light.
They wanted to be represented. They wanted to let their unwillingness be known!
Light bore all these gazes and Wills as his hand moved to land on the shoulders of Osaka.I think you should take a look at
And Osaka said no more as if she had done what she needed to do, the potent figure of Light coming into the picture as he stared at Noah and spoke out with calmness.
<If I may ask, how did you arrive at the position of power you currently have in this short period of time? How exactly did you bring the concept of your Age to a Consummate level?>
There were geniuses in the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage that rose to prominence over the years.
Many beings here were also considered geniuses as anyone achieving the 9th Boundary Layer in any concept had great attunement towards Extremity!
But what Noah was doing...was utterly ridiculous as the True Emperor of Light posed such a question.

And the ever increasing pressure of Haki around the True Emperor of Quintessence rumbled as his hand rose up while gazing forward, a burst of cerulean grandeur emanating from him along with his resonant voice.

<It's due to the home you all wanted to destroy, and the same concepts you all abandoned and thought to be restrictions. Had you really seen them for what they were...you would not have been struggling with the Noblesse, Quasarians, and Planeswalkers after billions of years in this Haven!>
WAA!

Glorious essence of Manadynamics erupted out as it screamed of purity and Extremity, the aura of a Consummate Boundary releasing from it wildly as it caused the Elder Ancestors before him to stare in a stupor!
But this was not all!
BZZT!
A fantastical ray of gold erupted as Providence also appeared around his body, the aura of a Consummate Boundary swirling around it with glory.
<The concepts you abandoned...>
Another flash of light bloomed as a mixture of crimson darkness erupted out- Entropy coming into play as Noah seemed like an incarnation of the rulings of reality!
<...were the answers to all your problems. You all were simply too weak to realize it.>
They termed the Natural Laws of Reality the worst types of concepts to be expanded to Boundaries.
They felt restricted by them and anchored the Major Plane of Existence they stemmed from to escape their influence!
Yet now, a being stood before them and told them how wrong they were!
Utter silence descended as the buzzing glow of multiple Consummate Boundaries was the only thing rising and falling in the Abecedarian Observatory.

If they had these for the last Billions of years...would not they be at the same level of Hegemony as the Planeswalkers who were filled with power and secrecy? Would they have exceeded even the Quasarians long ago? Would their great Enemies of Noblesse be a force they wiped out long ago?!
<You can run back to your Sacrariums and let it be known.>
WAA!
The dominating voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence rang out as he chose a different method of Conquest.
The tyrannical light of this Boundary burned from his eyes he continued.
<Let it be known that multiple Consummate Boundaries are at my fingertips, and any who wish to attain even a semblance of understanding of such concepts can come before me and kneel for them.>
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2338 An Unimaginable Form Of Conquest! I
paragraphs: There were many different methods of Conquest.
Noah could have chosen to send one or multiple of his clones onto the domains of the Ancestral Lernaeans.
But instead, he flaunted his Consummate Boundaries as he let them know that if any of them wished to even get close to such Concepts...they needed to come before him and kneel!
He wouldn't have to chase them, they would all have to run towards him.
And such shocking words smashed onto the Wills and souls of the powerful Elder Ancestors that were masters of Sacrariums.
Osaka was silent.
The True Emperor of Light had no words.

Who were they? Just what level of prestige in reality did they enjoy in their day-to-day life? For them to bow towards their Descendant- someone who came from their very own lineage years after they were born.. their souls and hearts forged in the light of Extremity over billions of years could not overcome this feeling so easily!
TAP! TAP!

Yet it was at this moment though, that the light steps on the sandy golden platform could be heard as the figure of Ophelia that was situated behind Noah stepped forward and came to kneel before his stature.

The Golden Lights of Wisdom were graciously wrapping around her, and she raised her head while kneeling and taking the right hand of the True Emperor of Quintessence who stared down towards her with utter magnanimity!
And seconds later...
BOOM!

The body of Ophelia erupted first with the grand light of Providence, and soon after the light of Entropy and Manadynamics also made their appearance as the aura of multiple Consummate Boundaries also trickled around her freely!
Actions spoke louder than words.
In her wisdom, Ophelia showed just what the words of the True Emperor of Quintessence meant.
And they bore witness to the shocking scene themselves!
A fight between pride and humility was an interesting one, but in the grand scheme of things... it never lasted long.
Didn't they choose to destroy their very home all for the sake of power? If they could truly get their hands on Consummate Boundaries just by paying homage to this being before them..
WAA
Waves of Providence surged as after Ophelia showed the way, and the silent and blindfolded Osaka was the next one to follow.
Things seemed to be relatively easier for the Seers as the boundaries that they had more often than not steered them towards a better fate- and the Judgment around Osaka was clear as day.
With her being the first one to fall, an Elder Ancestor gritted his teeth as he also fell to his knees, the allure of power before them being too strong!
Consummate!
Something they could never reach!
So even though the being before was their Descendant...they as the Ancestors began to kneel towards him one after another.

Noah watched this scene coldly as Haki continued to regally pulse around him, gazing as over half of the Elder Ancestors her kneeled- the essence of Conquest erupting out with wild tyranny as dazzling singularities of lights began to float out from the bodies of these Elder Ancestors.
These were...a part of their Aeonic Soul.
A core part of them that made their power!
This was the price to be paid as kneeling was merely a formal gesture!
They had to pay fealty and give up a part of their Soul!
And so the portions of souls of beings that had lived for billions of years...all surged towards Noah as he devoured it all completely.

And only after he received the pledge of Fealty did the bodies of those kneeling begin to tremble as from the portion of the soul they gave up, they felt an unbreakable bond form between them and the True Emperor of Quintessence as through this bond...they felt the connection of multiple Consummate Boundaries that they could now access! I think you should take a look at
With this...
<Haha...Consummate!>
An Elder Ancestor among those kneeling laughed boisterously at this moment as he wanted to initiate the Boundary of Sacrifice right away to attain something he thought to be impossible.
But...he was among those that kneeled.
There were a few other Elder Ancestors that still stood as Elder Ancestor Rodwig was among them...and in the lead of all these organisms was the True Emperor of Light!
His hair shone with radiance as he spoke out cool amidst all this.
<I represent too many things as I cannot make such a choice myself. I will pass the word and let you know.>
He was one of the leading Elder Ancestors as he didn't fall into the allure of power so easily.
Among those by his side, Rodwig clenched his fists as a sword glow blazed from his body!
<I have to ask.>
The Sword glow was contained and sharp as he spoke out amidst all this, Noah's gaze turning towards him as he felt a tinge of Karma.
<Theseus- one of the Commanders sent to assure the Cataclysm of the Barren Lands...you were the one who killed him?>
WAA!
A grand question! Rodwig would not be himself if he didn't at least ask such a question!
And yet the True Emperor of Quintessence replied simply and with coldness.
<Your son came to kill me and destroy my home...the result of all this was his death. If you feel discontent about this, you can also come at me.>
The buzz of the Sword was low as it hummed.
The face of Elder Ancestor Rodwig darkened and held a mix of emotions as he seemed ready to act, Light who was in front of him getting ready to move to make sure a fight did not break out!
But...
THUNK!
In the mixture of emotions and to the disbelief of many, Rodwig joined the majority that were kneeling as after ascertaining the fate of his son...he actually bowed to his killer!
Others may not be able to understand it. His own eyes showed a trace of unwillingness, but he did it nonetheless as only he knew why he did this!
Noah gazed at such a scene coldly as his Soul took everything in.
The oh so great Ancestors that others revered kneeled before him all for the sake of power.
It roused his tyrannical will of conquest and simultaneously caused a sense of distaste, Noah gazing at them as his voice echoed out.
<Go back and defend your Sacrariums. Let others know what they need to do in order to touch even a semblance of this power.>
He did not even need to move out himself.
He would have all of them come to him as he carried out an unimaginable method of conquest, telling these organisms to defend their Sacrariums!

After all, similar to the Abecedarian Sacrarium...many of the occupied domains were either a Major Plane, a Cluster of Major Planes of Existence, or Natural Domains of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution like the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity.
And since the Ancestral Lernaeans had multiple domains in the form of planes...it was time for Noah to be planting the seeds of having Planes for his Infinite Plane to devour and assimilate soon!

Noah could have chosen to send one or multiple of his clones onto the domains of the Ancestral Lernaeans.
But instead, he flaunted his Consummate Boundaries as he let them know that if any of them wished to even get close to such Concepts...they needed to come before him and kneel!
He wouldn't have to chase them, they would all have to run towards him.
And such shocking words smashed onto the Wills and souls of the powerful Elder Ancestors that were masters of Sacrariums.
Osaka was silent.
The True Emperor of Light had no words.
Who were they?
Just what level of prestige in reality did they enjoy in their day-to-day life?

For them to bow towards their Descendant- someone who came from their very own lineage years after they were born.. their souls and hearts forged in the light of Extremity over billions of years could not overcome this feeling so easily!
TAP!
TAP!

Yet it was at this moment though, that the light steps on the sandy golden platform could be heard as the figure of Ophelia that was situated behind Noah stepped forward and came to kneel before his stature.

The Golden Lights of Wisdom were graciously wrapping around her, and she raised her head while kneeling and taking the right hand of the True Emperor of Quintessence who stared down towards her with utter magnanimity!
And seconds later...
BOOM!

The body of Ophelia erupted first with the grand light of Providence, and soon after the light of Entropy and Manadynamics also made their appearance as the aura of multiple Consummate Boundaries also trickled around her freely!
Actions spoke louder than words.
In her wisdom, Ophelia showed just what the words of the True Emperor of Quintessence meant.
And they bore witness to the shocking scene themselves!
A fight between pride and humility was an interesting one, but in the grand scheme of things... it never lasted long.
Didn't they choose to destroy their very home all for the sake of power?
If they could truly get their hands on Consummate Boundaries just by paying homage to this being before them..
WAA
Waves of Providence surged as after Ophelia showed the way, and the silent and blindfolded Osaka was the next one to follow.
Things seemed to be relatively easier for the Seers as the boundaries that they had more often than not steered them towards a better fate- and the Judgment around Osaka was clear as day.
With her being the first one to fall, an Elder Ancestor gritted his teeth as he also fell to his knees, the allure of power before them being too strong!
Consummate!
Something they could never reach!
So even though the being before was their Descendant...they as the Ancestors began to kneel towards him one after another.

Noah watched this scene coldly as Haki continued to regally pulse around him, gazing as over half of the Elder Ancestors her kneeled- the essence of Conquest erupting out with wild tyranny as dazzling singularities of lights began to float out from the bodies of these Elder Ancestors.
These were...a part of their Aeonic Soul.
A core part of them that made their power!
This was the price to be paid as kneeling was merely a formal gesture!
They had to pay fealty and give up a part of their Soul!
And so the portions of souls of beings that had lived for billions of years...all surged towards Noah as he devoured it all completely.

And only after he received the pledge of Fealty did the bodies of those kneeling begin to tremble as from the portion of the soul they gave up, they felt an unbreakable bond form between them and the True Emperor of Quintessence as through this bond...they felt the connection of multiple Consummate Boundaries that they could now access!

chapters.title: Chapter 2339 An Unimaginable Form Of Conquest! II
paragraphs: One of Noah's biggest tools was his Infinite Plane, and it was already undergoing great changes when the Natural Laws that made it were expanded towards Extremity.

Noah benefited from Providence, Entropy, or Manadynamics becoming Consummate and reaching the 9th Boundary Layer, but the Infinite Plane...its benefits were on a whole other level entirely as at this moment, the pervasive aura of Extremity that lorded over everything in the Vaults of Extremity also began to permeate across the Infinite Plane and build in concentration.
It was a slow and gradual process to make sure the inhabitants were crushed under its weight as they slowly adapted, but it was occurring!
As all this happened, Noah would be ready for its expansion as he planted the seeds.
His deadly method of Conquest for the Ancestral Lernaeans.
His son that he had pointed towards the Noblesse!
All that was left...were the domains of Quasarians and Planeswalkers.
In the Source of Reality, Noah spoke out thoughtfully while feeling his expanding Origin, Body, and Soul.

He thought of the Planeswalkers that in the abundant memories he had gained, there was still little known about them as the high ranks of Noblesse and Lernaeans had sufficient evidence that these beings...may have not necessarily originated from this Haven.
That they stemmed from another Haven and had support across the crevices that organisms apart from Apex Aeonic Lifeforms couldn't cross!

And when Providence surged around Noah now, it fed him a great deal of information as he knew he would soon mix with these beings...and even those from other Planes as they all seemed to be coming for the secrets within the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
And even though his power may not be enough to overwhelm them right now...things may be drastically different in just a matter of minutes or hours!
<Very well. Let's open up NULLITY and RUIN first, and then the rest will follow...>
His Will rang out gloriously as around his main body, tendrils of crimson and silver lights wrapped around him.
He had exceeded the Primitivus and Proficere Stages with ridiculous speed due to his devouring of the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans.
He was now scaling up the Terminus Stage as the first set of Boundaries for these sources of chaos....were not too far away!
Deep within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.

In a region that held auroras of stellar obsidian rivers of light, a vibrant Plane of Existence floated within the very center of such natural constructs as it gave off a grand feeling of ancientness.

A countless number of these stellar obsidian rivers of light wrapped around the barrier of this Plane of Existence like surging rings of light that also carried a heavy gravitational force, radiant interstellar vessels stationed all around this area as the potent aura of Boundary Expansion Realm existences could be felt in abundance.
A few light years away from this location, within the foldings of spacetime...the visage of Henry carefully gazed towards the Domain known as the Styx Regality Plane that was filled with Noblesse.

Boundless intricate things were contained within it as Chaoticus Beasts could barely be seen in abundance past the barrier of the Plane being used as mounts, an air of peace and power permeating across this whole region as within its depths, it was protected by Reverend Noblesse!
'Or...it was.'

Henry's eyes were sharp as he saw another interstellar vessel leave the Styx Regality Plane, taking the aura of a potent 9th Boundary Layer existence with it as more and more beings were being pulled towards the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands where his father currently was!

It left the domains of all participating Lineages much more defenseless than normal, which made infiltration all that easier as from the words of Providence...the being he sought had already made his way into this domain of Noblesse!

The Planar Annals of Providence shone brightly before Henry's face as new words filled them at this moment, his figure buzzing with power soon after as he sent mental messages to the Dimensional Rulers, Emperor Penguin, Tiamat, Barbatos...and all others joining in on this mission.I think you should take a look at
On this hunt!
<The target has entered the domain as the most opportune time ordained by Providence is coming. Aunty Eowyn, you share a Karma of Death with him as we will depend on you for his initial location...>
They're all spread out across different regions near this domain in order to catch a single being.
A being who could escape instantly and disappear right in front of their eyes from what his father had told him.
To actually trap him...was an ordeal that would take the might of many beings!
HOOONG!
At this moment, rapid movements began to occur in the periphery of the Styx Regality Plane as multiple auras blazed powerfully.
It was time.
Henry felt a smile bloom on his face as Destiny and Providence wrapped around his figure and hid him even deeper, his voice spreading out across the established interaction channel at this moment!
<Begin!>
WAA!
The hunt for the True Emperor of Destiny kicked off spectacularly and silently as a tug of war between Destiny and Providence was played!
Below the surging Abyss in the Endless Thalassic Caverns of Nullity.
Past the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, space and time twisted as Noah found himself gazing at fantastical sights outside of pure fantasy.

The landscapes of mountains were torn down by ever raging tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY- which were waves of chaos that destroyed everything but when Noah neared...they made way for him and even wrapped around him to be engrossed into his Body as he reached the cusp of the Terminus Stage of these concepts!

He was learning the True nature of destruction from them as due to their raging nature, he saw the mountains flattening as the thick tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY transformed into snaking rivers that all surged further inward.

Ophelia's Aeonic Soul Clone stuck to Noah tightly as she squinted her eyes further ahead, both she and Noah sensing the aura of clashing forces as the shadow of a massive Leviathan could be seen near them, a single figure pushing it back as behind it- a grand allure of a particularly potent treasure proliferating outwards.
Ophelia peered across the tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY as she voiced out lightly.
<There's danger and opportunities ahead, but actually even more danger behind us at this moment...>
Her words were true, yet Noah smiled when he heard them.

Providence was already feeding him waves of information as he knew particularly powerful organisms were following the same path past the mountains and Leviathans to delve deeper into these treasured lands.
But he was not as curious about them as he was about the aura of the being he could feel ahead.
The one that had arrived and ignored all others as he delved deeper into these lands with purpose.
It was the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar who was currently ahead of them, his advancement halted by a particularly powerful Leviathan!

chapters.title: Chapter 2340 Aboriginals! I
paragraphs: <Elephantine Zoster Hive Queen>

A bellowing Leviathan with four massive elephantine limbs and a trunk that seemed like a terrifying Spear caused the tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY in the surroundings to come crashing down on the figure of the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar.
Noah and Ophelia came close to see this scene as Noah floated amidst the tendrils of red and silver lights while stroking his chin thoughtfully!
Ophelia saw his contemplative expression as she asked.
<Did you find something?>
<Mmm...> Noah nodded while continuing to sift through the many possible paths laid out by the Planar Annals of Providence.
<There is a path where I may share Karma and fate with this being.>
He voiced out what he was actively learning while experiencing the power of one of the renowned beings in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
Towards a Leviathan who had reached the 9th Boundary Layers of both RUIN and NULLITY...
OOOH!
Caesar seemed like an even greater beast as his skin pulsed with an obsidian stellar light.

As he was quite literally made of quasars, his body constantly changed from its humanoid form and into a circular rotating mass of extreme Gravitation- the essence of the Consummate Boundary of Borealis in the hands of Quasarians erupting from him as he released a concentrated point of gravity and temperature that burned and collapsed everything!

The impenetrable skin of the <Elephantine Zoster Hive Queen> was shredded as crimson gold blood overflowed, and before it could disperse its body into an endless array of foam, a gravitational force wrapped around it tightly as Caesar bellowed out once more.
BZZT!

And the thin lines of gravity instantly lit up with an obsidian light as it seemed like a black sun had formed around the <Elephantine Zoster Hive Queen>, its defenses melting under this light as even while collecting NULLITY and RUIN to protect itself- it wasn't enough!
Its massive body was instantly liquefied as a terrifying amount of Damage Values in the form of extreme temperature and Gravitation crushed it entirely.
And all that was left behind was a single champion.
He returned to his humanoid form as a stellar glow surrounded him, his gaze turning up from the molten earth he stood on to land on the figure of Noah and Ophelia in the silver red skies.
It was a gaze without any emotions, and a brief one as Noah had a smile on his face when their eyes locked!
A gaze, and that was it. Caesar then turned around as he was about to continue on the same path that he was on. But...
<Oh my, we've actually come across interesting Aboriginals...>
An authoritative voice filled with unbelievable amounts of power emanated out.I think you should take a look at
It did not stem from Noah or Ophelia, nor did it stem from the Mad Reverend emperor Caesar.
Behind them both in the Crimson silver skies filled with tendrils of Chaos, waves of essence parted ways to reveal the appearance of a dazzling set of existences.

Their hair was tinged silver and gold, their skin releasing a radiant fair luster while they were adorned in armaments that would put even Epoch relics to shame- their materials crystalline in nature as the Armaments radiated white gold light.

Every single one of them revealed devilish handsomeness and beauty as their bodies released waves of potent Extremity. The weakest among these beings would be the equivalent of a renowned and mighty Commander of the Quasarians or the Noblesse!
They looked aloof and otherworldly, as if nothing could ever cause them fear, as if the very Skies they stood on belonged to them.
And the terrifying wave of consummate boundaries that they gave off seemed to confirm their standing, each of them looking like an unstoppable force that others could only dream of ever touching.
It was 12 beings divided equally into six women and six men as the women looked like Queens of grand dynasties while the men looked like Emperors of dozens of Planes of Existence!
Their eyes carried exceeding power and knowledge that rivaled sages of the distant past, with a single gaze of theirs able to discern the truth of nature.
The one who had spoken was distinguished even within this group as he floated further forward than all the others as while he spoke, the others only watched on calmly.
At Golden Glow surrounded the eyes of this being as his silver and gold hair release a radiant Stellar light

<This is interesting...Destiny is actually telling me that these Aboriginals have the power to stand in our way, and that they will actually be vying for the same opportunities that we came for as well. Are you guys getting the same reading?>

The 11 Regal existence behind him were all covered with a glow of Boundaries powerfully at the 9th Boundary Layer as each of them nodded lightly, with existence like them similar to Noah being capable of discerning fate to an unbelievable degree!
Of the 6 women, one had languid eyes with exceeding calmness that turned towards Noah at this moment.

<Especially so for this pretty boy over here. He seems to have multiple Consummate Boundaries under his belt...an abnormality in this Haven as he doesn't carry the atmosphere of any Haven apart from Dissolution. What shall we do, Titus? We were told not to interfere with the Aboriginals too much. But these ones will very well interfere with our mission.>
From the distance, Noah heard these words as he nearly laughed, not remembering the last time that anyone ever referred to him as a pretty boy.

Providence was measuring the power of these beings as Noah also took the situation seriously, their power being higher than even the Mad Reverend Emperor below them as the reason was the same one that made Noah so powerful.
Multiple Consummate Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer!
The one called Titus smiled as the golden glow of Destiny increased around him, a devilish smile creeping on his lips as he spoke with potency and Tyranny.
<Naturally, we have to clear the hindrances in our route before we remorse it in the future.>
