<This is interesting...Destiny is actually telling me that these Aboriginals have the power to stand in our way, and that they will actually be vying for the same opportunities that we came for as well.
Are you guys getting the same reading?>

The 11 Regal existence behind him were all covered with a glow of Boundaries powerfully at the 9th Boundary Layer as each of them nodded lightly, with existence like them similar to Noah being capable of discerning fate to an unbelievable degree!
Of the 6 women, one had languid eyes with exceeding calmness that turned towards Noah at this moment.
<Especially so for this pretty boy over here.
He seems to have multiple Consummate Boundaries under his belt...an abnormality in this Haven as he doesn't carry the atmosphere of any Haven apart from Dissolution.
What shall we do, Titus?
We were told not to interfere with the Aboriginals too much.
But these ones will very well interfere with our mission.>
From the distance, Noah heard these words as he nearly laughed, not remembering the last time that anyone ever referred to him as a pretty boy.

Providence was measuring the power of these beings as Noah also took the situation seriously, their power being higher than even the Mad Reverend Emperor below them as the reason was the same one that made Noah so powerful.
Multiple Consummate Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer!
The one called Titus smiled as the golden glow of Destiny increased around him, a devilish smile creeping on his lips as he spoke with potency and Tyranny.
<Naturally, we have to clear the hindrances in our route before we remorse it in the future.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2341 Aboriginals! II
paragraphs: <Naturally, we have to clear the obstacles in our path before we regret it in the future.>
A deadly set of words emanated out.
Immense silence descended as it was quickly broken by a resolute voice.
<I have no qualms with you all, nor do I plan on getting in anybody's way. I am only here for a single thing, and I shall be gone as soon as that is attained.>
WAA!
The Mad Reverend Emperor actually spoke reasonably while staring at the cluster of powerful Reverends above him.
<Oh?> His words piqued the interest of Titus as the glow of Destiny became even more pronounced around him.

<What you're here for is likely what we're here for. Otherwise, my destiny wouldn't have reacted. It should be the same Extremity Panaceas...born in the depths of the Initiating Extremity Vein. A treasure that reforges one's existence and grants the Extremity Foundation. The problem is...there aren't too many of them as you and that pretty boy over there- well, Destiny is telling me you will definitely get in the way.>
Extremity Panaceas!

The Eyes of the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar released a burst of light the moment he heard this as his own Destiny...it went wild at this moment and affirmed to him that this may very well just be what his daughter needed to survive!
If he could obtain it and bring it back in time, she should be cured so long as her very existence can be reforged.

On the other side, Noah touched his face as he wondered if his recent transformations and the addition of Consummate Boundaries made his beauty reach entirely new levels for multiple beings to refer to him as a pretty boy!
Such a distinction was trampling on the dignity of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as his perceptive eyes locked on to these beings with a sharp gaze!
Meanwhile, on the molten earth below him.
<Extremity Panacea...> Caesar let the words roll out of his tongue as his gaze remained utterly calm.
He could see the smiles of control and confidence on the beings in the distant skies as when he thought about the state of his daughter and what their words were implying...

<I said I have no qualms with you not because you do not seem to be of this Haven, nor because I am afraid of your power. I simply don't wish to have my time wasted on pointless power struggles when the opportunities are so vast.>
BOOM!

Crackles of Boundaries surged around his body as a terrifying air that would even cause peak Reverends to shudder boomed out, his words continuing as his skin turned stellar black as if countless quasars spun on every atom!
<Below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, I am unrivaled. Let us not make each other enemies for no reason. I will take what I need and leave right after.>
The temperature in the surroundings rose to ridiculous levels.
Massive gravitational forces mixed in and raged out as Caesar stayed true to his distinction!
Against existences who were undoubtedly at the same stage of power as him, he was fearless! I think you should take a look at
Yet the figures above were unfettered as on their beautiful faces, dazzling smiles of confidence rose while Titus with utmost calmness.

<Haha, old man...you're unrivaled below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms? That distinction doesn't belong to you! You will come to realize that there are others far, far above you in strength even before being elevated to Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. As for the conflict between us...I tend to listen to my Destiny. If it tells me that you and that attractive boy will be getting in our way...I have to eliminate that threat and pull it from the roots entirely.>
Transparent forms of Haki began to rise from the fair skin of this terrifying being.

The billowing temperature and rising gravity from Caesar were pushed at bay with the mere appearance of this formless Haki, things seeming ready to explode when a nonchalant voice rang out gloriously at such a juncture!

<There they go calling me a pretty boy again...Ophelia, have I changed drastically in beauty since you met me?> Waves of Quintessence began to burn on his body as radiant multicolored Haki accompanied it with utmost majesty.
Ophelia didn't skip a beat as she smiled, her light brown countenance releasing waves of beauty no less than the women gazing down at them from afar as she nodded slightly.
<Yes, Sacrarium Master. You were already stunning before, but your appearance now makes my heart beat just a tad bit faster.>
WAA!
Noah's brows rose at her words as he nodded with understanding, turning his oppressive gaze towards the being known as Titus and those around him as he spoke out while his aura continued to rise.

< There are always overly prideful beings who think all of reality is beneath their feet. They get their time to shine briefly, they then realize their mistakes and overinflated egos, they regret, and then they die. I...have seen this story play out too many times.>
Glory and power erupted.
But it was held at bay as from the distance, Titus laughed freely!
<Interesting...but this isn't that type of story. Let me introduce myself.>
HOONG!
The surging tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY pervading moving in the surroundings instantly stopped.

Around Titus, a silver gold glow erupted out as everywhere it passed, RUIN and NULLITY were entirely erased as the silver red skies entirely faded, a terrifying Haki spreading out with maddening grandeur as feathery wings of silver and gold erupted from this being's back!
<From the Aeonic Haven of Genesis, I am a Haven Disciple of the Genesis Institute of Extremity- Reverend Emperor Titus.>
WAA!
The Aeonic Haven of Genesis!

There were Seven Aeonic Havens in the Havens of Extremity, and a series of frightening creatures from the Aeonic Haven of Genesis descended onto the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution for no purpose other than the utmost boons of its Initiating Extremity Vein!
They originated from an ancient faction known as the Genesis Institute of Extremity as this group...wasn't the only one.

And the Genesis Institute of Extremity was also not the only faction to send its people over as the Initiation of the Extremity Vein of the Youngest Haven...was something that drew in completely frightening entities with incomprehensible Origins stretched out across spacetime!

chapters.title: Chapter 2342 Catastrophic! I
paragraphs: A silver gold glow erupted out as everywhere it passed, RUIN and NULLITY were entirely erased as the silver red skies entirely faded!

Feathery wings of silver and gold radiated power from this being's back as he seemed like an untouchable existence- his Lineage and Origin unknown apart from his affiliation with the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
Titus!

<You think of me as some arrogant being who doesn't know the breadth and vastness of reality, and that I've somehow knocked onto something that I shouldn't have on this day. I can definitively tell you that any time I have a target...it is always an enemy that I can erase entirely with its roots entirely ripped out.>
WAA!
His voice was magnanimous.
His tonation was mighty!
He spoke with Absolute confidence as the other Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity floated behind him with eyes that showed they believed every single word!
And Titus shook his head as he seemed to think back on something before he continued.
<Of all the enemies I have faced so far, truly none remain alive to tell the tale.>
A deadly silence descended as his released Haki caused everything to be calm.

The Sources of chaos were pushed away as if they didn't exist, Noah, Ophelia, and Caesar looking at this scene with serious eyes as even amidst all of this- Noah still replied calmly as his body continued to climb up in power.
<Well, there's a first time for everything.>
He didn't have enemies that he wasn't able to kill before, and nobody he had made a target had lived to tell the tale!
The True Emperor of Quintessence told such a being that there was a first time for everything!

And truth be told, Noah knew he was a horrifying enemy for his current self and single Clone here, where even now- Providence was calculating that once he expanded RUIN and NULLITY by utilizing the Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity already devoured by his body, he should be able to stand toe to toe with this being.
Toe to toe.
But there was no guarantee of being capable of granting him True Death!
And the issue became that this being wasn't alone.
There were 11 others that may have been of slightly less power than him, but they were just as deadly!
And it was all of them against him, Ophelia, and this Quasarian Commander who already seemed fed up at this moment.

Noah bid his time even now as his Origin continued to expand powerfully, his Aeonic Values in terms of Vitality, Defense, and Damage continuing to rise along with the strength of his body- with his Soul still continuing the transformation brought about by the Entropic Entity of Extremity.

And Ruin and Nullity were nearly at the end of the Terminus Stages as he absorbed billions of years of understanding from the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans he had defeated, so Noah knew the time wasn't too far away!
He just had to hold on for a few minutes longer and all of these transformations would be complete...and he could then gather exactly how powerful beings from other Havens were.
What their history and concepts were.I think you should take a look at
What their memories would tell of the vastness of Extremity!
But just as he was curious about what his enemies were hiding, so were they about himself.
<But, I do make it a habit of knowing exactly who my enemies are before erasing them. Let's see, who are you...>

The vibrant hands of Titus flashed as he pulled out a golden mirror that caused both Noah and Caesar to feel a profound sense of oppression, astonishment arriving from their faces as Titus continued with a sly smile!

<Ah yes, it is a instrument forged by an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as nobody under this stage can evade its effects. No offensive or defensive capabilities, but it can shed some transparency on who a being is.>
In less than an instant, a golden light flashed and passed across space to reflect on the figures of Caesar, Noah, and Ophelia!

Their prepared barriers and defense mechanisms acted as if it wasn't an attack as it truly carried no Damage Values- and it was akin to the light of Clarity released by the Eyes of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform that the Noblesse held.
It was too fast- and it truly was something that a different stage of Lifeforms normally utilized!
Titus had a calm expression as a golden light returned to the mirror, and he read on calmly.

<Ophelia, with an Aeonic Soul Age of 19 Billion Years. Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power approximately at the Peak Reverend Stage. A single Consummate Boundary under you as you are accepting other Consummate Boundaries even now...interesting.>
Titus read off the golden mirror freely as Ophelia's eyes released a profound light of Wisdom!
<Caesar, with an Aeonic Soul Age of 53 Billion Years. Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power approximately at the Unequalled Reverend Stage...haha, so at least you weren't lying about your power.>
BZZZT!

The stellar obsidian body of the Mad Reverend Emperor vibrated with power as he seemed ready to let loose and attack imminently, but the voice of Titus freely continued again as this time, his eyes turned sharp.
<The last one is...Osmont, with an Aeonic Soul Age of...what?>
His keen eyes blinked a few times.
The Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity behind him raised their brows and sent their Wills over to look as gazes of astonishment also came upon their faces!
Surprise followed by slightly more earnestness as Titus finished his words.
<Osmont, with an Aeonic Soul Age of less than 100 Years...my oh my, who are you...really?>
An Aeonic Soul Age of less than 100 Years!
The horrifying instrument that Titus held was known as an Apex Aeonic Relic as even with its stupendous capabilities, it only gave approximations to a certain level.
It wasn't able to give an exact numerical value, where if someone was within a range of a few hundred years to a thousand, it would say less than 1,000 years.
If someone was below the age of 100, it would also simply say so as a specific number wouldn't be approximated!
So these Haven Disciples from the Genesis Institute of Extremity...didn't know that the True Aeonic Soul of the being they were focusing on currently...was barely a fraction of this 100!

chapters.title: Chapter 2343 Catastrophic! II
paragraphs: After Titus's glorious transformation, all the others had remained at bay.
But at this moment.
BZZT!

Radiant golden and silver wings blossomed on the 11 other beings as one of the most dazzling women in the silver gold crystalline armament squinted her eyes while reading out what was on the Apex Aeonic Relic.

<Osmont, with an Aeonic Soul Age of less than 100 Years. And Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power...unable to be defined at this moment. Titus, this is likely a genius affiliated with the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra for him to be able to mask even his Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power against the Haven Seeing Mirror. He may be similar to those fostered monsters from the Vicissitude Extremity Grotto with mutated souls for him to be this young...>
WAA!
The Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity gazed towards Noah as if they were seeing an equal for the first time, many assumptions being made by them as Titus didn't lose his smile.

<You may be right, Diona. His Consummate Boundaries are hidden as we can assume he had as many as us, and he must have been bathed in Aeonic Treasures of Extremity within the first few seconds of being born and infused with them for the next decades...haha, we've actually come across one of the Engineered Entities!>
More and more assumptions were made as Noah's sharp eyes took in all of this information and expanded what he already knew.

He gave the enemies the time to freely give him more information while his transformation also finished, where he allowed them to continue making wrongful assumptions about him as much as they wanted!
A genius affiliated with the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra?
Akin to the fostered monsters from the Vicissitude Extremity Grotto?
Engineered Entity?
He was already wrongfully placed into so many destinations when all he was...was someone with Infinite Mana that continued to utterly break the laws of Reality!

<But...even if he is a being engineered since birth to speedily advance towards Extremity, I am turning 900 in a few days as our age discrepancy is not that large. I am curious what such a being will be able to show me as even with all this...my Destiny still thinks that he is not complete.>
WAA!
The silver gold glow around Titus became even more intense.
Those around him shook their heads while sighing and becoming serious, Diona pursing her lips as she radiated multiple Boundaries at the Consummate level.

<We'll have to finish this once we start it, and we also can't allow it to delay our search for the Extremity Panaceas. Those similar to us from other participating Havens are not too far off from our position.>
<Mmm...> Titus nodded as liquid silver and gold began to drip around his body, focusing strictly on Noah as he voiced out with a smile.

<Pretty boy, you ready? I want to see what mysteries the Haven Seeing Mirror couldn't unveil from you. I haven't yet met someone younger than me exhibit power at this level apart from those ridiculous beings from Extremity Lineages...and they have Extremity quite literally coursing in their veins. What will you show me?>
Terrifying waves of Haki and battle intent spread out.
Noah's visage in the skies was unfazed as he spoke lightly towards Ophelia.
<Will you be okay? I'll take on as many of them as possible.>
<Mmm...> Ophelia nodded with a serious gaze as she continued. <My Aeonic Soul Clone shall not perish here today.>
WAA!
Their Aeonic Soul Values rose to unprecedented levels.I think you should take a look at
The beings before them posed terrifying power as they knew their current selves weren't their match!
But she was Ophelia, the one who deeply understood Wisdom.
And he...was the True Emperor of Quintessence. Battles were his Forte. Battles were where he thrived.
So long as he could overcome his enemies in battle, he would come out many times stronger than before.
Haven Disciples?
The Genesis Institute of Extremity?
Their distinction and standing didn't matter so long as at the end of it all, he triumphed over them and turned them into Loot.
BZZZT!
His newly risen Consummate Boundaries pulsed as they roared out to be released, the many tools under his belt ready to unleash their glory!
His soul...his soul that had undergone so many transformations was entirely different from what any soul should be.

The recent one of the changes brought about through the Entropic Entity of Extremity caused him to feel the Sources of Chaos from afar as even though the Haki and radiance released from Titus had pushed away the raging tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY, his body attracted new tendrils freely as just his existence in this space...increased the disorder and chaos.
Streaks of silver and red emerged from all directions and surged towards Noah as the smile on Titus expanded even more, his body instantly disappearing a moment later!

As for the 11 Haven Disciples behind him, they also turned into points of light that instantly disappeared as their speed was something that only Unequaled Reverend Emperors could even have a chance of releasing!
Unequaled.
Reverends who had no enemies apart from those at the same stage, and those above them who were Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

These were the beings they became entangled with as facing such a situation, a catastrophic amount of cerulean singularities the size of atoms blossomed from Noah to cause his surroundings to turn into a hellish torrential flame storm, tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY reforming as he released area of effect attacks to keep the coming enemies at bay.
Ophelia instantly released her Planar Domain as a golden light covered her body, Words of Wisdom spewing out freely!
While the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar...
<I have no time for this foolishness!>
BOOM!
His figure bellowed out with utter rage as he was on a race against time, and these beings actually dared to stand in his way!
So what if they were from one of the older Havens?
What if they were on the same stage of power as him?!
He just had to erase them like all those that confronted before him in the past, and he would be ever closer to achieving what he wanted.

So he turned into a shining cluster of terrifying Quasars that seemed akin to trillions of black suns that could each burn weaker Reverends, the gravitational temperature he released being something that nobody could freely even come close to!
With such an surge of power, the eyes of the Mad Reverend Emperor entirely disappeared as when he thought about his dying daughter, he bellowed out fearlessly.
<LET'S GO!>
BOOOM!

Radiant golden and silver wings blossomed on the 11 other beings as one of the most dazzling women in the silver gold crystalline armament squinted her eyes while reading out what was on the Apex Aeonic Relic.
<Osmont, with an Aeonic Soul Age of less than 100 Years.
And Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power...unable to be defined at this moment.
Titus, this is likely a genius affiliated with the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra for him to be able to mask even his Quantitative Aeonic Soul Power against the Haven Seeing Mirror.
He may be similar to those fostered monsters from the Vicissitude Extremity Grotto with mutated souls for him to be this young...>
WAA!
The Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity gazed towards Noah as if they were seeing an equal for the first time, many assumptions being made by them as Titus didn't lose his smile.
<You may be right, Diona.

His Consummate Boundaries are hidden as we can assume he had as many as us, and he must have been bathed in Aeonic Treasures of Extremity within the first few seconds of being born and infused with them for the next decades...haha, we've actually come across one of the Engineered Entities!>
More and more assumptions were made as Noah's sharp eyes took in all of this information and expanded what he already knew.

He gave the enemies the time to freely give him more information while his transformation also finished, where he allowed them to continue making wrongful assumptions about him as much as they wanted!
A genius affiliated with the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra?
Akin to the fostered monsters from the Vicissitude Extremity Grotto?
Engineered Entity?
He was already wrongfully placed into so many destinations when all he was...was someone with Infinite Mana that continued to utterly break the laws of Reality!
<But...even if he is a being engineered since birth to speedily advance towards Extremity, I am turning 900 in a few days as our age discrepancy is not that large.
I am curious what such a being will be able to show me as even with all this...my Destiny still thinks that he is not complete.>
WAA!
The silver gold glow around Titus became even more intense.
Those around him shook their heads while sighing and becoming serious, Diona pursing her lips as she radiated multiple Boundaries at the Consummate level.
<We'll have to finish this once we start it, and we also can't allow it to delay our search for the Extremity Panaceas.
Those similar to us from other participating Havens are not too far off from our position.>
<Mmm...> Titus nodded as liquid silver and gold began to drip around his body, focusing strictly on Noah as he voiced out with a smile.
<Pretty boy, you ready?
I want to see what mysteries the Haven Seeing Mirror couldn't unveil from you.
I haven't yet met someone younger than me exhibit power at this level apart from those ridiculous beings from Extremity Lineages...and they have Extremity quite literally coursing in their veins.
What will you show me?>
Terrifying waves of Haki and battle intent spread out.
Noah's visage in the skies was unfazed as he spoke lightly towards Ophelia.
<Will you be okay?
I'll take on as many of them as possible.>
<Mmm...> Ophelia nodded with a serious gaze as she continued.
<My Aeonic Soul Clone shall not perish here today.>
WAA!
Their Aeonic Soul Values rose to unprecedented levels.I think you should take a look at
The beings before them posed terrifying power as they knew their current selves weren't their match!
But she was Ophelia, the one who deeply understood Wisdom.
And he...was the True Emperor of Quintessence.
Battles were his Forte.
Battles were where he thrived.
So long as he could overcome his enemies in battle, he would come out many times stronger than before.
Haven Disciples?
The Genesis Institute of Extremity?
Their distinction and standing didn't matter so long as at the end of it all, he triumphed over them and turned them into Loot.
BZZZT!
His newly risen Consummate Boundaries pulsed as they roared out to be released, the many tools under his belt ready to unleash their glory!
His soul...his soul that had undergone so many transformations was entirely different from what any soul should be.

The recent one of the changes brought about through the Entropic Entity of Extremity caused him to feel the Sources of Chaos from afar as even though the Haki and radiance released from Titus had pushed away the raging tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY, his body attracted new tendrils freely as just his existence in this space...increased the disorder and chaos.
Streaks of silver and red emerged from all directions and surged towards Noah as the smile on Titus expanded even more, his body instantly disappearing a moment later!

As for the 11 Haven Disciples behind him, they also turned into points of light that instantly disappeared as their speed was something that only Unequaled Reverend Emperors could even have a chance of releasing!
Unequaled.
Reverends who had no enemies apart from those at the same stage, and those above them who were Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

These were the beings they became entangled with as facing such a situation, a catastrophic amount of cerulean singularities the size of atoms blossomed from Noah to cause his surroundings to turn into a hellish torrential flame storm, tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY reforming as he released area of effect attacks to keep the coming enemies at bay.
Ophelia instantly released her Planar Domain as a golden light covered her body, Words of Wisdom spewing out freely!
While the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar...
<I have no time for this foolishness!>
BOOM!
His figure bellowed out with utter rage as he was on a race against time, and these beings actually dared to stand in his way!
So what if they were from one of the older Havens?
What if they were on the same stage of power as him?!
He just had to erase them like all those that confronted before him in the past, and he would be ever closer to achieving what he wanted.

So he turned into a shining cluster of terrifying Quasars that seemed akin to trillions of black suns that could each burn weaker Reverends, the gravitational temperature he released being something that nobody could freely even come close to!
With such an surge of power, the eyes of the Mad Reverend Emperor entirely disappeared as when he thought about his dying daughter, he bellowed out fearlessly.
<LET'S GO!>
BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2344 Catastrophic! III
paragraphs: Catastrophic eruptions bloomed all around as the figures that had disappeared in the skies reached their targets horrifically quickly.
The visage of Titus shockingly cut through the blue, red, and silver flames of Entropy as his fair hand sparkled with silver and gold radiance while it led the way- untouched!
All the essence seemed to be contained within his very skin as it shone with crystalline grandeur.
<My body is my greatest weapon.>
BOOM!
A devilish smile was ever present on his face as he bypassed all the flames and began to crush the boundless auras and barriers around Noah's body.

His body took on a unique stance amidst his advance as his right hand swung down like a primordial hammer, the very fabric of Reality in the surroundings vibrating as a phantom of a catastrophically titanic hand briefly bloomed in the skies and joined Titus in this single move- that shattered all remaining barriers and ever-rising flames of Entropy around Noah, reaching his body right away!
The light of multiple Consummate Boundaries shone on the fist of Titus as at this moment, the light of Noah's Consummate Boundaries also covered his body as the strike arrived!
...BOOOM!
The impact was dreadful as Noah felt like he was hit by the weight of a dozen Planes of Existence at the same time.

The hardness of his Body and his Foundation wasn't for show as paired up with his ever increasing Aeonic Defense Values, and the fact that he had released waves of attacks and barriers to reduce the terror of this attack...it all culminated into the shocking reality of him being capable of taking the strike of an Unequaled Reverend Emperor without his very skin ripping apart!
BZZZT!
The authority of multiple Consummate Boundaries surged as with this impact, Noah's figure was the one to be blasted down towards the stellar black earth as the strike was simply too heavy!
And at such a juncture, Titus continued to speak.
<With a wave of my hand, Realities collapse.>
His body once more took on a unique stance as if he was following the movement arts lost through the Aeons of Extremity!
<With a single punch, Planes of Existence shatter.>
<This...is power. These...are the Extremity Martial Arts of Genesis.>
BOOM!
His momentum was relentless and utterly dominating as his hands repetitively punched out with shocking grace and power, his voice ringing out along with it!
<Genesis Wing Chun's Third Style>.

His hands formed fists at some points and released palms on other instances, but the result was the conjuration of all the strikes he had made into massive silver gold phantoms of palms and punches that covered all of Noah's vision!
Each one was utterly catastrophic as it was equivalent to a full strike of an Unequaled Reverend Emperor!
Yet even while facing such a horror-inducing sense of power, Noah's expression retained its majesty as his body exploded with concentrated Aeonic Mana of Extremity.
He could conjure any myriad of skills as he wished.

This time, he released thousands of severing rays of light that were composed of spinning singularities of blitzkriegs, tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY wrapping around them in a show of beautiful chaos and destruction as the moment they left his body, thousands more of such rays were released again...and again, and again! I think you should take a look at
As if...he was a conduit releasing countless and endless rays of severing light.

Each one with the effect of chaining between enemies as with the gradual increase in the authority of his Boundaries, Noah knew he would be capable of replicating the same reality altering effects of his most ridiculous skills on the scale of Extremity.

He could only achieve the chaining effect currently on the scale of Aeonic Soul Damage Values, but more would come in the future as for now...these endless rays of cerulean, crimson, and silver colored singularities were set by Noah to be released from his body endlessly without stopping!
The targeted enemies were selected as from his body, Aeonic Mana of Extremity surged out endlessly.
He targeted all enemies because while Titus threw down the terrifying strike above him, the aura of 5 more Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity surged towards him from the sides!
2 Haven Disciples swung like deadly blades towards Ophelia, and 4 of the Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity surged towards the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar!
His Severing Rays endlessly barreled towards all of them as against the dominant attack released above...
'Genesis Wing Chun's Third Style, yes?' Noah gazed at the unique method of attacks as his skin bloomed to take on a cerulean hue.

The Arcane Planar Domain of Mana was activated as he glowed with an utter blue radiance, his body instantly taking on the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form as he expanded in size and became utterly glorious!

Seeing the cascading phantoms of hands barreling down, he actually reached up towards them and embraced their might as he wanted to absorb the essence of everything contained in this attack and redirect it elsewhere!
BOOOM!

The endless rays of severing light releasing from him became even more resplendent as along with this, the Planar Domains of Quintessence, Loot, Blood, Entropy...and the rest of his Boundaries that had exceeded the 6th Boundary Layer all erupted with fervor and at no cost.
Manadynamics deemed it so!

The explosion of all of these domains paired with the core that Noah had absorbed from the deadly attack of Titus was a trajectory laid out by Providence as the next step was to release it all and focus in towards one area where 2 Haven Disciples were!
If he could take down just a few, taking the rest of them out would be infinitely easier for him!

Yet the moment he took the next step and absorbed all of the damage values from Titus to convert it into chaotic forms of energy that were released towards two Haven Disciples as shown by Providence...
SHAA!

The figure of Titus materialized on this same trajectory as he stood together with the two Haven Disciples, their bodies glowing with bastions of silver gold light as Titus's smile became ever brighter!
<Haha, you're even more interesting....[Genesis Kenpo's First Style-Fortress]!>

The hands of all three Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity moved on the same trajectory as their palms connected in front of their chests, a fantastical silver gold shield of light blooming around each of them as they even resonated to join together and rebuff Noah's oncoming redirected attack, and his eruption of the output of all his instantly released Planar Domains!
The impact destroyed all sound, raging winds of Extremity being thrown about as when the scene cleared, the forms of all three Haven Disciples were unscathed, Titus included.
Their gazes had only become more serious.
While Titus...seemed to be enjoying himself even more!
He saw the Endless rays of severing light flowing from Noah's stellar sky-blue countenance still as he rushed towards it freely, his body blazing with even greater concentrations of Haki!

chapters.title: Chapter 2345 Unbound! I
paragraphs: Within a communication channel ingrained in the Aeonic Souls of the Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.

<Don't be caught off guard. He can absorb attacks to a certain extent and redirect them...you two would have just received something equivalent to my attack in addition to his own just now. Don't slip up!>

The voice of Titus spread to all those present under his group, excluding the other channels of communication of the few other groups of Haven Disciples spread out in different regions of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

His interest in this Entity before him increased more and more as when he tried to peer deeper into him with the Haven Seeing Mirror or even his own Destiny, a lot of the things he would see in others were veiled!

This meant that either this being had a truly powerful Boundary along the same lines as his Boundary of Destiny that had ridiculous masking capabilities, or he had made great accomplishments in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity with a unique soul.
'A Unique Soul...'
Titus smiled when this thought crossed his mind.
As he identified the many oddities around this being, he couldn't help but think in this direction as he recalled stories he had heard of from his teachers.

As he surged towards this being who released dazzling rays of volatile chaotic energies filled with the essence of multiple Consummate Boundaries as if his Aeonic Soul Values weren't being drained constantly because of it, Titus thought of the experiences of his Teachers who had come across beings who had undergone mutations along the pressure of Extremity- beings who then mutated to develop unique traits that distinguished them above others!
More often than not, some had Mutated Souls, while others had Mutated Origins, or Mutated Bodies out of other beings' wildest imagination.
When his teachers came across such beings and overcame them in the past...they were able to obtain the unique traits that made these existences so special!

One of his Teachers that was a step away from Extremity at this very moment had overcome an Entity with a mutated Aspect of Existence in the past that could devour and assimilate everything about their enemy and reproduce it for themselves without fail- and his Teacher had gained this unique mutation for himself after this being was defeated!

From his Teacher's experiences, there were also instances of the appearance of other Mutated Entities who turned all enemies they defeated into Legions of deathly shadows that did their bidding, Entities who were so technologically advanced they could calculate and foresee paths billions of years into the future, Entities who had been existences that reached Extremity trillions of years ago and had faced True Death...and yet they were reborn eons later!
Such Entities existed.
They were unique and powerful as if one wasn't careful, they may even fall to their sheer power.
There were even renowned Mutated Entities who were important personages across the Vaults of Extremity to this day!
'So...who are you?'
WAA!

Which faction was cultivating this Mutated Entity? With his Genesis Institute of Extremity, he didn't have to be wary of too many factions apart from the truly horrific and ancient ones- and those factions wouldn't send their prodigies into an excursion like the Initiation of the Extremity Vein of the Youngest Haven.
Their history was too deep, and they were among the first to scour the Oldest Havens of Extremity and obtain unimaginable boons.

Another indication that made Titus fearless and to count the faction this Osmont belonged to as something either at the same level as his Genesis Institute of Extremity or below...was the level of power this being displayed!
If he was truly from one of those ancient terrifying factions, their means were immeasurable as Titus would long be dead at this moment.
So he made a move.
He wanted to see if he could actually catch a mutated Entity in its infancy as there were many things about it that Titus was inquisitive about!

And at this moment, none were more pressing than the fact that this being endlessly released rays of light that attacked all of them here senselessly, and it didn't look like he was stopping anytime soon.
'Is it actually a Mutated Origin with a ridiculous resource usage? Haha, let's see!'I think you should take a look at
He became even more excited as he pulled from the Extremity Martial Arts of Genesis to unveil everything this Entity hid!
He was at the very center of it all.

Endless rays of severing light constantly unleashed from him as they smashed towards his enemies and were bounced away by silver gold barriers of light, but they instantly chained towards nearby Haven Disciples constantly as it was a never ending bombardment!

It kept the Haven Disciples targeting Ophelia somewhat occupied and allowed her some breathing room as she was much too weak for them, and it even aided the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar as he raged and turned into trillions of burning Quasars!
Yet even with all this, the strongest being here was undaunted.

Titus continued his relentless advancement as to Noah's surprise, even though he absorbed all the Damage Values from his enemy's attack while in his Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity state, he inexplicably felt nearly 25% of his Aeonic Vitality Values sapped away!
It showed that this was one of the few extremely powerful enemies Noah had faced in recent times as he held means that could also heavily bend reality itself.

Facing such an enemy caused Noah's tyranny and Quintessence to burn brightly as it embraced the challenge, seeking to overcome it and come out even stronger as at this moment...any sense of shackles were released from him.
'Alright...let's get wild.'
WAA!
Such a thought blossomed as countless thoughts crossed Noah's mind, and after he validated them with Providence...he proceeded forward with a plan!

He had a predetermined number of Boundaries he could deem Quintessential as when he did so and simply brought them to the 6th Boundary Layer, they would then be propelled to the 9th Boundary Layer by Quintessence.
He had conserved the last 2 slots of RUIN and NULLITY.
But from taking down the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen, he gained the Sources of 4 Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity!
It meant 4 chances to bring four concepts to the 9th Boundary Layer.
And as he felt the fading life force even after absorbing the ridiculous Damage Values from Reverend Emperor Titus...
'Bring Prana to the 9th Boundary Layer.'
HOONG!
'Bring Dream to the 9th Boundary Layer.'
The Sources that were already absorbed into his Body sunk into specific parts of his Soul and wrapped around the past Decreta of Prana and Dreams!
And...
BOOOM!
An astonishing amount of life force exploded within him as a verdant gold light shot up like an aurora of grandiosity to the colorful skies!

chapters.title: Chapter 2346 Unbound! II
paragraphs: An overabundance of life-force raged from his body akin to an erupting volcano!
And within his soul, a dreamy golden light permeated all around as it sought to turn dreams into a very real reality.

Events were still unfolding for Noah's True Sanguine Clone, but in Noah's eyes that reflected an aurora of colors in the depths of the Infinite Plane...time nearly came to a stop as dazzling prompts bloomed before his eyes.
<Your Dimensional Realities quintessentially resonate with the Sources of Prana and Dreams that have been greatly elevated towards Extremity.>
<The 9 Dimensional Realities in the Infinite Plane quintessentially resonate with the Sources of Prana and Dreams that have been greatly elevated towards Extremity.>
<A quintessential expansion of the Infinite Plane is beginning under the basis of Extremity.>
<A quintessential Expansion and Strengthening of your First Plane of Extremity has begun as your Dimensional Realities resonate with the expanded Sources of Decreta!>
<Your First Plane of Extremity is surging towards completion!>
An unexpected change began in both his very own Origin and the Infinite Plane itself.

The Infinite Plane was already steadily advancing towards an entirely new construct due to its Natural Laws that bound it beginning their expansion to Extremity, the vast stretches of reality and Domains within it entirely different now from how they were just a day ago.
Now, the 9 connected Minor Planes within it and their Decreta that defined them...also rose up towards a phenomenal change!
What would happen when the authority of Dreams to make the impossible possible greatly rose to the upper boundaries of Extremity?
What would happen to Prana? Apollyon?!
His First Plane of Extremity was experiencing the greatest change in all this as he felt like his Aspects of Existence were being smelted by celestial fires and constantly reborn into a greater form.

First, it was the Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas from the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans that propagated the expansion of his Origin along with the Sources of Extremity he continued to anchor onto it.
Now, his expanded Sources of Extremity relating to Decreta kicked this into high gear as everything was rapidly propelled forward!
The matches that lit everything up was the advancement of Prana and Dreams to the 9th Boundary Layers!
The life force that Titus had inexplicably taken was entirely replaced as the blood and amount of life within Noah exploded to become many times what it was before.
His Aspects of Existence and constantly surging essence became even more refined as the authority of Dreams squeezed itself into everything to help him achieve his wildest dreams!
And even here, he wasn't done.
'Bring...Apollyon to the 9th Boundary Layer.'
WAA! I think you should take a look at
A Dimension that had a profound Source of Chaos.

Since Noah thrived on chaos and became ever stronger through it, he released Apollyon even before Ruin and Nullity were ready as a molten crimson light boomed from his chest and tainted the Endless severing rays with a cataclysmic color!
Boundless strength coursed through him as he knew he exceeded Peak Reverend Emperors.

He wondered how far on the designation of Unequaled Reverend Emperors he had come as when he stared at the confident demeanor of the enemy coming towards him and the fancy moves he made, Noah's tyrannical will blazed as he wanted to establish Quintessence!
With an overabundance of life force coursing through his veins as information on the Boundary Layers Prana, Dreams, and Apollyon flowing into his mind, he spoke out calmly.
<Plane of Dreams>.
<Plane of Prana>.
<Plane of Apollyon>!
HOONG!
It felt like he was pulling out the very Dimensional Realities within his Origin.
As if he was taking their grand power and imposing it on the outside world!

In the silver gold skies that were altered with the dominant Haki released by Titus and the other Haven Disciples, boundless stellar verdant vegetation flowered as trees that would put Yggdrasil to shame erupted out- an ancient forest blooming into existence as thick crystalline green vines sprouted and arched across the skies like snakes seeking to impose their Dominion.

Within this verdant eruption of light, dazzling green Cosmos could also be seen forming as they buzzed with both life and death- these Cosmos carrying a terrifying gravitational force as they carried a terrifying capability that had to be observed with the description of the Plane of Prana to fully appreciate its glory!

<The Sixth Boundary Layer of Prana>:: A Boundary that grants you the authority to call out the Plane of Prana and impose its dominion in the outside reality. As it is a Manifestation of your Prana Dimensional Reality, it comes at no cost to call out as once active, the Plane of Prana constantly releases a light of Aeonic Vitality Regeneration that rejuvenates 85% of your total Aeonic Vitality Values every nanosecond. In addition to this, Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos manifest from the domain and thunder down towards you and your enemies. When smashing onto your enemies, they deal 2x your Maximum Aeonic Soul Damage Values as they specialize in sapping away the life force of intended targets, while you and your allies will experience a revitalization of 85% of your total Aeonic Vitality Values on every hit...
An astonishing Planar Domain.

It caused for the flourishing of Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos as if they were verdant suns of life and death, streaming towards the Haven Disciples as they further added to the things they had to defend against while when such a cataclysmic Cosmos smashed onto Ophelia...
<Ahh!>
Her body released even greater bursts of power and vibrancy as immense life force flood-like raged in the surroundings!

Wisdom turned into words and commands that charged towards the 2 Haven Disciples trying to get close to her while also dealing with the many sources of attacks in the surroundings, their expressions currently full of frustration as traces of surprise were beginning to rise.

When the Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos smashed towards The Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar, his Soul was extremely tuned as it didn't feel a sense of danger from them, allowing the Cosmos to hit him as they broke apart like eggshells on the exterior of trillions of Quasars that made his body, and the injuries he had sustained in the brief nanoseconds this battle began were all erased as he bellowed out while releasing even more terrifying waves of gravity and temperatures!

chapters.title: Chapter 2347 Unbound! III
paragraphs: Only the effects of the Plane of Prana were displayed so far as this alone caused the pace of the battle to rise up another octave, but this was only a single Plane.
Noah...had called out two others.

On the black earth below his feet, the Plane of Dreams and Plane of Apollyon were displayed at the same time as the earth cracked and splintered to reveal golden sand and Crimson black tendrils of lava seeping out chaotically.

All of the stellar black earth trembled and vibrated as it cracked apart, a plane of Dreams and Apollyon coming to be as it seemed like golden sandy dunes were rising along with crimson black volcanoes shooting out pillars of crimson destruction to the skies!
The scene...was utterly breathtaking as all souls here had to stop briefly to appreciate its wonders.

Ophelia felt as if the back of the being who supported her was immensely vast as when her will observed the pure fantasy playing out, all she saw was the form of an Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity with ever increasing pairs of auroras of cerulean wings behind it, muscular stellar blue limbs and a magnificent body with a face that only showed radiantly shining singularities for eyes!

No nose or mouth were present as this face still carried exceeding stellar beauty, the gorgeous verdant domain above, and the gold and Crimson domains below erupting with him at the center as each one was more beautiful than the last.

From the sandy golden dunes and rising molten mountains of destruction, halcyon and red Cosmos formed and spun out with shocking trajectory as they filled the battlefield similar to the raining Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos, their radiance and usage just as fantastical as they represented Noah truly going wild on this day!

<The Sixth Boundary Layer of Dreams>:: A Boundary that grants you the authority to call out the Plane of Dreams and impose its dominion in the outside reality. As it is a Manifestation of your Dream Dimensional Reality, it comes at no cost to call out as once active, the Plane of Dreams will radiate a Quintessential Aeonic Dream Authority that augments all of your actions and thoughts towards the smoother alteration of reality, turning what you dream of into a more solid form. Its boons are hard to quantify in a numerical value as greater manipulation of reality with the Quintessential Aeonic Dream Authority must be experienced in order to be understood. In addition to this, Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Dream Cosmos manifest from the domain and thunder down towards you and your enemies. When smashing into your enemies, they obstruct and restrict their ability to alter reality, causing for the activation of their skills, usage of their resources, and other means of reality alterations to fail. When your allies are hit with the Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Dream Cosmos, they will gain a nanosecond multiplier of 1,000% to All Aeonic Parameter Values...

<The Sixth Boundary Layer of Apollyon>:: A Boundary that grants you the authority to call out the Plane of Apollyon...it comes at no cost to call out as once active, the Plane of Apollyon increases the Sources of Chaos in the surroundings and enhances their effect. Once enough Sources of Chaos are concentrated in the surroundings, the Plane of Apollyon will begin calling down Aeonic Apocalypses of Extremity as they draw upon possible Unrecorded and Recorded Apocalypses of Extremity in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to be displayed onto the Reality around you. Through your authority, only those in the surroundings selected as targets will undergo initiated Aeonic Apocalypses of Extremity that are carried out with 3x your Maximum Aeonic Soul Damage Values...
Madness.
This was the advent of what Noah called forth as it was more than just going wild!
The Plane of Prana was drastic enough, but the Plane of Dreams came with its own abstruse uses while the Plane of Apollyon...
BOOOM!

It caused for the eruption and resumption of the tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN that were in the surroundings as they came back with ten times the concentration, the Crimson pillars of Apollyon rising to the skies pulling on the thick tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN as they were all converged towards a single location in the skies.I think you should take a look at
A location that blazed with deadly entropic chaos of boundless grandeur as a nanosecond after the Sources of Chaos were gathered, a ringing of an extremely ancient bell resounded out.
A bell that caused the raging figure of Titus to gaze up in surprise briefly as Noah...received a fantastical prompt!
<The Recorded Apocalypse of Extremity- Ruin's End, has been initiated.>
CRACK!

From the gathering of the Sources of Chaos, the skies cracked with this area at the very center as from it, deep liquefied waves of crimson Ruin seeped out endlessly as they boasted horrifying Damage Values of an Unequaled Reverend Emperor.

Along with these liquefied waves of Ruin, roars rang out as from the cracked skies, the seas of Ruin joined together and also formed cataclysmic Terrors of the wildest chthonian dreams, these amalgamation rushing out with purpose towards all the Haven Disciples here as it was like an endless sea of Ruin was released on top of them!

All of this...in addition to the Endless severing rays of light that Noah released, in addition to the Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Cosmos that smashed around, and in addition to Noah's multiple other Planes already released and carrying out their own forms of attacks!
It was simply...dreadful.
And it was such concentrated Layers and layers of attacks and power that the eyes of the Haven Disciples...finally turned grim.
They couldn't ignore the attacks freely or block them as freely as they were doing before.

They became overwhelmed in all directions with just too many sources of attacks that they were now being forced to concentrate on defending...otherwise wounds would begin to appear on their flawless bodies as well!
It was an incredible development of events that when Titus looked at all this and the environment that were splitting apart as if Apocalypse had arrived...
<Haha...you're one crazy fucker, Osmont! What the hell is all this!>
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2348 On Another Level! I
paragraphs: The very layout of reality was changed by him!

The skies rained down verdant Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos as it looked like a starry field of green forest, while the earth below was tinged crimson and gold as sand dunes and mountains of lava that also constantly spat out terrifying Cosmos could be seen.
In the nexus of the skies, a singularity had caused everything to fracture as a Recorded Apocalypse of Extremity- Ruin's End, erupted out with glee!
All of these drastic changes to reality...were things that even after minutes, hours, or even years passed- their traces would be etched onto this space and remain for billions of years to follow.
For the mark of the being that called them out to stretch across history!
And at the center of it all was an existence taking on the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form as he released rays of boundless light.
WAA!
Titus bellowed out with ever luminescent eyes while at the same time, his hands unfurled to release something.

Utterly terrifying words that even caused his allies to be shocked left this being as amalgamations of terrors formed from an endless sea of RUIN crashed towards him, along with severing rays of light and Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Cosmos seeking his end!
Yet his body became covered by a gorgeous and impenetrable silver gold glow as the object he released from his hands...was a radiant stellar feather.
A feather!
Yet its appearance caused a dreadful sense of oppression to appear in this space as this single feather...was not of the same form of life as them.
The feather flashed.
The Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar roared out as an unprecedented feeling of danger descended, something being shattered and unleashed in his soul as a cosmic glow descended unto him.

At the center of it all, Noah's soul clearly felt the utterly dreadful feeling as his stellar eyes of singularities were concentrated with even more disorder and chaos, a trace of anger rising within them at this moment as he actually turned towards another direction entirely!

It was...towards the Aeonic Soul Clone of Ophelia that also seemed to sense something profound at this moment, a light sigh escaping her lips as when Noah turned towards her and locked eyes with her gaze, she spoke out with a tinge of guilt.
'I'm sorry.'I think you should take a look at
This was the last thought to flash as an instant later, the radiance of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem erupted.
It erupted and covered everything entirely!
CAAA!

A celestial bird's cry reverberated out that carried sound waves that would normally shatter the souls of even Peak Reverend Emperors, followed by the appearance of corporeal silver gold claws that emanated grandeur far exceeding the 9th Boundary Layer.

These silver gold claws instantly manifested across this whole space as they tore down everything they came across, seeming like starry points of sharp light that tore apart any barrier they came across.

A few appeared near the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar as he bellowed out while parts of his body were torn apart- his Soul receiving heavy Damage at the same time as immense gravitational waves were erupting from him to keep everything else at bay!

Even fewer streaks of these deadly claws appeared beside the figure of Ophelia as the endless glow of golden Wisdom covering her body...was torn apart as if it didn't exist, the light of the dreadful Apex Aeonic Soul Totem entering her soul and very quickly causing everything to dim.
Wisdom had told her that her Aeonic Soul Clone would not die here today.
But when it came to a power exceeding it...it wasn't even able to see as in this case, Wisdom turned out to be wrong.

A power outside the boundary of a lifeform like her descended as even though it wasn't the full attack that an Apex Aeonic Lifeform could release, it was an attack that infinitely neared this power as its true terror wasn't in any numerical sense in terms of damage values.
Its true terror was that it contained traces of power from an entirely advanced lifeform!
The attack entirely destroyed the gorgeous countenance of Ophelia as after her defenses were bypassed, her radiant figure was instantly turned into ash as her Aeonic Soul Clone perished.
Destiny could be wrong. Wisdom could be wrong. When it came down to it, extreme Power was the only decider of a path!

A bellow of rage erupted out from the being that all the silver gold claws were actually targeting at the very center of, his countenance shown with dozens of overlapping Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana and Dreams Cosmos were ready to unfurl at a moment's notice- even greater authority being pulled upon as the 9th Boundary Layer of Prana and Dreams were activated!

From Noah's body, what seemed like two genuine lights of Minor Planes of Existence flashed to surround him as he withstood an attack that even his Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form could not entirely negate- an overabundance of life force and dream authority surrounding him he sought to bring existence to his whims and overcome this!

The Recorded Apocalypse of Extremity, Ruin's End, converged towards him. His manifested Planes and now what seemed like palpable and genuine Minor Planes of Existence erupted from his massive body as glorious Quintessence shone from all around, Noah intending to match an unstoppable enemy who showed how different the creatures within the Vaults of Extremity were!

When it came down to it, extreme Power was the only decider of a path!

A bellow of rage erupted out from the being that all the silver gold claws were actually targeting at the very center of, his countenance shown with dozens of overlapping Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana and Dreams Cosmos were ready to unfurl at a moment's notice- even greater authority being pulled upon as the 9th Boundary Layer of Prana and Dreams were activated!

From Noah's body, what seemed like two genuine lights of Minor Planes of Existence flashed to surround him as he withstood an attack that even his Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form could not entirely negate- an overabundance of life force and dream authority surrounding him he sought to bring existence to his whims and overcome this!
The Recorded Apocalypse of Extremity, Ruin's End, converged towards him.

His manifested Planes and now what seemed like palpable and genuine Minor Planes of Existence erupted from his massive body as glorious Quintessence shone from all around, Noah intending to match an unstoppable enemy who showed how different the creatures within the Vaults of Extremity were!

He says->BZZZT! His visage was turning towards Noah seated on the throne as he spoke, but his words couldn't continue coming out as immense terror and fear gripped him and many others here in the next second! It was because in this calm environment, a progression of unbelievable events bloomed for those perceptive.First was the figure of Ophelia beside the golden throne that Noah sat on having a look of worry appear on her expression an instant before, this look changing into shock a moment later and acceptance as next, her light brown face became extremely pale as she fell to her knees while spitting out blood! But this wasn't all.Noah's figure on the golden throne released a bellow as he instantly adopted the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form, the Planes of Dream and Prana also being called out around this clone as horrifically, on the space above Ophelia...silver gold claws carrying the authority of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform shot out and cascaded towards her main body! This...was the power of an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem.The power of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! It didn't matter whether it was one's Clone or main body- when the soul signature of a being was targeted and deemed for death, it would seek the very source of this being.The attack from the deeper areas of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands actually crossed an unknown distance to appear in the Abecedarian Sacrarium, Noah stepping between it and Ophelia's main body as he took the last vestiges of the silver gold claws into his Body that was wrapped by dozens of Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana and Dream Cosmos! BOOOM! The attack was devastating as behind Noah wasn't just Ophelia, but the clones of Adelaide, Anna, and many others who didn't leave with his son towards the Lands of Noblesse.Noah stepped in front of them to take on the last vestiges of this deadly attack as it was much easier to handle than what his True Sanguine Clone currently faced in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, the usage of multiple methods wrapping up the horrific damage and sense of oppression that this attack released as Noah contained it all.WAA! The skies closed back up as raging waves of Entropy surged, the impact contained- but the effect of what had just occurred was fresh in the minds of all beings! The True Emperor of Light and the other Elder Ancestors standing before Noah had fallen to their knees due to the sheer pressure of this attack as Light was one of the two Reverends here.And even he...felt a surge of terror at the attack that came through as he recognized it to be something carrying traces of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! Yet...this True Emperor of Quintessence had actually withstood it? Seeing the glorious cerulean form of the existence that was gradually fading as soon as the deadly attack was dispersed, Light and the other Elder Ancestors couldn't get their minds to wrap around the fact that this being truly was their Descendant.He instead seemed like one of the Mysterious Entities they only heard of with caution and fear! Light felt as if his mouth was extremely dry as he tried to open up his mouth and speak again- because the message he had was also something he considered of utmost importance.<This...one of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from our Lineage is seeking-><He can wait.> Noah's resonant voice boomed out as one could feel the anger within it.The True Emperor of Light felt his soul tremble as he realized that even when he thought he had overestimated the might of this Last True Emperor of their Barren Lands, he had still been too far off as his voice alone made him feel like he was talking to the respected personages that were entirely different Lifeforms! Noah ignored the Elder Ancestors as after he looked at Adelaide and the others to confirm they were okay, he bent down to the figure of Ophelia that was shivering on the dreamy golden sands as he cradled her into his arms.She had suffered a heavy injury to her soul with the death of an Aeonic Soul Clone, her radiant light brown skin tinged red at this moment as Noah only felt his anger riding when seeing her in this state! The type of power to have put her in this state was all the more dreadful as it stemmed from an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem, with her soul and Origin currently being unstable as a surging light spread out from his body and covered her- their figures moving across space to a different location as multiple Panaceas were already flowing from Noah's Expansive Space to heal her- the light of Prana currently being infused fully into her as Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana Cosmos were constantly being released from Noah's hands and showering her body.In his mind, a great deal of computations were being carried out as while his Dream Dimensional Chassis took care of Ophelia, his True Sanguine Clone in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands had the ordeal of surviving the brunt and focused attack released by one of the more deadly enemies he had faced in recent times!—Across the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.In a domain far above an azure sky filled with the remnants of shattered Planes of Existence.<How exactly shall we navigate this? We received invitations from other factions in nearby Havens as among their boons, Consummate Boundaries are part of it. Now, we hear our Descendant actually has multiple.>The voice was deep and ancient.A voice filled with power and age as it rang out from a being shrouded by a violet light, his visage hidden as he talked towards another figure bathed in a golden radiance not too far away! The figure bathed in a golden radiance held a profound light of fortune as it was the True Emperor of Fortune- the one who had built the Golden Forge and left their History recorded in the vestiges of the Barren Lands.<You move as you wish. Up to this day, you don't seem to have realized that we each make our own fortune. I'm sure this True Emperor of Quintessence doesn't have any amicable feelings towards you lot anyways due to your ruthless actions...so what exactly will you even do?>The voice was calm and filled with a profound sense of laziness as the opposing Apex Aeonic Lifeform who had spoken first let out a snort.His violet haze shone with even grander radiance as he spoke out while gazing at the expanse of shattered Planes of Existence.<It is merely a Descendant. Even if it has to be by force...>...! His last words were left unsaid as from the True Emperor of Fortune, a light sigh of disappointment was the only thing that could be heard!

chapters.title: Chapter 2350 On Another Level! III
paragraphs: 2350 On Another Level! III
Within the enacted domains of the Noblesse.
Around the Styx Regality Plane.
<Lock down the surroundings! A thief has broken into the Spirit Hall!>

The booming voice of a Reverend Emperor bellowed out with utmost rage as a VOID spread out madly in the surroundings, the Wills of many Noblesse scouring all space within and nearby the Styx Regality Plane as the Obsidian rivers of stellar light surrounding it made the darkness all the more oppressive!
Finding a hidden Reverend in such a situation was going to be extremely difficult.
'But finding me? It will be impossible for you all.'

Moving across the crevices of space, a vibrant thought rang in the mind of Oppenheimer as he relied on his new vibrant eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to remain hidden from the scrutiny of the two Reverend Emperors left to defend the Styx Regality Plane and the Spirit Hall within it.
It made getting his portion of Aeonic Soul back unimaginably easy as the only thing was that its removal triggered the mechanisms of the Spirit Hall!
But Oppenheimer had already stepped out of the Styx Regality Plane as crossing the crevices of space, he knew he had all but escaped as he was already thinking of his next moves.
The remnants of the Barren Lands. The possible passage into other Havens...
Many possibilities swirled in his mind when all of a sudden...
DING!
His destiny released a sound of danger as if an attack was descending unto him at his very moment!
His expression changed as he prepared to defend, and it turned even more sour in the next instant as the 'attack' arrived!
From his hidden position in space...a blinding verdant gold light shot from him like a beacon of light that made his presence known to all.
It wasn't an attack. It was a marking! And one that was born from...
'Karma? A Karma of Death? Who the hell-'
BOOM!

<Surround him!> Before his thoughts could continue any further, the Wills of the Noblesse Reverend Emperors locked onto him and surged over as his slow escape plan was shredded to pieces, his eyes shining brightly as they released shocking radiance to fold space and have him leave this region even faster!

He moved in a straight line away from the Styx Regality Plane as an endless sea of the VOID approached him from behind, his figure luminous as the beam of light made him seem like a dazzling firefly in a dark stellar night!
And just as he moved a few light years forward...
BZZT!
He felt space coil and constrict around him as an instant later, an essence at his very core felt a rejection as his advancement was stopped and he was pushed back.

He gazed towards the point of the rejection as unbelievably, a thin golden film of light could be seen extending in front of him and going on to cover the space above and below- this golden film of light even extending and wrapping around the far away Styx Regality Plane as it seemed like a circular barrier that contained everything!
<A Barrier of Destiny. Useless for many other beings, but specifically made for you with all the beings you shared destiny and karma within your Age...O True Emperor of Destiny.>
A powerful but young voice resounded out as Oppenheimer's clouded expression turned towards a corner of the golden barrier nearby where he saw multiple figures materialize.
A devilishly handsome young man he had never seen before.
But the others...
His eyes opened wide with surprise as he saw beings he didn't expect to see ever again in his life.
The visage of the Dimensional Ruler of Avalon, Guinevere.
The forlorn figure of the Dimensional Deceiver, Lilith!
The sharp golden hair of a Dream Dimensional Ruler he remembered during his conquest, Eowyn!

One Dimensional Ruler after another appeared before him in a shocking turn of events, with all of these beings not merely making their appearance as an instant after...they released horrific Planar Domains of the essence of Consummate Boundaries!

Two Reverend Emperors behind him, and the sudden appearance of multiple combatants who seemed even more dreadful as they each released an aura of Consummate Boundaries- their purpose deadly and singular as it only seemed to be coming for his life.
Oppenheimer was more than surprised at such a progression of events as before they occurred, Destiny should have warned him!
Why would it not warn him?
HOONG!

He felt a dazzling sense of danger as even though he had obtained the Eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, he had yet to and couldn't truly make them his as so far, he had only been capable of using their closeness to Extremity to bring Destiny and one other Boundary to the 7th Boundary Layer.
With the might of the Eyes of Clarity, he was able to withstand attacks of Reverends and even hide from them as this situation...it wasn't in line with his destiny!
Just who had masked and messed around with his destiny...
As his body channeled the power of the Eyes of Clarity, they came to land on the visage of the young existence that had spoken.
When Oppenheimer looked closely at this being, his face held features he felt like he had seen before! Features of...
'Impossible...' The moment the thought entered his mind, Oppenheimer likened the image of the young being before him with that of the Entity he had evaded from the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
And when their gazes locked, this figure smiled with a knowing look as his voice echoed out.
<You overcame all the distinguished Destined Emperors and Chosen Emperors in your Age...I'm curious if you'll be able to do the same today!>
WAA!
With a burst of grandeur, the son of the True Emperor of Quintessence moved with desolating might against the True Emperor of Destiny!
Within the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
As the Son faced his first real challenge, the Father faced yet another arduous trial as his mission at this moment was surging against an assault from an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem!
Something that carried a trace of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
The moment it arched towards him, he felt his Lifeforms draining even with the countless layers of protections he had.

The only reason he kept his life was due to the constant instant regeneration from exploding Quintessential Kainos Aeonic Prana and Dream Cosmos and the benefits of the 9th Boundary Layers of these Boundaries that he had enacted.
Layers that...connected him to the genuine Minor Planes of Existence in his Infinite Plane!

<The 9th Boundary Layer of Dreams>:: The barrier between the Dimensional Realities in your Origin and the Dimensional Realities in the Infinite Plane becomes increasingly thin. At this point in time, you can extract the authority of the Dream Dimensional Reality to manifest in the surrounding area space as Quintessential Aeonic Dream Xystons will materialize and wander around any area of the presented Dimensional Reality to deliver attacks that contain 3x your Aeonic Soul Damage Values as well as the weight of the whole Dream Dimensional Reality. Another authority brought forth is that your Aeonic Vitality Values become fixed and bound to the Dream Dimensional Reality, where only when 90% of the Dimensional Reality is annihilated can your final Aeonic Vitality Value be destroyed. As the Infinite Plane and your own First Plane of Extremity change, the description of this Layer will change and have new features...
Second chapter in the evening today as well ^.^
Adui
