chapters.title: Chapter 2351 On Another Level! IV
paragraphs: 2351 On Another Level! IV
The effects of the 9th Boundary Layers of Dreams and Prana were distinctive and glorious in nature!
Similar to the 9th Boundary Layer of Dreams, Prana was just as ecstatic.

<The 9th Boundary Layer of Prana>:: The barrier between the Dimensional Realities in your Origin and the Dimensional Realities in the Infinite Plane becomes increasingly thin. At this point in time, you can draw out the authority of the Prana Dimensional Reality to manifest in the surrounding space as Quintessential Aeonic Prana Xystons will materialize and wander around any area of the manifested Dimensional Reality to regenerate and bestow you an enlarged life force 3x your Aeonic Vitality Values as your Maximum Aeonic Vitality Values are temporarily exceeded while this authority is active. Another authority brought forth is that your Aeonic Vitality Values become fastened and bound...only when 90% of the Prana Dimensional Reality is annihilated can your final Aeonic Vitality Value be destroyed. The cost of utilizing the features of this Boundary Layer are paid for in full by the Infinite Plane...
A glorious addition to Noah's arsenal.
And he didn't have to even pay any resource cost for it!
The Infinite Plane would do so on his behalf as the Resonance between his own Dimensional Realities and the Dimensional Realities within the Infinite Plane was truly becoming thin.
When he bound the Sources of Natural Laws and Decreta, he was granted an authority that stated his main body would not truly face True Death unless the very Sources of these Planes were destroyed!
Now, he could release this authority with his own clones so long as he called out the 6th and 9th Boundary Layers of the past Decreta.
The 6th Boundary Layers allowed for an outward Manifestation in the skies or on the earth around him.
The 9th Boundary Layers allowed for a second Manifestation around his body as currently, miniature circular Planes of Existence roared around him!
Golden stellar sands and verdant streams of light surged all around as Quintessential Aeonic Prana and Dream Xystons flew around madly- opposing the streams of silver gold claws that wished him harm!
With the manifested Dimensional Realities above and below him, as well as their manifestations around him...he wouldn't perish so long as the damage to these domains didn't exceed 90%.
And how could his enemies know about such a fact?
SHIING!

The might of an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem focused on him was utterly dreadful as this wasn't a residual essence similar to what his Dream Dimensional Chassis had faced when protecting Ophelia's main body.
When just 50% of their horrific grandeur reached Noah, they broke through all defenses and pierced through his Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form!

And even though he could nullify any damage at the 9th Boundary Layer and below, this surpassed it by another level as when Titus and the other Haven Disciples saw this scene, they felt their hearts settle a little.

Titus as the holder of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem that he released felt everything even more closely as he sensed the Lifeforce of this being before him dwindling rapidly, where even the constant renewal when verdant Cosmos and stellar green spears hit him...the silver gold claws continued to shred everything down as Titus could almost see all of this being's Aspects of Existence annihilated in the next moment!
He smiled at such a scene as his resonant voice rang out.
<You were a tough one to crack, Osmont. Now let's see just what secrets you were hid-...oh come on, don't make me take back my words!>
Titus had begun his words with relative ease as he saw the life-force of this being near its end, but when it did near its end...it stayed there.
It didn't go down any further.
Titus smacked his lips as he began to frown in seriousness.

There seemed to be a trace of Life force- literally a small minuscule piece that could be taken at any time- and yet it didn't budge as the silver gold claws of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem passed through his body!

Up until all the streams passed and faded, the cerulean form of this being remained staunchly in place as on its monstrously handsome face, the stellar eyes of singularity stared coldly towards Titus!
BOOM!
A verdant Cosmos and a green Spear of life smashed into his Body as his drained life force all but recovered in the next instant.
The green and gold manifestations of planes around him that were ripped apart somewhat began to radiate grandeur as they healed and reformed.
The Manifestation of the Minor Planes above and below them also radiated even more radiance as their deadly Cosmos began to swing freely again!
It was a shocking scene to come across as Titus became somber at such a development while sighing lightly.
<My guy, that was an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem you know?>
Frustration and seriousness were apparent on his face as what he used was a life protecting measure!
Yet this being just withstood it like this?
Even while he remained nonchalant on the outside, he sent communications to the other Haven Disciples who followed him.

'You all...if we want to see this through, get ready to use your Apex Aeonic Soul Totems soon. Helena, see if you can discern anything on the method we can use to kill this creature. Dionysus, move with me and focus on defending...'
Multiple commands echoed out from him as he didn't simply use up another Apex Aeonic Soul Totem without figuring out how this being survived- with his means being very methodical!
And he had to be this way as when he looked at the enemy he had chosen for himself today...this being stared towards him fearlessly as his singularities for eyes currently radiated wrath.
<Titus of the Genesis Institute of Extremity...>

His voice echoed out as it pulsed with intense Haki of tyranny and Quintessence, yet his tone carried immense disdain for even the name of the faction he called out as if he considered it all beneath him!

The being they only knew as Osmont stared straight towards the distinguished Haven Disciple of the Genesis Institute of Extremity as his voice boomed out while he moved with his cluster of fantastical abilities.
<...I'm gonna fuck you up.>
BOOM!
Essence erupted out with maddened grandiosity as the True Emperor of Quintessence began his counterattack!

IV
The effects of the 9th Boundary Layers of Dreams and Prana were distinctive and glorious in nature!
Similar to the 9th Boundary Layer of Dreams, Prana was just as ecstatic.
<The 9th Boundary Layer of Prana>:: The barrier between the Dimensional Realities in your Origin and the Dimensional Realities in the Infinite Plane becomes increasingly thin.

At this point in time, you can draw out the authority of the Prana Dimensional Reality to manifest in the surrounding space as Quintessential Aeonic Prana Xystons will materialize and wander around any area of the manifested Dimensional Reality to regenerate and bestow you an enlarged life force 3x your Aeonic Vitality Values as your Maximum Aeonic Vitality Values are temporarily exceeded while this authority is active.

Another authority brought forth is that your Aeonic Vitality Values become fastened and bound...only when 90% of the Prana Dimensional Reality is annihilated can your final Aeonic Vitality Value be destroyed.
The cost of utilizing the features of this Boundary Layer are paid for in full by the Infinite Plane...
A glorious addition to Noah's arsenal.
And he didn't have to even pay any resource cost for it!
The Infinite Plane would do so on his behalf as the Resonance between his own Dimensional Realities and the Dimensional Realities within the Infinite Plane was truly becoming thin.
When he bound the Sources of Natural Laws and Decreta, he was granted an authority that stated his main body would not truly face True Death unless the very Sources of these Planes were destroyed!
Now, he could release this authority with his own clones so long as he called out the 6th and 9th Boundary Layers of the past Decreta.
The 6th Boundary Layers allowed for an outward Manifestation in the skies or on the earth around him.
The 9th Boundary Layers allowed for a second Manifestation around his body as currently, miniature circular Planes of Existence roared around him!
Golden stellar sands and verdant streams of light surged all around as Quintessential Aeonic Prana and Dream Xystons flew around madly- opposing the streams of silver gold claws that wished him harm!
With the manifested Dimensional Realities above and below him, as well as their manifestations around him...he wouldn't perish so long as the damage to these domains didn't exceed 90%.
And how could his enemies know about such a fact?
SHIING!

The might of an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem focused on him was utterly dreadful as this wasn't a residual essence similar to what his Dream Dimensional Chassis had faced when protecting Ophelia's main body.
When just 50% of their horrific grandeur reached Noah, they broke through all defenses and pierced through his Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form!

And even though he could nullify any damage at the 9th Boundary Layer and below, this surpassed it by another level as when Titus and the other Haven Disciples saw this scene, they felt their hearts settle a little.

Titus as the holder of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem that he released felt everything even more closely as he sensed the Lifeforce of this being before him dwindling rapidly, where even the constant renewal when verdant Cosmos and stellar green spears hit him...the silver gold claws continued to shred everything down as Titus could almost see all of this being's Aspects of Existence annihilated in the next moment!
He smiled at such a scene as his resonant voice rang out.
<You were a tough one to crack, Osmont.
Now let's see just what secrets you were hid-...oh come on, don't make me take back my words!>
Titus had begun his words with relative ease as he saw the life-force of this being near its end, but when it did near its end...it stayed there.
It didn't go down any further.
Titus smacked his lips as he began to frown in seriousness.

There seemed to be a trace of Life force- literally a small minuscule piece that could be taken at any time- and yet it didn't budge as the silver gold claws of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem passed through his body!

Up until all the streams passed and faded, the cerulean form of this being remained staunchly in place as on its monstrously handsome face, the stellar eyes of singularity stared coldly towards Titus!
BOOM!
A verdant Cosmos and a green Spear of life smashed into his Body as his drained life force all but recovered in the next instant.
The green and gold manifestations of planes around him that were ripped apart somewhat began to radiate grandeur as they healed and reformed.
The Manifestation of the Minor Planes above and below them also radiated even more radiance as their deadly Cosmos began to swing freely again!
It was a shocking scene to come across as Titus became somber at such a development while sighing lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2352 Are You Nuts?! I
paragraphs: 'It must be a mutation related to resource usage. This level of unrelenting production is something that even 10 Unequaled Reverend Emperors can't keep up.'

The voice of Titus rang out amongst the communication channel of the Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity, their destinies interlinked as they sought to find the solutions to this enemy together!

Seeing the alterations in existence in the skies above and the earth below, as well as the radiant domains surrounding this being and just the constant and senseless energy usage...Titus could only come to this conclusion.
ƥandasnovel·ƈom 'Anything on why his life force stopped reducing at the last second? How can we eradicate him completely? There must be an anchor holding him in place...'
Another voice rang out as no answer came!
They only saw the billowing stellar cerulean figure usher out more madness and chaos as Titus squinted his eyes while shaking his head once more.
He uttered one last message in the communications link before his body radiated silver gold light to meet the oncoming enemy.

'And his Damage Value Output seems to be constantly rising. It just jumped markedly again as if diverts attacks again, you all have to be careful. Make sure you don't fall to a nameless Entity in the Haven of Dissolution!'
WAA!
Titus's body took on a unique stance as he strengthened his core and shot out like a silver gold arrow!
The Entity's power had increased sharply.
Why was this?
It was always rising as Noah unlocked and elevated new Boundaries, but right after the release of the Apex Aeonic Soul Totem and its drastic results...something critical had occurred!
Away from this crucial battle.
Outside of the Vaults of Extremity, in the dazzling Planar Palisades of Extremity.

An Infinite Plane floated serenely as it was the size of a grain of sand, its very Source currently undergoing fundamental changes as its Natural Laws and Decreta all drastically changed while being expanded to Extremity.
And at this moment, these changes were even more so applicable to the master of the Infinite Plane as his Origin that received so many different sources of Elevation...could not take it any longer!

It had reached a critical juncture as from the Bound Sources of Extremity to the Obsidian Planar Origin Panaceas and now the Resonance with the elevation of the Concepts of Prana, Dreams, and Apollyon to the 9th Boundary Layers...
It all culminated to a single prompt.
<The First Plane of Extremity is ringing the bells of completion.>
His Origin emanated intense grandeur as when his Will seeped into it...
Oh!

The sight was too illustrious to see as akin to a radiant tower, his 9 Dimensional Realities were stacked on top of each other as they had been expanded to be over ten times what they used to be in the past, their sheer breadth being massive as this wasn't a simple expansion! I think you should take a look at
They underwent expansion, refinement, and strengthening as every surface of these Dimensional Realities exceeded any other Minor Planes of Existence in quality!

Massive Reality Passages that seemed like stellar mountains and pillars of Ascendancy Stanchions stretched across the 9 Dimensional Realities, one of the grander changes being the potent aura of Extremity that this Origin now emanated.

It wasn't just Blood, Loot, and Quintessence that were now bound to his Origin- with all of the Boundaries he had raised to the 9th Boundary Layer having their Sources of Extremity bound to him as this also aided in his rapid elevation!
As he stared at the stellar rotation of the multicolored Cosmos and connections of his First Plane of Extremity, more prompts cascaded down as his whole Origin radiated potent rays of wonder.
Rays that pulsed with the dense aura of Extremity that only the most powerful Reverends would have as it passed through his main body and caused all of his clones to shine with shocking luminosity!
When a change occurred in one Aspect of Existence- it carried over to the other Aspects of Existence as well since all of Noah's was intricately bound by his Soul!
His Aeonic Soul Values continued their exponential rise.
His Body...it constantly shed unseen particles of dust and became ever resplendent as its hardness exceeded the most powerful EPOCH Relics!
Even though his Origin was the one that had accomplished a great change, his Soul and Body experienced Quintessential changes due to it.
<The First Plane of Extremity has been completed!>
<The path forward has been illuminated.>
<The Total Augmentation of the First Plane of Extremity has been expanded to grant a base of +500,000 Aeonic Soul Damage, Defense, and Vitality Values>
<Your Body alone can now withstand and release 500,000 Aeonic Soul Damage Values as the essence of any Planar or Innate Boundaries is nullified by 80% against it.>
500,000 for his Origin, and 500,000 more from his body for a glorious 1 Million in his Base Values!
He had reached a new stage of power Entropy as everything about him jumped a degree higher, the prompts that had arrived showing only the start of the boons as there were more to follow!
<The 9 Dimensional Chassis connected to the First Plane of Extremity undergo a Quintessential advancement.>

<9 Sources of Extremity can now undergo a deeper binding to the First Plane of Extremity as they will cause the budding of the Pillars of Extremity to shoulder your Ascension to an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.>

<You can now begin the formation of the Second Plane of Extremity by choosing the 9 Dimensional Realities as templates to forge 9 Major Planes of Existence, or you can seek different Planar Templates across Extremity to forge as the basis of the Second Plane of Extremity.>
Unprecedented grandeur and brilliance erupted at the depths of his body and spread out to all Aspects of his Existence as the path forward became clear!

Would he take the 9 Dimensions that were Minor Planes of Existence as templates to forge Major Planes of Existence for his Second Plane of Extremity, or would he enact something else entirely based on other wonders in the Planar Palisades of Extremity or the Vaults of Extremity?
Bountiful choices waited for him as every part of him- down to the very atom...bathed in a profound light of power!

chapters.title: Chapter 2353 Are You Nuts?! II
paragraphs: As his Main Body experienced the fantastical changes, the clones bound to the 9 Dimensional Realities resonated and advanced even further as the force of Extremity they released reached intense levels!
In a hidden domain within the Abecedarian Sacrarium, the Dream Dimensional Chassis experienced this transformation as well, and uniquely...one more person benefited from this more than any others.
It was the injured Ophelia.

To stabilize her Aeonic Soul that had suffered from the essence of an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem, Noah had infused her with boundless waves of Prana as well as his own Blood which was akin to an Ultimate Panacea, and he then connected even more closely with her through Dual Cultivation as all her injuries were healed in seconds while her power began to rise!
This...was before he completed the First Plane of Extremity.

After its completion, the Dream Dimensional Chassis radiated pristine levels of essence that came from the establishment of something pristine, and the being Noah was connected to at this time felt all her Boundaries churning as they devoured the potent aura of Extremity surging from him- all of Ophelia's Boundaries proceeding ever closer towards Extremity!
This applied even more so to the Boundary of Dreams she had also gained access to learn.

The First Three Boundary Layers of Dreams were achieved by her in mere seconds during this Dual Cultivation with the Dream Dimensional Chassis as in the midst of all this, Ophelia's light brown skin was tinged red as she managed to express her words through the surging brilliance around her.
<Woah, I should get injured more if this is the treatment I'm gonna receive every time...>

The boons brought forth by the First Plane of Extremity were plenty as what Ophelia coincidentally enjoyed now was something that others could as well- the change not only prohibited to Noah as those connected to him would also experience its wonders.
And this wasn't only limited to Dual Cultivation as all people under Noah would stand to benefit, either its true wonders yet to be unveiled!
In the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
In the deeper areas, the entire landscape was altered as the skies were tinged green, with the land colored crimson gold as vibrant Cosmos and spears surged around the whole area with deadly force!
Titus and 7 other Haven Disciples were focused around Noah as 4 others surrounded the visage of an injured Caesar.

The Mad Reverend Emperor had actually used his own shocking means to survive the blow of an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem, his body currently returning to a stellar Obsidian humanoid form as crackles of Extremity began to arc across his body.
<I told you to leave me alone.>
HUUUM!
His voice began to bloom slowly, but it very quickly caused the expressions of the four Haven Disciples around him to become rather drastic.
<I said that all I came for was a single thing and that I had no qualms with you all!>
BOOM!
The skies began to vibrate in a shocking manner as even Titus who was clashing with Noah's ridiculous output of skills was forced to turn around as his eyes showed incredulity!
<I said all this...and you all just wouldn't stop. So...you can all die.>I think you should take a look at

His humanoid quasar form suddenly illuminated with glory as all of a sudden, the immense authority of all of his Boundaries was brought forth as a radiant curved line suddenly came into existence on his stellar obsidian body.
A curved line blaring with multicolored radiance as it was...akin to a pulsing blood vessel that radiated Extremity!
<That...you, you can't be serious!>
The Haven Disciples saw this scene as their gazes became those of incredulity, because they knew very well what the manifestation of this multicolored vessel radiating waves of Extremity meant!

And after the appearance of one, The Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar bellowed out as a second and a third one appeared- his stellar obsidian quasarian form gaining three multicolored curved lines on his body as the power he gave off...neared the line of something all beings here were all too familiar with.
Titus saw this scene as his expression became grave, and he actually roared with a trace of anger and disbelief as he never expected a being to do this!
<Are you nuts?! The moment you begin your advancement towards becoming an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, you cannot touch any lifeform of lower levels!>
WAA!
Yes!
They knew all too well what this being was doing!

Those at the Unequaled Reverend Emperor level who had made enough achievements in the Boundary Expansion Realm and had at least 9 Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer could try and bring together all of their accomplishments and finalize their Foundation!
To finalize one's foundation, all of their culminations in the Soul, Origin, and Body had to resonate with their Boundaries to call forth the Aeonic Extremity Meridians.

It was a crucial process that even the most powerful beings took shelter in hidden locations or were guarded by those they trusted as any mistake during this process resulted in the shattering of one's foundation as they forever remained below the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level!
This was the process of Apexification!

The development of one's Aeonic Extremity Meridians to elevate one's existence, eventually taking a chosen Boundary from the 9th Boundary Layer and using this as a basis to define who they were as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.

The greater the number of Aeonic Extremity Meridians, the more powerful one would be when they became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform. This was why Titus and other existences from multiple Factions across a few selected Havens...had sent their people to the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution to attain Extremity Panaceas from the Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution and establish an Extremity Foundation- a Foundation that granted one the chance to form a much greater number of Meridians and guaranteed their advancement to become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

Yet at this moment, they saw a being recklessly begin the process of Apexification as while Aeonic Extremity Meridians continued to form magnificently on his body, his shining countenance that was gaining an entirely different power roared and rushed towards the nearest Haven Disciples.
<I can't make a move?! Let's see who will fucking stop me from killing you all today!>
HOONG!
With newfound dominance, the Mad Reverend Emperor made a move beyond anyone's calculations!

chapters.title: Chapter 2354 The Mad Reverend Emperor! I
paragraphs: Apexification!
Titus felt like he was going mad when he saw such a scene as even amidst all this, he could still understand it somewhat.
Every existence who became an Unequaled Reverend Emperor and had accumulated over 9 Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer had the chance to initiate this process.
The failure rate was quite high as the price was being left behind and never touching the gates of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

So of course, if he and the other Haven Disciples were hunting down an existence and the choice was between death or throwing caution out of the window to try and advance to an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...the answer was clear.
Nobody would simply wait for death.
Titus understood this thought process, but he was still frustrated!
Because the process of Apexification in the middle of battle was also another method of death- with the chances of success being extremely minimal.
But this being did it nonetheless as even if he may not be successful, his initial burst of power may be able to take some of them down with him!
<Don't spare your Apex Aeonic Soul Totems! If he attacks any Lifeforms with the essence of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, he will not have much longer left to live!>
Titus bellowed out while his senses warned him of the terrifying Entity he had targeted arriving before him with a relentless momentum.
The attacks of this being had drastically changed in Damage Values as the many sources of attacks he released may very well break through his defenses if he wasn't careful.
'Ridiculous problems from all around...I better not end regretting this.'
He shook his head at such a development as while keeping an eye on the being who had begun the process of Apexification, he focused on Osmont as at this point in time- he actually had to!
BOOOM!

Immense reverberations bloomed as Six Aeonic Extremity Meridians could not be seen shining gloriously on the body of the Mad Reverend Emperor, his voice booming out as he descended like a cataclysmic singularity on the Haven Disciples that were attacking him- one of these beings pulling out an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem and Initiating it right away.

<You all used an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem on me with no repercussions, do you truly think yourself above everything that when I use essence similar to an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem- something will happen to me?>
Terrifying words erupted from his mouth that caused the Haven Disciples to turn somber.
Yes.
The essence from Apex Aeonic Soul Totems was infinitely close to emulating that of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, but it wasn't all the way there.
So long as Caesar was undergoing the procedure of Apexification and didn't become a genuine Apex Aeonic Lifeform...could he use his authority that was nearly there to wipe the floor with them?!
<Fucking hell!>

A curse came out from the Haven Disciple Caesar faced as the one who had activated an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem had a dazzling red light bloom from it, a massive Crimson bell forming in front of him as it emanated frightening waves of power and smashed towards the barreling figure of Caesar.
And in such an instance...I think you should take a look at
BOOM!
The billowing cluster of Quasars that was the Mad Reverend Emperor actually collided with the Crimson bell head on as the impact alone was maddening!
<You should've let me be.>
BOOM!
The crimson bell was pushed back as cracks began to appear from it, horrific waves of gravity pressing from all around as even space twisted.
<But some people do not get the message until death comes for them!>
BOOM...CRACK!

With an unrelenting force, The Mad Emperor broke through the force released by an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem as the crimson bell was crushed and folded by the weight of frightening gravity, his figure flashing towards the Haven Disciple that had released this attack as the shock and horror on the face of this being only became inches away from his.
<What Genesis Institute of Extremity?>
BZZT!

His stellar obsidian hands shot out and wrapped around the neck of this profoundly powerful Haven Disciple as the temperature on his body alone caused this being's skin to melt, waves of torrential gravity pressing in from all around as this Unequaled Reverend Emperor began to be compressed as if he were a ball of mud!
<Julius!>

A bellow could be heard from Titus from afar as in the next instant, the being in the clutches of Caesar was squeezed into a small mass of crimson gold made of blood and bones as billions of years of hard work went to waste.
An unreal reality settled in as unbelievably, a Haven Disciple from the Genesis Institute of Extremity had actually fallen.

Not only had they fallen in the Youngest Haven while seeking the Extremity Panaceas from the Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution, they were only in the periphery as they hadn't even neared the Extremity Vein- and yet one had perished!
This reality settled in as the one who had done this was relentless, even though his body pulsed with a tinge of instability as a Ninth Aeonic Extremity Meridian began to materialize on his body.

It was a scenario that further caused the gazes of Haven Disciples to change as the appearance of 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians meant this being had a truly deep foundation as his success in the procedure of Apexification...was actually high!
Even with such a development, the Haven Disciples had clear thoughts as a bellow from Titus could be heard.
<Just hold him back for now! He can't keep this state any longer as he will have to advance or ruin his Foundation. The moment he becomes a full Apex Aeonic Lifeform, he won't be able to touch us!>
WAA!
Destiny flourished.

The three nearby Haven Disciples close to the Mad Reverend Emperor pulled back with wrathful expressions as they each initiated their Apex Aeonic Soul Totem, one source of frightening energy after another beginning to surge towards Caesar!

chapters.title: Chapter 2355 The Mad Reverend Emperor! II
paragraphs: Waves of attacks from Apex Aeonic Soul Totems surged towards him, yet this being...
<One is not enough!>
BOOM!
He bellowed out with valor as the surrounding reality began to be scorched entirely.
<For your actions to force me to this and jeopardize the life of my daughter, all of you need to die!>

He truly seemed to have gone mad as with indomitable might, 9 vibrant Aeonic Extremity Meridians shone on his body while giving off an austere air of power- his limbs beginning to disappear at this moment as they turned into stellar particles of light.
The process of Apexification was proceeding steadily.
It could not be stopped...unless one wanted to destroy their foundation!
Caesar's body clashed with the might of three Apex Aeonic Soul Totems as he wasn't pushed back, his power scaling upwards evermore as his body disappeared at a faster rate.
Stellar skin, muscles, bones...everything about him that made his old lifeform disappeared as the trillions of Quasars that made his cells all but faded into radiant lights.
Caesar could feel this transformation more than others as he knew his time was running out!
OOOH!

Waves of pressure were released from him as one singular Boundary paved the way forward- this Boundary wrapping around the 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians as this was the concept he chose to define who he was.
Borealis!
It pushed away anything approaching with a dazzling force of gravity as all three Apex Aeonic Soul Totems and the force they released were shattered.
The Haven Disciples gritted their teeth at this as they prepared to take drastic actions themselves, but in this instant as the rage of the Mad Reverend Emperor was about to continue...
SHIING!
All of the body parts disappeared as in his place, only 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians remained.
No Origin. No Soul. No Body.
Nothing could be felt outwardly as all of it...was contained in the 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians that throbbed with potent waves of Extremity at this juncture!
Everything about one's old life would be erased as from the chosen Concept that defined them...they would be reborn into something else.

The Consummate Boundary of Borealis permeated across the 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians as Titus and the other Haven Disciples sighed in relief- which was a unique sensation for them as they were actually forced to be happy about another being succeeding in their process of Apexification!

The second hardest juncture was during the formation of the Aeonic Extremity Meridians as the hardest juncture was the confinement of the chosen concept inside the Meridians. This being had passed all this seamlessly as at this moment...dazzling waves of light emanated out as the body of the Mad Emperor began to be reformed from the 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians.
From the concept of Borealis itself!
The aura of life it gave off was entirely different from before as it was that of an entirely different lifeform.
Waves of such a lifeform began to spread out from here and extend outwards powerfully as it was a might that could not be so easily contained!

From the dazzling multicolored Aeonic Extremity Meridians, a brand new body was formed as quadrillions of atoms made of constantly spinning quasars came together to construct a humanoid form of a distinguished existence that held shocking beauty and grace.
Grace of an entirely different Lifeform as the 9 Aeonic Extremity Meridians disappeared in his body while shining brightly!
OOOH! I think you should take a look at

He bellowed out with magnificence as all beings here faced a profound sense of oppression- an oppression deep in one's Soul as they knew this being before them could without a doubt grant them true death!
And this mad being didn't delay as his first actions before he even stabilized his new existence...
<Did you really think I would stop here?! You all do not know what you've made me lose!>

The gazes of others changed, but Titus remained stern and calm as dazzling obsidian rays of light ten times as powerful as any Apex Aeonic Soul Totem erupted from the figure of the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar.
Nay, not the Mad Reverend Emperor- but the Mad Apex Emperor, Caesar!
The rays of stellar obsidian light he released surged towards every Haven Disciple here as at such a juncture...
BZZZT!
The skies above darkened.
An extremely ancient and undeniable aura of power cascaded from above as it stopped everything in its tracks.

The attacks that Caesar threw out halted in their tracks as his expression became one of utter rage, looking at the dark skies and bellowing out towards them in a shocking manner even though the aura seeping from them...was that of Extremity!
Extremity!

It utterly stopped everything in its tracks as it even wrapped around Noah and the Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity, Titus sighing inwardly as an ancient feminine voice descended from the darkened skies.
<The lives of lesser Lifeforms are not for us to interfere in. You already killed one, so take that as your recompense.>
The voice carried undeniable authority as not even Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could withstand it, but the Mad Apex Emperor remained defiant as he bellowed out while vibrating with even more power!
<I am unwilling!>
BOOM!
A luminous stellar obsidian light shone.
But it didn't matter as from the genuine aura of Extremity in the skies, a just white hand instantly appeared as it came to wrap around the visage of the Mad Apex Emperor.
It wrapped around him without so much as any resistance as the ancient voice continued to resound!
<No Apex Aeonic Lifeforms can participate in the Initiation Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution, and you may not touch the lower Lifeforms here. For your indiscretion...>
HOONG!

The latter words were left unsaid as the just white hand snatched out Caesar's figure as if he were a mere weed, bringing his countenance up above and taking it away as these terrifying auras disappeared entirely!
Those below had no words as it seemed everything was brought to a halt, Noah also gazing at the skies where a hand had stretched past his materialized Dimensional Reality as if it didn't exist.
In the midst of all of these incredible actions, a small quasar the size of an atom escaped the eyes of all those that remained here as it floated towards him.
His Providence and destiny shone as he caught its path towards him, letting it land on his cerulean skin as this Quasar...carried a mark of the Mad Apex Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 2356 Save Her I
paragraphs: A massive white hand came down and plucked the visage of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform like it was nothing!

This hand rose up and disappeared from the skies above as if it never existed, but its significance was too profound as even while stabilizing the concept that defined him- Caesar truly could do nothing against it.
Across the folds of space, time, and reality.
A great deal of distance was traversed in an instant as Caeser felt the restrictions of his body loosened somewhat, the hand holding onto him unclasping as its pressure still bore down unto him!

<It was established long ago that on the path to Extremity, advanced lifeforms will not interfere with those below them. Violating this rule is worthy of death...only if you continue to be defiant. But I do not wish to kill one of the few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in this Haven when it is already the youngest and weakest, so what will it be, Quasarian?>

thankful. Now, let's get you upto date on what it means to be an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, and what your responsibilities are from here The voice boomed with undeniable authority as one had to only agree to it, otherwise only doom awaited them as the Mad Emperor gritted his teeth while pulling his aura back, working on stabilizing his advancement and clearly taking the Boundary of Borealis to the 10th Layer!

<Good. You killed one lifeform before you fully became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, and your own life was on the line, so this can be excused with a few years of service. Had I stepped in after you killed others, the tight wound fogeys connected to the Genesis Institute of Extremity would have demanded your death...so be thankful. Now, let's get you upto date on what it means to be an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, and what your responsibilities are from here on out...>

The voice was ancient and regal at the same time as this fair hand was connected to a fantastical being- a being whose body was veiled with layers of Extremity as when one traversed past the hand, they would see a veiled head with two luminous eyes pulsing with grandiosity!

These eyes were currently coldly focused on Caesar, but their gaze also briefly crossed the veils of space and time as they sank down past the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity, delved into the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, and focused on the cerulean figure surrounded by Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
The eyes of an Existence that had reached Extremity gazed at this cerulean existence conjuring manifested Planes around him as just briefly...this existence made a simple comment!
<Interesting...>
During this utterly precarious ordeal, a minuscule Quasar carrying the will of a recently advanced existence flowed into Noah as he accepted it into his mind.
In one's mind, countless thoughts could be shared within an instant.
So the time outside was akin to being frozen as within a portion of Noah's mind, a Will communicated with him!
The scene formed was that of a vast cluster of quasars the size of Minor Planes stretching out for an unknown number of light years.

These quasars were unique as they seemed like advanced variations of planes, abundant life ever so present within them as at their very center, stellar obsidian Major Planes of Existence carrying a similar signature could be felt.

Far above this scene, the figure of Noah's soul form could be seen as in front of him, the stellar obsidian visage of none other than the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar gazed down with a face of frustration and anger!
<I have a daughter.>
He began by speaking simply as Noah walked beside this being to stare at the expanse of Minor Planes and Major Planes of the Quasarians showing below him.
He could feel the tug of Providence and Destiny as he continued to listen passively while Caesar continued.

<I have a daughter that I very sick, and what seems like the last hope for her was in this Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution...in the Extremity Panaceas that can reforge one's foundation. Because WAA!
of the recent actions, all of that is closed off for me.>
WAA!
His solidified will gave off impressive pressure as it turned around to face Noah at this moment, his eyes filled with power as he continued!

<Now, I do not know you or what you stand for, but you aided me against these vermin and are the only one nearby that Borealis deems trustworthy and powerful enough to acquire Extremity Panaceas. I stand before you not as a Quasarian or the Will of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, I stand before you as a Father who urgently wishes to save his daughter, and it seems I will be restricted in doing so for the near future as I cannot obtain the Extremity Panaceas myself. And even though you are trustworthy as Borealis deems, I understand that no being under the Havens of Extremity is a Saint. So...what will be your price?>
Golden Providence shone within Noah's eyes as he didn't even gaze back to Caesar before he replied.
<Two things. One...is that down there.>

He pointed towards the scene of the cluster of Planes that should have been one of the central domains of the Quasarians as the face of Caesar darkened even though he was expecting it- and this was the reason why the scene below was even shown!
This was the price that his Boundary of Borealis that had stepped into the 10th Boundary Layer told him as he steeled his heart to pay it and waited to see just what the second condition would be!
<The last thing I want...is a bet.>
<A bet?> The Mad Apex Emperor raised his brows while Noah nodded and finally came to lock his eyes with him, a devilish smile blooming on his face.
<Yes, a bet. A wager that within the next year, you and I will have a match. If I win this match...you will have to serve as my Vassal.>
BOOM!
A shocking term was put forth as Caesar's eyes flashed with danger and power!
He looked at another unflinching stare as his eyes squinted while he replied coldly.
<It is a bet...so if I win instead?>
<If you win, I'll give back the group of planes below and even follow you. Isn't it nice? You'd get back everything and more.>

<I have a daughter that I very sick, and what seems like the last hope for her was in this Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution...in the Extremity Panaceas that can reforge one's foundation.
Because WAA!
of the recent actions, all of that is closed off for me.>
WAA!
His solidified will gave off impressive pressure as it turned around to face Noah at this moment, his eyes filled with power as he continued!
<Now, I do not know you or what you stand for, but you aided me against these vermin and are the only one nearby that Borealis deems trustworthy and powerful enough to acquire Extremity Panaceas.

I stand before you not as a Quasarian or the Will of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, I stand before you as a Father who urgently wishes to save his daughter, and it seems I will be restricted in doing so for the near future as I cannot obtain the Extremity Panaceas myself.
And even though you are trustworthy as Borealis deems, I understand that no being under the Havens of Extremity is a Saint.
So...what will be your price?>
Golden Providence shone within Noah's eyes as he didn't even gaze back to Caesar before he replied.
<Two things.
One...is that down there.>

He pointed towards the scene of the cluster of Planes that should have been one of the central domains of the Quasarians as the face of Caesar darkened even though he was expecting it- and this was the reason why the scene below was even shown!
This was the price that his Boundary of Borealis that had stepped into the 10th Boundary Layer told him as he steeled his heart to pay it and waited to see just what the second condition would be!
<The last thing I want...is a bet.>
<A bet?> The Mad Apex Emperor raised his brows while Noah nodded and finally came to lock his eyes with him, a devilish smile blooming on his face.
<Yes, a bet.
A wager that within the next year, you and I will have a match.
If I win this match...you will have to serve as my Vassal.>
BOOM!
A shocking term was put forth as Caesar's eyes flashed with danger and power!
He looked at another unflinching stare as his eyes squinted while he replied coldly.
<It is a bet...so if I win instead?>
<If you win, I'll give back the group of planes below and even follow you.
Isn't it nice?
You'd get back everything and more.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2357 Save Her II
paragraphs: <If you win, I'll give back the cluster of planes below and even follow you. Isn't it nice? You'd get back everything and more.>

The devilish smile on Noah's face caused Caesar to be distrustful, and this Mad Apex Emperor thought back to the power Noah showed before as well as his confidence that he would be able to get past the Haven Disciples unscathed to even be able to continue forward towards the Vein of Dissolution.
With all of this and many more things considered, Caesar nodded with consideration as a burst of light shot forth from his Will and floated towards Noah.

<I managed to make the others use their Apex Aeonic Soul Totems to make it easier on you. So just get past them and attain the Extremity Panaceas as soon as possible. Here are the coordinates and authority for you to get into the Plane my daughter is in, as well as what you should be mindful of. Contact this quasarian signature here if you need help and can't get to me...>
The valley of light continued abundant information about Quasarians and secret information that only one of their strongest past Reverends would know!
Caesar gave it all out freely as after one ascended to the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level, the issue of Lineages was a minor one as what mattered the most were interests.
And nothing was of greater interest to the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar than his daughter.
So his fragment of will gazed calmly at the figure of Noah as he vocalized one last time while he began to disappear.
<Please, save her. Save my Xiaomi.>
WAA!
Boundless waves of Providence and Destiny shone serenely in Noah's mind as the fragment of will disappeared.
He silently gazed at the scenes and memories left behind as his mind quickly returned to the scene outside of it.
Towards the Haven Disciples that were sighing with relief after a madman was gone!
But he wouldn't let them have the relief nor satisfaction.
He had to wrap things up as he himself stabilized his Realm and understood the complexities of the completed First Plane of Extremity!
After all, he was the only one forging this path.
He was the pioneer that would expand new horizons and bring to light things others couldn't even imagine!
So these beings that currently stood in his way...
'It is time for you all to disappear.'
He thought this not just because of his own authoritative will, but because at this very moment...
<Your Understanding of Nullity has reached the apex of the Terminus Stage>
<Your Understanding of Ruin has reached the apex of the Terminus Stage>
<You can now control the Sources of Chaos to breed more than just destruction!>
<You have come to a Quintessential understanding regarding nothingness and destruction.>
<You can now control the Sources of Chaos to breed more than just destruction!>
<The Expansion of Nullity and Ruin into Boundaries is now possible.>
BOOM!
His soul ridiculously added yet another conduit of change as a profound understanding of the states of Verisimilitudes flowed in his mind!
And so with dominating momentum, he continued.
<Expand Nullity and Ruin into Boundaries...and deem them Quintessential.>
He wouldn't need to utilize any Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity for them.

A simple expansion to the 6th Boundary Layer with lesser Pearls of Extremity and a designation of Quintessential would bring them all the way to the 9th Boundary Layer as thereafter, he would have intricate control over two more profound sources of chaos!
Sources that were states of being in the very Havens of Extremity themselves.

He felt that with this, his completion of his First Plane of Extremity, his ever strengthening Body and Soul that was constantly being reinforced by the feature of The Entropic Entity of Extremity...he felt that with all this and more, Unequaled Reverend Emperors should be dominated by his hands!

Titus barely caught a break as he sighed at the departure of the Mad Apex Emperor, his heart feeling a trace of respect for the fair white hand that had plucked him away as whether it was in the Haven or the Haven of Genesis, those that had reached Extremity were always being he looked up to!
Because many of his teachers still hadn't reached this state.

Only the most distinguished of beings in the Genesis Institute of Extremity had actually reached the stage of Extremity- and the actual number that they held was unknown even to Titus as it was a tightly guarded secret.

The stage of Extremity seemed ever close after one entered the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeform and enacted the 10th Boundary Layer of a concept that defined them, but it also seemed even further away as if one didn't attain something like the Extremity Foundation, it would be nearly impossible!
'So let's finish things up and proceed with getting the Extremity Panaceas. If the situation becomes too convoluted...I can also just lock my wounds and give up.'
WAA!
He was a straightforward man.
He would do what he wanted and go for the utmost benefits, but if it was turning out to be too much trouble...he would also abandon a path no matter how sweet it seemed!
'So let's finish this up-'
HOOONG!

Just as time resumed after the descent of the genuine aura of Extremity, Titus and the others turned to face their only remaining enemy as apart from the continuous production of abilities still pouring out from him senselessly...massive pillars of crimson and silver roared out from his body as the aura of Ruin and Nullity seeped out- but this time, it was that of immaculate Boundaries that did not at all seem low!
And the supremacy this being released...only exploded to a greater level as Titus looked at this radiant being while cursing out.
<Fucking hell...>
What would he do now? He sought help from his destiny once more as he weighed the pros and cons- on whether he should keep on this path or lick his wounds and go!

chapters.title: Chapter 2358 Utter Trash! I
paragraphs: In the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

The eruption of pristine power and grandeur of Extremity did not go unnoticed by those close by, with the many powerful individuals arriving from different parts of the Havens of Extremity sensing the shocking reverberations that occurred towards a certain area.

Even though they felt these shocking reverberations, very few beings actually made their way over as they inherently knew that the blaring aura of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as well as the eruption of a genuine aura of Extremity not too long after...it was not something that they wanted to be up against or involved in!
So the few that did feel these auras...didn't dare to even come!
But there were others more distinguished than them.
There were others...who didn't even fear the aura of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, nor the genuine aura of Extremity!
Such beings were from extremely old and ancient Origins as they could call the Havens of Extremity their very homes.
One such being who was nearby and following her own path felt the reverberations of power as she floated towards it unlike all others...and it was mainly due to nothing other than her curiosity.

This existence has a unique feminine charm as she held a humanoid form with fiery red gold hair snaking past her shoulders, and yet a bright stellar crimson horn rose from her forehead and pointed to the skies as it kept in a shocking cluster of power!

Her countenance was full of calm and curiosity as she pierced across space extremely quickly, her figure appearing a light year away as even though she wasn't hidden in the veils of space, no being below the Supreme Aeonic Entity level would even be able to see she was there!
She was only known as Ayame, and to enter this Aeonic Haven of Dissolution...a member of her Lineage that had grasped Extremity had brought her over.

Her languid eyes full of power and grace looked over as she noticed the unfolding battle from afar, her fair hands covering her lips as even though there were current events playing, her eyes were seeing a different set of events as she saw what occurred seconds before this!

She saw the white hand pulsing with Extremity that came down, she saw the culprit who had called it down, and the beings that were to blame for this all as the Recorded History was easily revealed in her eyes- her manipulation of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity reaching shocking levels!
'I see...'
Her eyes lit up as she understood the whole situation and laughed lightly.
'Little brats from the Institute of Extremity Genesis attacking who they thought to be an aboriginal just because of their own greed...what around him screams aboriginal?'
Her face portrayed exceeding beauty as she followed the current events playing out and focused on the one she found to be called Osmont.I think you should take a look at

How dumb were these dense martial arts fools to believe they were attacking an aboriginal of the Youngest Haven? Even with her eyes that could peel across Layers of secrets utilizing the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, she couldn't find much about this being as it meant he had reached a similar level of expertise or had an even more profound secret.
'More than that, this isn't even his main body, so what did you even expect to gain if you managed to take him down?'
She only shook her head with more disappointment as she wondered how she came from the same Haven as these brats from the Genesis Institute of Extremity!

And as she gazed at their faces now, she could read their thoughts as clear as day as these Haven Disciples...were beginning to feel fatigue and regret as they saw Osmont erupt with the dense Boundary Essence of the States of Verisimilitudes- Ruin and Nullity!
Even though they were two of the most basic States, only accomplished Reverend Emperors could walk on their path and actually expand them towards high enough layers as this being...
'He already has four...eleven...'

She counted the number of different Essences of Consummate Boundaries she could feel around this being as when she affirmed they far exceeded 10, she became surprised again as a stray thought entered her mind.
'Isn't he at the same level that those prideful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that Grandpa wants me to choose from were at before they underwent Apexification...?'
A single stray thought. One that she shook her head wryly of as she refocused on the current situation.

Her eyes that could easily see the Recorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity analyzed the ongoing battle as she figured out the wall that these Haven Disciples couldn't cross- they had brought down the life force of this Osmont to a minuscule level, but they couldn't entirely erase it as something seemed to be anchoring it down!
'What could it be...'

Ayame tried to put herself in their shoes as she wondered how she would tackle a foe like this, but before she could think any further, a drastic change that even caused her to be genuinely shocked bloomed.

From the rising pillars of Ruin and Nullity that were pervasively surging around this being, the tendrils of the Boundary Essence of Nullity released a brilliant light as they rose to the peak of the skies, but they were followed behind closely by tendrils of a cerulean Boundary essence that Sakura could only liken it to be similar to a variation of the ancient shape of Mana!
If it was just this, Sakura wouldn't be astonished as there were many different sources of Boundary Essences mixing around in this space from this being alone.

The issue was...the silver tendrils of Nullity and the cerulean tendrils of a shape of Mana were beautifully dancing and wrapping around each other as when they reached the highest point in the skies bounded by a verdant Planar Domain...the colors of silver and blue buzzed and mixed on a stupendous level as a heavy, primitive, and utterly wild aura instantly blared out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2359 Utter Trash! II
paragraphs: A heavy, primitive, and utterly wild aura instantly blared out!
'This...'
Ayame realized what was happening as it was something she had seen before.
Something that she had seen...only the most accomplished Apex Aeonic Lifeforms begin to do.
'The Amalgamation of different Boundary Concepts into one? That's...'
WAA!
Yes!
This was why she was shocked!
She wanted to say it was impossible!
She wanted to say that the action of beginning to fuse different Boundary Concepts was only possible for Boundaries that had reached the 10th Layer!
She wanted to say that only those who had established their Aeonic Extremity Meridians could do this!

She wanted to say a lot of things, but the scene before her defied all of her expectations as even though it seemed unstable and not fully there- the silver and blue Essences truly intermixed as a penetrative and deadly essence that caused even her own Aeonic Soul to tingle from afar tried to come to fruition.

It caused her shock, but for the Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity who were already beginning to feel overwhelmed by the ridiculous output of abilities from multiple Consummate Boundaries of this being...it actually caused a sense of fear to begin sprouting!

And even though it was the beginnings of fear, these beings reacted very quickly- especially the one called Titus as he seemed to have made up his mind, his humanoid form breaking apart as the image of a Celestial silver gold Planar Halcyon Sparrow bloomed!

The other Haven Disciples did the same as this also surprised Ayame, where when she read these beings earlier, she had seen they were about ready to abandon this venture if it was proving too much trouble for them.

The beginnings of the amalgamation of two Boundary Essences hit the nail on the coffin for such a risk as instead of running, they were actually staking it all? Ayame squinted her eyes as her expression turned sour soon after.

She realized why these Haven Disciples did what they did as her perceptive eyes very quickly caught onto waves of communication traversing across space and time- but they were Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as always!
HOONG!

Her eyes erupted with glorious light as her hands reached out, grasping onto these waves of communication as she saw they were intended to spread out to all the groups of Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity currently in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
Their message was simple.

<We have located a Mutated Entity who has inexhaustible resource reserves and can also spark the fusion of Boundary Concepts before reaching the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level! If we can grasp his secrets for ourselves, Extremity will be ever closer to our grasp. The danger level is high so...>

The more she read the message, the angrier Ayame became as she crushed the waves of this communication in her hands and spread out an unseen light that locked down any forms of communication in this region!
'You pick a fight with someone out of greed and when things get dangerous, you seek help? Rubbish.'
Her gaze was piercing as she felt immense distaste for these beings, her crimson horn beginning to release a deadly light!

'If you wish to attain something that can bring you ever closer to Extremity, achieve it with your own hands...or die from overestimating yourselves. What utter fucking trash...'I think you should take a look at

She felt billowing anger from their actions as Ayame made a move through the very Aenic Annals of Extremity to prevent ongoing and outgoing forms of communication, her eyes coming to focus on a certain being who was moving with a dominating momentum as he seemed to be in an extended state of an epiphany!
For Noah, it was akin to a myriad of factors coming together that instantly ushered him into a state of epiphany.
Before he even entered the Havens of Extremity, he had pondered on trying to bring together Mana and Nullity!
He later found out that the only possibility for him to do so was to expand both of these concepts into Boundaries- and only then could he even have a chance of performing such a task.
And when both Ruin and Nullity began to surge across their Boundary Layers, Noah once more felt a familiar pull.
A pull between Mana and Nullity as Noah also felt a slightly weaker pull with Mana and Ruin!
And as if it was a chain reaction, the origin of his Main Body pulsed as an instant later, it felt like all of his Sources of Extremity were pulsing and resonating with Manadynamics.
With the Aeonic Mana of Extremity!

But all the other pulls and resonances didn't currently feel as potent as it was between Mana and Nullity, where Noah knew that if he tried to bring anything together...he would have the greatest chance of success with these two!

He truly didn't know why, but he closed off all his other senses and focused on this as he felt the Manadynamics surge, his Aeonic Mana of Extremity feeling the familiarity of not just a Boundary, but something that had the potential to transform into another concept entirely.
HOONG!
His Aeonic Soul led the way as it wept out with glory, Noah's main body raising his right hand up in the depths of the Infinite Reality as tendrils of Mana and Nullity rose up with it.

And when he did this action, his clones in the Infinite Plane and all other clones also found themselves raising their right hand as tendrils of silver and blue flashed with gorgeous radiance, a burst of information beginning to course through Noah's mind at this moment as he felt like understood things somewhat!
His Aeonic Mana of Extremity that stemmed from Manadynamics was a profound authority connected to Extremity.
It was from a natural law that at its basis...told of how essence was neither created nor destroyed, only changed into different forms!
Then came the state of verisimilitude, Nullity.
Nothingness.
No inherent quality apart from nothingness as this Boundary did not have an identity as pronounced as others!
What could be easier than to pair a Boundary that specialized in changing into different forms with a Boundary that was already formless?
BZZZT!
A spark of inspiration.
A flash of glory!
And then...an explosion of prompts cascaded down!

Her eyes erupted with glorious light as her hands reached out, grasping onto these waves of communication as she saw they were intended to spread out to all the groups of Haven Disciples of the Genesis Institute of Extremity currently in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
Their message was simple.
<We have located a Mutated Entity who has inexhaustible resource reserves and can also spark the fusion of Boundary Concepts before reaching the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level!
If we can grasp his secrets for ourselves, Extremity will be ever closer to our grasp.
The danger level is high so...>

The more she read the message, the angrier Ayame became as she crushed the waves of this communication in her hands and spread out an unseen light that locked down any forms of communication in this region!
'You pick a fight with someone out of greed and when things get dangerous, you seek help?
Rubbish.'
Her gaze was piercing as she felt immense distaste for these beings, her crimson horn beginning to release a deadly light!
'If you wish to attain something that can bring you ever closer to Extremity, achieve it with your own hands...or die from overestimating yourselves.
What utter fucking trash...'I think you should take a look at

She felt billowing anger from their actions as Ayame made a move through the very Aenic Annals of Extremity to prevent ongoing and outgoing forms of communication, her eyes coming to focus on a certain being who was moving with a dominating momentum as he seemed to be in an extended state of an epiphany!
For Noah, it was akin to a myriad of factors coming together that instantly ushered him into a state of epiphany.
Before he even entered the Havens of Extremity, he had pondered on trying to bring together Mana and Nullity!
He later found out that the only possibility for him to do so was to expand both of these concepts into Boundaries- and only then could he even have a chance of performing such a task.
And when both Ruin and Nullity began to surge across their Boundary Layers, Noah once more felt a familiar pull.
A pull between Mana and Nullity as Noah also felt a slightly weaker pull with Mana and Ruin!
And as if it was a chain reaction, the origin of his Main Body pulsed as an instant later, it felt like all of his Sources of Extremity were pulsing and resonating with Manadynamics.
With the Aeonic Mana of Extremity!

But all the other pulls and resonances didn't currently feel as potent as it was between Mana and Nullity, where Noah knew that if he tried to bring anything together...he would have the greatest chance of success with these two!

He truly didn't know why, but he closed off all his other senses and focused on this as he felt the Manadynamics surge, his Aeonic Mana of Extremity feeling the familiarity of not just a Boundary, but something that had the potential to transform into another concept entirely.
HOONG!
His Aeonic Soul led the way as it wept out with glory, Noah's main body raising his right hand up in the depths of the Infinite Reality as tendrils of Mana and Nullity rose up with it.

And when he did this action, his clones in the Infinite Plane and all other clones also found themselves raising their right hand as tendrils of silver and blue flashed with gorgeous radiance, a burst of information beginning to course through Noah's mind at this moment as he felt like understood things somewhat!
His Aeonic Mana of Extremity that stemmed from Manadynamics was a profound authority connected to Extremity.
It was from a natural law that at its basis...told of how essence was neither created nor destroyed, only changed into different forms!
Then came the state of verisimilitude, Nullity.
Nothingness.
No inherent quality apart from nothingness as this Boundary did not have an identity as pronounced as others!
What could be easier than to pair a Boundary that specialized in changing into different forms with a Boundary that was already formless?
BZZZT!
A spark of inspiration.
A flash of glory!
And then...an explosion of prompts cascaded down!

chapters.title: Chapter 2360 Immovable! I
paragraphs: It was something that many beings thought differently about as it made up a core part of the power of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Others thought of it as the Amalgamation of different Threads of Extremity.
Others thought of it as the fusion of Concepts of Extremity.
Extremity itself could be seen as a collection of countless pathways, and those powerful enough could at a certain point in time pull together these pathways to produce even more astonishing paths!
Even more astonishing concepts as the type of essence produced from it...was on another level entirely.
But there were strict requirements in doing so!
Yet before the eyes of the True Emperor of Quintessence...glorious prompts arose.
<You have successfully sparked the convergence of two Boundaries of Extremity.>
<The Aeonic Annals of Extremity have recorded your accomplishments as you gain an even deeper understanding and access!>

These were the first set of prompts as Noah saw the cerulean light of the Aeonic Mana of Extremity and the silvery light of Nullity mixing, a blinding light being birthed from it as it took all of Noah's concentration and the concentration of his clones to simply keep the two energies together!
His Aeonic Soul Values were rapidly being depleted as it felt extremely hard to keep the two Sources of Extremity together, and it wasn't until a set of prompts came that Noah found it easier.
<The Eighth Boundary Layer of Nullity has been achieved.>
<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Nullity has been achieved.>
WAA!
Only when Nullity also reached the 9th Boundary Layer did the Resonance gain a sense of stabilization.

The two concepts were on the same stage as Noah found the effort required to keep them together was greatly reduced, and he could more efficiently mix these Essences as the brand new source of power rising from it began to flourish with even greater majesty!
<The Full Convergence of Manadynamics and Nullity is 1% completed and progressing further.>
<You have discovered a new unnamed form of energy!>
<Through the Convergence of two Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer, the Rank 1 Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has been born!>
An Unnamed form of energy!
When one tried fusing two Boundaries of Extremity together, they opened the pathway to a new form of power that was termed Dynamis of Extremity.
Dynamis!
A word that had many meanings, among which included potentiality, authority, and an immovable force or power!
All beings bringing together different Threads of Extremity would birth new and varying types of Dynamis of Extremity.
New forms of authorities whose power was unknown as the only authority that could withstand it was something similar.

So when Noah bought together the Aeonic Mana of Extremity and intertwined it with Nullity to birth a type of Dynamis of Extremity that he needed to coin the name of, how could his enemies that had yet to grasp this type of power stand against him?!
<Your Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity is in a rudimentary state until you can complete its process of Convergence.>
<The effects of your Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity can only be discovered by utilizing it on yourself or others.>
<Your rate of progression towards Extremity on all Boundaries has been increased by an unknown factor!>

The prompts came down one after another as by this time, Noah's soul found stability from the fearsome power he called out as above all of his bodies that had their hands stretched upwards- they could see a radiant color of blue gray...a color commonly known as lividus!
It shone with blinding metallic cerulean radiance as this lividus color of light hung in the space above Noah's clones like a cataclysmic bomb that could dominate everything to oblivion.
Dynamis.
A type of energy that was immovable!
A type of energy that had the potential to transform into something others could only dream of!

Noah's senses wrapped fully around it as he felt his spent Aeonic Soul begin to recover rapidly, his body beginning to pull in this Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity into his own Aspects of Existence and beginning to circulate it as he felt every single one of his cells down to their very atoms beginning to buzz.
At the same time, he had his True Sanguine Clone in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands make a move as his hand that was raised to the skies...swung down like a verdict towards his enemies!
At a junction between a perilous future or running away...Titus chose the former.
This was because the being before him was entirely too special, with everything culminating in him pulling together two Threads of Extremity!
Something that one needed to have Aeonic Extremity Meridians to do as these different paths of Extremity had to at least be at the 10th Boundary Layer.
But this being defied that reality.
And Titus wanted to understand how he did so as even under the threat of losing the lives of Haven Disciples or even himself...he risked it all!
After all, something like this was at the same level as Extremity Panaceas if not greater as it nearing one of the things that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had to do in order to get close to Extremity!
He comprehended the risks and the possible benefits as he sought for help that should arrive very soon after he sent a message.
He understood it, but...
SAA!
He couldn't help but feel a tinge of rising remorse as he felt the pulsing metallic blue light surge down with a command from this being.
<Use your Apex Aeonic Soul Tot->
He saw this essence that caused his soul to feel a prickling sensation go towards one of the Haven Disciples close to it as this Essence...was too fast!
Even before an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem could be utilized, the metallic blue light arrived before him.

And a scene that caused their scalps to tingle unfolded as this Haven Disciple's Soul felt unmatched danger, his Planar Halcyon Sparrow form releasing over a dozen silver gold strongholds of defensive lights that would take concurrent attacks from over a dozen Unequaled Reverend Emperors to get past!

chapters.title: Chapter 2361 Immovable! II
paragraphs: Over a dozen silver gold bastions of defensive lights that would take simultaneous strikes from over a dozen Unequaled Reverend Emperors to get past were released.

Yet when the metallic blue essence arrived...these layers of defensive lights didn't even receive an impact as the Boundary Essence that made them...seemingly turned into a hazy state, instantly changing its colors from silver gold to metallic blue as the descending power that was a fusion between two Boundary Essences cleanly cut through- its concentration even increasing the more it moved forward!
Others may not be able to see what the intricacies behind it were, but Titus saw it clear as day as he felt his soul shake.

The metallic blue essence didn't meet any resistance where it went as it instantly changed the nature of the opposing essence that stood before it, transformed it into an essence akin to it, absorbed it, and nullified everything entirely!
When it came across an opposing essence, it entirely altered it and devoured it to become a part of its strengths as it became ever more concentrated and faster.

It meant that the layers of defenses that should have taken even Titus at least ten strikes to get through...were entirely bypassed and shredded in an instant as the metallic blue light smashed into the body of the glorious Haven Disciple!
There was no explosion, blinding light, or a booming impact.
The terrifying light sunk into the body of the Haven Disciple freely as an instant later...all light and life force emanating from this being disappeared.

All the stellar silver gold radiance around this Planar Halcyon Sparrow disappeared as its massive body began tumbling to the ground below- golden dreamy sands reaching out to grasp it as if they were welcoming the corpse to its eternal grave!
And from its body, the terrific metallic blue light emerged with even greater vibrancy and power as it instantly shot towards another direction.

Titus saw this scene as he felt as if his soul was standing on pins and needles, instantly pulling out two Apex Aeonic Soul Totems and activating the first one to release a silver gold light that protectively hugged his body!
<Fuck...fuck, fuck!>

Expletives escaped his mouth as he saw the deadly light that he assumed to be a type of Dynamis of Extremity wildly rush towards another Haven Disciple- everyone here beginning to feel surging waves of danger as their destinies warned them of their possible ends!
Titus looked at the unfolding scenes as he once more felt like he stood at a crossroads of choices.
Choices!
Had he made any right choices today?
Was the choice he was currently on the right one?
'And why the hell haven't I received any replies yet?!'
He screamed inwardly as by now, he should've heard back from other groups of his Genesis Institute of Extremity or even have some of the more powerful beings near this location.
His choice to stay on this path was dependent on them- and this was why he had called for help!
When he had this thought, his soul trembled as he was forced to remember something one of his most prized teachers had told him a hundred years ago.

<Titus, you will come across many trials in your life. Something you need to remember is that in all of them, your life should always lie in the palm of your hands. If you ever find yourself relying more on Totems or the strength of others, you are leaving your life in the hands of Destiny. And destiny...is very, very fickle.>
WAA!
This memory blazed in his mind as he shuddered!
He...he had actually risked his life on the premise of relying on others to come and aid him.
How did he miss this? How did he forget something so critical?!
'Damn.'
Seeing the unfolding situation and putting his life in his own hands...he instantly made another choice.
Among the decisions he made today, this was the single most right one!
BZZT!

His magnificent Planar Halcyon Sparrow form turned around to instantly make a withdrawal and leave the battlefield as he forsaken his goal of obtaining the secrets of this Mysterious Entity right then and there!
Even though he had sacrificed many things to gain nothing, he would not put his life on the line any longer when this Entity revealed too many unknowns.
So he made the right choice, but...
BOOM!
His massive silver gold body was frozen in place as he felt his neck constricted, a voice reaching his ears as it originated much too close to him!
<I told you...that I would fuck you up.>

While they were all focused on the horrifying metallic blue essence and what it was doing, they had lost sight of the man himself as he appeared right in front of Titus's retreating figure, his right hand clamped on his feathery neck as it felt like an Extremity Metalloid had clamped down on his body!
Vibrant metallic blue light covered the skin of this being as he looked like a devilish creature emanating essence from Unrecorded Aeons!

Yes, Titus had made the right choice. He had even made this choice as he chose to retreat first without alerting the Haven Disciples that followed him to this change- all for the sake of buying time for his retreat!
He made the right choice, the only problem was...he made it too late.

The silver gold defensive layer born from an Apex Aeonic Soul Totem around him didn't disappear as this being had forcefully constricted it onto Titus's feathery skin, the metallic blue glow around his hand clashing and shockingly pulverizing the power of this Totem ever so slowly as it actually seemed to win over it!

Titus had one more Apex Aeonic Soul Totem that he crushed at this moment to cause an attack to bloom right in front of the head of this being, silver gold light illuminating him as a boundless cluster of claws unfurled inches before his face.
And all there was...
BZZZT!
Was a scathing clash of Essences as the metallic blue luster on his skin actually kept the essence of Apex Aeonic Soul Totem at bay!
Titus's heart dropped at such a scene as a horrifying outcome neared this startling battle!
