chapters.title: Chapter 2372 The Vein Of Dissolution! IV
paragraphs: Utterly massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution silently stood atop floating obelisks in the distance while existences stemming from different Havens gathered.

Noah stared calmly at all of them while observing the best possible paths for him to take, with him currently gathering information as his Will and the Wills of many beings here locked onto the figure that had risen to address others!
Phos of the Extremity of Light from the Aeonic Haven of Helios!

The magic circle beneath his feet radiated Light through his body as he seemed too dazzling for any others here, his hair shining with a stellar white and blue luster as even when Ayame of the Infinite Extremity rose up and spoke, he remained unfettered.
His smile only became wider as he continued.
"Friend from the Infinite Extremity...I simply feel great benevolence towards others here, which is why I propose this to actually be in their favor."
"Oh?" Ayame's stellar crimson horn shone sharply as she smiled back at this being who continued with an unfettered momentum while nodding.

"Yes. There are those like me and you from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity that have deep histories and power across the myriad Havens. Others cannot even touch us in power alone, not to mention the Inheritances that stand behind us."
Yes!
Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity!
Factions that were stretched out across eons and had their accomplishments Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity in abundance!
Factions with dense reserves of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and terrifying beings that had reached Extremity.
They reigned above other Inheritances and Factions as the Extremity of Light that Phos stemmed from and the Infinite Extremity that Ayame stemmed from were some of them.
And they knew it.
Phos knew the power and weight he held, and the even greater power behind him.

And he wasn't alone because as he spoke...other distinguished groups atop crimson and silver obelisks from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity also rose up with grandeur and power as they seemed to agree with the words of Phos!

"The discrepancy between us is too large. So to prevent any mishaps...those of us from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity will make a move first and retain ownership of any upcoming Extremity Panaceas. Once those from the Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity have obtained a sufficient number of Extremity Panaceas, the rest can begin to make moves."
WAA!
A devilishly charming smile was present on Phos as if he had ushered forth a truly magnanimous solution.
Groups from the Genesis Institute of Extremity and other factions that were a level below Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity adopted somber expressions as their eyes turned sharp.

"Oh my..." Ayame had a surprised expression on her face as she nodded while placing her fair hand on her chin thoughtfully, her fiery red gold strands of hair seeming like burning flames as she spoke out mockingly.
"...How very magnanimous of you. As expected of one of the Fanatics of Light. You always seek the best interests of others."I think you should take a look at
Her tone was clear in its mocking and disdain.
Those from the Extremity of Radiance had their eyes turn sharp as the magic runic circles below their feet turned, but Phos kept his charming smile as he looked at Ayame.
He gazed at her stellar crimson horn and exceedingly beautiful face as he knew her identity.
How could he not?

Even though she was from the Aeonic Haven of Genesis, Phos and all other prominent beings from Aeonic Inheritances of Ultimacy knew those rivaling them as their factions were not isolated over the eons- many meetings occurring between them as the last time he saw her...was less than a hundred years ago during the Centennial Exchange of Extremity.

A gathering when prominent powerhouses of Inheritances exchanged their ideologies and power, showing the extent their Limits took them towards Extremity as all those in the Boundary Expansion Realm could participate!
Reverend Emperors had their own stage.
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had even grander stages as their exchanges were the highlight whenever they occurred- drawing an immense number of audiences and powerhouses.
Phos remembered seeing this crimson horned existence from the Infinite Ultimacy in the last Centennial Exchange of Extremity.

He didn't meet her in battle, but he saw her unrelenting might as she dominated one prodigy after another from multiple Inheritances before she grew bored and was escorted away by an Existence that had reached Ultimacy before the matches even ended!
An existence that had reached Extremity...was escorting her!
So even as she spoke mockingly right now towards him, he raised his hand and calmed those below him while keeping his devilish charm.

"Yes, I am simply thinking about the positions of other Inheritances and giving them a way out. They can't match up to us in power, and even if they did...would they dare fight seriously to injure or even kill those from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity? Their whole Lineages and Inheritances would be erased as where is the fairness in that? So they can only wait their turn until all those from the Aeonic Inheritances of Ultimacy obtain their Extremity Panaceas, then they can fight amongst themselves thereafter..."
His words resounded all around as many other groups gazed on coldly while not saying a word.
Others clenched their fists, but when they truly thought about it- he wasn't wrong!

Ayame's scoffing expression became that of displeasure as she stared towards Luminance and other groups that gazed on coldly from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity, traces of disappointment swirling in her eyes as she was about to speak once more when...
"Ah, what about me though?"
A voice rang out from the same obelisk she floated off.
A voice that didn't carry an ounce of fear as it even vibrated immense regality and grandeur.

It stemmed from a devilishly handsome man letting off a radiant glow of an Emperor- a stellar multicolored spear and shield grasped on each of his hands as he looked like a gladiator from ancient times!
He spoke off freely as in the surrounding space, Entropy began to rise as chaos slowly built up!

Once those from the Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity have obtained a sufficient number of Extremity Panaceas, the rest can begin to make moves."
WAA!
A devilishly charming smile was present on Phos as if he had ushered forth a truly magnanimous solution.
Groups from the Genesis Institute of Extremity and other factions that were a level below Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity adopted somber expressions as their eyes turned sharp.

"Oh my..." Ayame had a surprised expression on her face as she nodded while placing her fair hand on her chin thoughtfully, her fiery red gold strands of hair seeming like burning flames as she spoke out mockingly.
"...How very magnanimous of you.
As expected of one of the Fanatics of Light.
You always seek the best interests of others."I think you should take a look at
Her tone was clear in its mocking and disdain.
Those from the Extremity of Radiance had their eyes turn sharp as the magic runic circles below their feet turned, but Phos kept his charming smile as he looked at Ayame.
He gazed at her stellar crimson horn and exceedingly beautiful face as he knew her identity.
How could he not?

Even though she was from the Aeonic Haven of Genesis, Phos and all other prominent beings from Aeonic Inheritances of Ultimacy knew those rivaling them as their factions were not isolated over the eons- many meetings occurring between them as the last time he saw her...was less than a hundred years ago during the Centennial Exchange of Extremity.

A gathering when prominent powerhouses of Inheritances exchanged their ideologies and power, showing the extent their Limits took them towards Extremity as all those in the Boundary Expansion Realm could participate!
Reverend Emperors had their own stage.
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had even grander stages as their exchanges were the highlight whenever they occurred- drawing an immense number of audiences and powerhouses.
Phos remembered seeing this crimson horned existence from the Infinite Ultimacy in the last Centennial Exchange of Extremity.

He didn't meet her in battle, but he saw her unrelenting might as she dominated one prodigy after another from multiple Inheritances before she grew bored and was escorted away by an Existence that had reached Ultimacy before the matches even ended!
An existence that had reached Extremity...was escorting her!
So even as she spoke mockingly right now towards him, he raised his hand and calmed those below him while keeping his devilish charm.
"Yes, I am simply thinking about the positions of other Inheritances and giving them a way out.
They can't match up to us in power, and even if they did...would they dare fight seriously to injure or even kill those from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity?
Their whole Lineages and Inheritances would be erased as where is the fairness in that?
So they can only wait their turn until all those from the Aeonic Inheritances of Ultimacy obtain their Extremity Panaceas, then they can fight amongst themselves thereafter..."
His words resounded all around as many other groups gazed on coldly while not saying a word.
Others clenched their fists, but when they truly thought about it- he wasn't wrong!

Ayame's scoffing expression became that of displeasure as she stared towards Luminance and other groups that gazed on coldly from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity, traces of disappointment swirling in her eyes as she was about to speak once more when...
"Ah, what about me though?"
A voice rang out from the same obelisk she floated off.
A voice that didn't carry an ounce of fear as it even vibrated immense regality and grandeur.

It stemmed from a devilishly handsome man letting off a radiant glow of an Emperor- a stellar multicolored spear and shield grasped on each of his hands as he looked like a gladiator from ancient times!
He spoke off freely as in the surrounding space, Entropy began to rise as chaos slowly built up!

chapters.title: Chapter 2373 The Vein Of Dissolution! V
paragraphs: "Ah, what about me though?"
The tone of these words was too damn calm and carefree.
To Phos, it felt even worse than hearing the words of Ayame as his eyes and the eyes of many turned towards a certain crimson obelisk.
An obelisk where the True Emperor of Quintessence began to rise in the air while looking towards Phos and the others head-on!
The words felt mocking.
It felt as if this being didn't have an ounce of fear towards Phos and or what Inheritance stood behind him!
"Who the fuck are you?" The happy expression on Phos disappeared from being interrupted by a nobody as he spoke with a cold smile.

Others watched on with intrigue as they knew the power of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity well, and no being would dare to insert themselves in a situation like this unless they had backing...or they were extremely dumb!
Since all of them were existences that had lived for a great deal of years and pondered on Extremity, they gave a benefit of the doubt towards the former as many eyes watched on sharply.
Was it another being similar to the crimson horned Ayame from an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity, or...
His voice was magnetic as it rang out clearly for all beings to hear.

"I don't belong to any big Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity nor any Inheritances outside this Haven like you all. I'm just an aboriginal from this Haven of Dissolution as I wonder...when do you think I can make a move to also obtain the Extremity Panaceas stemming from the Initiating Extremity Vein of my home Haven?"
WAA!
The space filled with crimson and silver radiance brightened up evermore as many Wills came to focus on Noah.
His eyes carried no trace of fear as his words felt carefree!
As if in this domain, nobody could even touch him!

"Hah..." Phos shook his head and laughed with a hint of disbelief at the words uttered out as the magic circle below his feet shone with even greater brilliance, his smile turning cold as he looked towards Noah with a hint of playfulness.

"I thought all Aboriginals were left behind in the outer fringes before even getting here so I didn't consider you, little guy. Naturally, you can have your chance to fight for the opportunities after all of us here get what we need. And just a warning before you open your mouth again- I will tolerate your initial disrespectfulness, but anything more than that..."
BZZT!
Terrifying waves of Haki barreled out from him that caused those nearby to feel a sense of dread.

They contained the essence of over a dozen Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer along with a hint of something else that was unknown...the mere waves of the soul of this being released in the form of his Will causing others to feel stifled as his Aeonic Soul Values seemed to exceed the normal bounds of Reverends!
"Oh?" Yet the being this was directed to remained floating undaunted.

Ayame watched on as an intrigued smile rose on her face, while prominent Reverend Emperors from other Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity watched on calmly and lazily, while Phos and other groups from the Aeonic Haven of Helios watched on coldly!
And under the gazes of all these beings in front of him as well as the completely unmoving Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution situated on obelisks behind him, he spoke out grandly.
"Well, it seems I must make a proposal as well..."I think you should take a look at
His devilishly handsome features became apparent to all as the aura of Quintessence began to swirl around him.

"...You see, I think the discrepancy between me and you all is much too large, and I do not wish to accidentally butcher any fools from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity while I'm seeking the Extremity Panaceas. So I shall move first and retain ownership of any upcoming Extremity Panaceas, and once I feel like I've gotten enough...then you all can begin to make your moves."
BOOM!
His words were akin to a thundering hammer that smashed into the surroundings, with the Reverend Emperors here having to confirm they heard correctly as their eyes constricted at such a development!
And this being wasn't done as he continued, his tone seeming sincere as if he was only speaking the truth!
Something everyone also noticed was how his words...seemed to be very similar to what Phos of the Aeonic Haven of Helios had said!

"I'm only thinking about the positions of you fools from all these different Inheritances and giving you a way out. After all, if you start dying towards me and your whole teams get wiped out, would your Inheritances be able to handle my fury when they inevitably come seeking revenge? Can you imagine it? Can you imagine your Extremity of Light and other Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity all wiped out just because a dumb fuck like you decided to float up and commence speaking gibberish? So, you should really hold off your opportunity as when I'm done taking however many Extremity Panaceas I need, you can fight together for what remains. How does that sound?"
Immense silence descended.
Utter and intense silence!
Ayame's pink lips opened into an "O" as even she was dumbfounded!
She had seen through the power of this being and knew where he came from, but for him to just speak like this...
"Haha!" Laughter couldn't help but escape her lips at this development!
'The True Emperor of Quintessence, huh? Well, you have the balls for it, I'll give you that!'
An additional hint of interest was added in her mind when it came to this being, but even though she reacted half-heartedly...there was the being that these words were directed to.
There was Phos of the Extremity of Light from the Aeonic Haven of Helios.

This being's facial muscle muscles trembled as the magic runic circle below him released a blinding radiance, all other groups from the Extremity of Light exploding with such blinding glow as their facial expressions turned from coldness to rage and killing intent!
But...this wasn't all.
Noah didn't just attack Phos with his words.
He attacked the Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity behind him...and the Inheritances of all those here who went with his words or didn't speak out against him!
He effectively talked back against beings that nobody ever talked back against...and poked a group of utterly powerful beings nobody would ever dare to even touch!
This...was taboo!

chapters.title: Chapter 2374 The Vein Of Dissolution! VI
paragraphs: He spoke against existences that normally never had anybody speak against!
He defamed the name and distinction of the Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity!
The being affected the most by this was Phos, with Noah's eyes staring directly at him when he spoke.
The gaze of this being turned utterly hostile along with multiple other groups from the Extremity of Light...and even some groups from different Inheritances!
But...there were over half of all the Reverends here who remained utterly still and watched on coldly.
Some held truly deep and ancient Inheritances similar to Ayame as even events like these seemed beneath them, one such group being 10 Reverend adorned in pure pink robes.
A runic etching of a flower petal could be seen for their pupils as they gave off an overabundance of life and power!
A Reverend Emperor positioned last within this group spoke up at this moment in a way that only those around him could hear.
"Did he really just say that? For him to actually have the gall..."
Anger could be seen rising on his face as before he could continue...

"You dumbass, that's not what you need to be thinking of." A prominent voice cut him off as the being that had spoken prior turned very respectful towards a man with a demeanor of a long standing Emperor in the lead of this group.
"Senior Brother Atlas..." He spoke cautiously as he waited for this being whose hair and brows shone with a stellar pink color to continue speaking.

"You shouldn't be thinking along the lines of that he actually had the gall to say what he said. Your line of thought should be the fact that he knows about Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity and sees the sheer power of all beings here, and regardless of all that....he still said what he said. What does that mean?"
WAA!
A profound light of power shone in the flower petal pupils of Senior Brother Atlas as he asked this question, the junior brother behind him hesitating briefly before he replied with firmness!
"It should be that he's somehow confident to say that and come out unscathed. Does he actually have a backing?"

"You're finally getting some sense. And it doesn't matter if he has backing or not. No being that has cultivated to the stage of a Reverend would suddenly turn suicidal. So for him to do what he did, he is either baiting others to attack him, or he is simply someone potent enough that he took offense to the words of that fool and couldn't just sit back. Either way...it has nothing to do with us. Understood, Junior Brother Jax?"

His gaze was unshakable as he questioned, Jax nodding powerfully soon after as this group of beings stared closely at what was unfolding before them, their Wills also ready to act as they looked at the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution and the region past the many Obelisks.

They stemmed from another Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity with extremely deep history, their grandeur also rooted in the Aeonic Haven of Helios as they stemmed from the faction known as The Plum Sword of Extremity!
The one termed Senior Brother Atlas gazed towards Noah as he crossed his hand behind him, speaking as if he was imparting lessons to the Junior Brothers and Sisters behind him.

"In the vastness of Extremity, there are countless oddities, anomalies, and even Mutated Entities. When you see something that doesn't necessarily make sense, do not be so quick to anger or have your pride take over rationality. Just in this domain right now, there are likely multiple beings like me with a Mutated Aspect of Existence or special in their own way, with power exceeding what normal Unequaled Reverend Emperors can muster. Don't be so quick in seeking death by jumping on every little thing...death will come soon enough."
WAA! I think you should take a look at
His words resonated in the minds of others from the Plum Sword of Extremity as they nodded and watched on carefully!
This group of beings wasn't the only one as over half of all Emperors here maintained aloofness and calmness in this situation, whether they stemmed from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity or not.
They knew their purpose here and would act accordingly as events unfolded, many choosing not to jump headfirst into a situation with a lot of unknowns!
Some of the more potent beings who were offended by Noah's words...even sat back and watched to allow others to test him before they decided to make any moves or not!
But...there were still those whose pride was stepped on enough for them to act regardless of the background of everything.

Among all Reverend Emperors here, the one who felt as if all gazes gathered onto him and his standing after he was rebuffed by an mysterious being...Phos was the first one to make a move as his voice boomed out.
"I care not what backing you have...the dignity of the Extremity of Light cannot be stepped on."
Brilliance flashed.
The magic runic circle below his feet radiated pristine splendor as in the next second, his figure entirely disappeared.
[Superluminal Burst]
His voice was the only thing that could be heard as thereafter...
BOOM!

A heavy and dense impact that would eviscerate any normal Unequaled Reverend Emperors resounded as the visage of Phos appeared right before Noah, his fist covered by layers of light as his speed...was utterly monstrous!
Superluminal!
Speed that far, far exceeded light.
It was something all beings stemming from the Extremity of Light located in the Aeonic Haven of Helios were very prideful of.
Speed that their enemies couldn't even match as when they attacked, the battle was usually over!
And yet...
Phos's eyes became ever sharper as he saw this being's eyes actually follow him, where he was even able to react and bring his shield up to meet his punch at this very moment!

Booming tendrils of essence surged between the two of them as the stellar entity holding the Spear and shield didn't move a step back, while the power of Phos seemed fixed as glow and light overflowed around him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2375 The Vein Of Dissolution! VII
paragraphs: Phos was surprised.
But opposite to him, Noah was also surprised as he gazed at the being before him.
His Shield was surrounded by the metallic blue luster of the Unknown Dynamis of Extremity, and yet this being opposed it without losing to it due to a dense layering of essence that covered his hand!

Essence that contained over a dozen Boundaries weaved together in a fantastical way as they bore fruit to something even greater- whatever this something was being the factor that actually allowed this being to clash with Noah.

Granted, the Convergence of the Unknown Dynamis of Extremity had not even come close to 100% as this Essence was not complete, but it was capable of rivaling and even penetrating Apex Aeonic Soul Totems!
What did Phos from an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity have that Titus from a lesser Inheritance didn't have?
Noah looked at this being closely as even while standing before him and feeling the pulsing immensity of a Energy of Extremity- whether he recognized it or not, this being was fearless.
His billowing blue robe and pulsing runic lights made him look like a Battle Magi from ancient times as he pulled his hand wrapped in layers of essence while he spoke out.
"There are anomalies and Mutated Entities out there who believe themselves to be the best."
WAA!

"You may have thought this way and decided to say what you said, but even if that may be so...you did not just denounce me. You denounced many beings here and the Inheritances behind them as whatever power you may hold...I am not alone."
As he spoke, dozens of lights flashed as heavy auras moved.
Those from his Extremity of Light were the fastest as dozens surrounded the whole periphery in an instant.
Then other Inheritances from the Aeonic Haven of Helios moved as soon after...multiple other groups followed suit!
Yes, many of the powerful Unequaled Reverend Emperors here did not make a move.
Many simply sat back and watched the show.
But the provocation Noah had uttered out was still one that some of these prideful beings could not take lying down!
They knew that many terrifying Entities existed out there, but they still didn't fear as each of them was in a group that came from powerful Inheritances.
And there were multiple groups here each more terrifying than the last as there was strength in numbers!
And the strength of groups of Unequaled Reverend Emperors from Inheritances across the Aeonic Havens...was utterly dreadful!

"Since the grandeur of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity does not seem to be known in this Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, let us use you as an example to instill it while reminding all others. There is a reason why we remain Recorded throughout History. There is a reason why we lead the masses towards Extremity. For you to disparage us...is to disparage the very concept of Extremity itself!"
BOOOM!
"Apex Aeonic Relics will not save you. Apex Aeonic Soul Totems will not save you...even the intrusion of a genuine Apex Aeonic Lifeform will not save you. Not from us."

His voice was magnetic as atop the obelisk Noah floated on, a few hundred immense powerful existences gathered and placed their scrutiny on a single being- something that even the renowned Mutated Entities here wouldn't want to face as some watched with curious eyes from afar.
In the midst of it all was Noah.I think you should take a look at
Carrying his Xyston and Aegis, he floated at the center of this all as he seemed like an indomitable champion undaunted by the reality around him!
Why did he react and say what he did towards the ridiculous words of Phos?
Firstly, his nature as the Tyrannical Emperor- as the True Emperor of Quintessence...didn't allow for him to simply follow the commanding words of another and take a step back to not seek Loot!
The other...was that he needed the pressure.
Providence showed many paths as this particularly difficult one...was the one that guaranteed his complete Convergence of Manadynamics and Nullity to come the fastest.
If he could survive it that is!
And when it came to the tools of survival he had at his disposal, there were already many.
And at this very moment, Providence and Destiny told him he was about to get an even grander tool!
At the depths of the Infinite Plane, within its very Source of Reality.
Noah's main body was releasing milky waves of multicolored radiance as his Origin was undergoing major remodifications currently.

Apart from the tower-like First Plane of Extremity that was contained in its own continuum, an even more massive and grander domain began to come together above it as it utilized the Templates of its Minor Planes to begin the establishment of Major Planes of Existence!

Above the First Plane of Extremity, the Second Plane of Extremity began to form as the Templates of 9 Dimensional Realities that would grow to become Major Planes were being built one singularity after another as Noah send in the essence of all Planar Origin Panaceas he obtained from his recent enemies, with his bound Sources of Extremity also acting to spur the formation, expansion, and reinforcement of the sprouting Planes as the essence of his Boundaries permeated throughout!
The Essences of his Sources of Extremity.
HOONG!

When all the Sources of his enacted Boundaries wrapped around the Templates of Planes of the Second Plane of Extremity along with their prior connection to his First Plane of Extremity...immense radiance overflowed as prompts rose before his eyes.
[You have stably bound 36 Sources of Extremity with your expanding Origin.]

[The Completion of the First Plane of Extremity and the Initiation of the Second Plane of Extremity through the same Planar Templates has given birth to a Quintessential Feature linked to your Sources of Extremity.]
[The Feature of Quintessential Clones of Extremity stemming from bound Sources of Extremity has been used as the basis.]
[The Quintessential Feature of Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification has been born.]
Immaculate multicolored splendor was released from his Origin as his Sources of Extremity began running wild.
The reason was a simple one!

[Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification]:: A feature that allows your Origin to manifest and summon their bound Sources outwardly in the forms of autonomous Reified Sources of Extremity. These manifestations can move according to your will as they will represent their Source of Extremity to the fullest, their Damage and Defense Values varying from your main body depending on the Source of Extremity they represent as the Values may be Quintessentially greater or lesser. Since they are isolated forms of Extremity, their focus is on locating and ascending their own Source towards Extremity- with all prior abilities of Quintessential Clones of Extremity retained by the Reified Sources of Extremity. When adding the essence of the Unnamed Energy of Extremity to their composition, they can absorb and assimilate the conceptuality of other Boundaries they come across into themselves to get ever closer to Extremity...]

[...The forms that the Reified Sources of Extremity take are determined during their conception and heavily influenced by the nature of the Boundary they represent. Once a sufficient number of Reified Sources of Extremity have been called out, the name of the feature will change from Unrecorded to Recorded Aeonic Extremity Reification. Summoning the Reified Sources of Extremity comes at no cost to you, and upon facing True Death, they will only be recalled into your Origin and hibernate for a day before they can be manifested again. Current number of Reified Sources of Extremity that can be summoned- 9. As your Origin continues to grow, more slots will be accessible as manifesting the Reified Sources of Extremity of your Boundaries simultaneously is a possibility...]

His Shield was surrounded by the metallic blue luster of the Unknown Dynamis of Extremity, and yet this being opposed it without losing to it due to a dense layering of essence that covered his hand!

Essence that contained over a dozen Boundaries weaved together in a fantastical way as they bore fruit to something even greater- whatever this something was being the factor that actually allowed this being to clash with Noah.

What did Phos from an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity have that Titus from a lesser Inheritance didn't have?

"There are anomalies and Mutated Entities out there who believe themselves to be the best."
WAA!

And the strength of groups of Unequaled Reverend Emperors from Inheritances across the Aeonic Havens...was utterly dreadful!
"Since the grandeur of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity does not seem to be known in this Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, let us use you as an example to instill it while reminding all others.

chapters.title: Chapter 2376 Reified Sources Of Extremity! I
paragraphs: Reified Sources of Extremity!
The workings of the Quintessential Clones of Extremity were incorporated into this feature as through it, Noah could call out manifestations of the very Boundaries that made them.
But just how different were these manifestations compared to the Quintessential Clones of Extremity?
There was a great deal to learn about them, but Noah already noticed three things from the description.

They could quite literally absorb the essence of other Boundaries to raise their own progression towards Extremity, it was of no cost to him, and that even upon facing True Death...they would only be recalled into his Origin to Hibernate as they wouldn't truly die!
These three factors alone were dreadful enough, but Noah felt like there should still be more.
Providence told him so!
So as his main body began constructing his Second Plane of Extremity and created an even grander foundation, his Will moved to test out exactly what this newly risen feature held in store.
After all, it should have even grander things in store than what was simply stated in the description!
Stellar crimson and silver obelisks floated grandly in space.

The auras of powerful beings were raging in abundance as far from the obelisks they were clustered atop of, massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution watched on coldly as even at this moment- they didn't make a move!

These massive titans were hundreds and thousands of times larger than the Reverend Emperors here who were restricted to an average of 2 meters, seeming like entire islands or world sized Beasts to them as some Reverend Emperors felt their destinies ring out warning bells.
But the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution never made a move so far.
It was as if they were waiting for something.
Something that had yet to occur!
The space that was most active in this region had a few hundred Unequaled Reverend Emperors surrounding one Entity who gazed at all of them fearlessly.
The cold expression on Phos of the Extremity of Light was even more pronounced along with those from the Aeonic Haven of Helios who chose not to take Noah's words lying down.
He looked at all of them and their massive numbers as towards Phos's words of him being outnumbered no matter his strength...he smiled as he looked around him.
"And who said I was alone?"
His words caused the cautious Reverend Emperors to look around, only to see no beings coming to aid Noah as their eyes became even sharper!
Ayame was off to the side as she pondered while looking at the show with interest, but even she didn't make a move.
Before any moment could pass, a dark light flashed from Noah's body.
Dazzling waves of authority erupted out as he spoke grandly.
[Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification]
WAA!
A feature was activated. No resources were paid as his Origin spun with utmost glory!
And he then spoke out which concept of his was to be proclaimed and reified.
[Entropy]
[Manadynamics]
[Nullity]
[Ruin]
[Dream]
[Apollyon]
[Loot]I think you should take a look at
[Blood]
8 concepts were called out one after another as blaring auras of dreadful might bloomed like singularities around Noah!
And from the Initial magnitude of the singularities alone...they seemed to exceed the limitation of mere two meters that the terrifying authority of Dissolution was imposing on all beings here!
And after calling out 8 names, Noah spoke the last one with most regality.
[Quintessence]
WAA!
Blindingly oppressive waves of power erupted that caused the Reverends nearby to back off as the scene gradually became clear.
The first one to appear released dreadful obsidian waves of essence as a prompt rose!
[The Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus, has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
Stellar tendrils of black light surrounded the apparition.

Rivers of Entropic reality could be seen coming together to form the musculature and backbone of a beast reminiscent of a Singularity Traversing Quantum Warhorse, it's body forged from rivers of entropic Realities as atop it...the visage of a devilishly handsome man held its reigns.

His face seemed like an aged version of Noah as he was donned in a crystalline black armor, strands of dark hair falling past his shoulders as the pupils within his eyes...they constantly rotated with clusters of tens of singularities!
His gaze was cold and dreadful as when he appeared, Noah finally understood more of the features of the Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification.
[The Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus, has been born from the Source of Entropy as he can exhibit 3x your main body's Aeonic Soul Damage Values and only half of your Aeonic Soul Defense Values]
[Bellicus shall only draw upon Entropy for all of his resources as he seeks to unleash extreme chaos.]
Yes.
The other crucial aspect that was written in the description of the feature of The Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification, but not clearly understood.
No cost to Noah.
No cost in calling them forth, and no cost in his Aeonic Soul Values or Resources as the Reified Sources of Extremity drew upon their own independent reserves from the concept that made them!

They could be utilized on the battlefield and be sustained without Noah having to even lift a finger! Not to mention...the Damage Values of the dazzling Harbinger of Entropy were deemed to be 3x as high as Noah's.
And the more amazing thing...was the magnitude of Bellicus.

This older version of Noah was over 200 Meters in magnitude as he was more than 100 times larger compared to Noah's own True Sanguine Clone and other Reverends here- the authority of Dissolution that was imposed on all beings here not falling upon it!
And why was this?
Unlike the existences here, the Harbinger of Entropy was not a lifeform.
He was a concept.
He was a Source of Extremity!
[OOOOOH!]
Seated upon a Singularity Traversing Quantum Warhorse, Bellicus bellowed out with utmost fervor as an instant later...
[The Recorded Apocalypse- Aeonic Plane Cataclysm, has been called forth.]
[The Unrecorded Apocalypse- Entropy's Feast, has been called out.]
The terrain began to change a moment after his appearance.
And he...was just one of 9!

chapters.title: Chapter 2377 Reified Sources Of Extremity! II
paragraphs: [You have obtained the Title of The Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus]
Amidst the appearance of a massive being similar to him in appearance, more and more prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes as this Source of Extremity was merely among the first that he had called out.
After the blazing eruption of apocalypses that Bellicus ushered forth, those summoned thereafter manifested one after another.
[The Arcane Haven Source Engine has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]

[The Arcane Haven Source Engine has been born from the Source of Manadynamics as it can exhibit 3x your main body's Aeonic Soul Damage Values and 3x your Aeonic Soul Defense Values, with all resource requirements for its abilities reduced by 95%]
[All other Reified Sources of Extremity will be supported in resource usage so long as the Arcane Haven Source Engine is active.]

From Manadynamics, a terrifying Engine came out as a circular construct of pure blue light manifested, countless runic lines interweaving around it as this...was a Source Engine that could run a type of Haven!
Tendrils of pure blue light weaved on its cerulean surface as it seemed like a burning blue sun that blinded all eyes.
HOONG!
Waves of shockingly pure essence emanated out as in the surroundings, a storm of cerulean grandeur blooming out.
Arcane.
Similar to the Arcane Mana Entity form Noah could take, the Source of Manadynamics that was manifested held the grandeur of such abilities and more that even Noah had yet to unfold!
And this was only the second Reified Source of Extremity!
A booming sound as if the skies were cracking apart echoed out in the next second as two piercing roars burst the eardrums of weak nearby Reverends.
[The Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[The Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin has been born from the Source of Ruin as it can exhibit 4x your main body's Aeonic Soul Damage Values and 25% of your Aeonic Soul Defense Values.]
[The Nullified Phoenix of Cataclysm has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[The Nullified Phoenix of Cataclysm has been born from the Source of Nullity as it can exhibit 4x your main body's Aeonic Soul Damage Values and 25% of your Aeonic Soul Defense Values.]
The Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin and The Nullified Phoenix of Cataclysm!

Massive Beasts similar to the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution from afar manifested as a billowing crimson dragon with wings made of pure Ruin roared out, its crystalline crimson scales radiating a pure aura of Extremity as above its draconian head, a stellar crimson crown of Ruin rotated with power!

Beside it, a silver feathered Phoenix of pristine beauty roared out, silver flames raging around it as a burning crown rotated above it- torrential flames of nullity very soon also engulfing everything around it.

This Reified Source of Extremity and those preceding it all gave off immense waves of power that seemed to approach the massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution situated from afar- their very makeup being utterly different from others as they weren't even on the same stage of life as the Reverend Emperors.
And appearing besides these current Reified Sources of Extremity...
[The Dreamer of Extremity has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[The Aeonic Demon Emperor of Destruction has been Recorded...]
[The Aeonic Cache Bringer has been Recorded...]
[The Vampyre of Extreme Sanguinity has been Recorded...]
One Reified Source of Extremity after another unfolded to reveal shocking forms as there was one last Singularity that bloomed to eclipse every single one of them.
It was the last name to be called.
It was the last Reified Source of Extremity to manifest, and yet it stood at the forefront of the other 8 that all lined up beside it.I think you should take a look at
[The Quintessential Emperor of Extremity has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
BZZZT!
[You have called out the Source of an Unprecedented Lifeform!]
From a distance away, Ayame's expression became grim as she looked towards the manifested constructs of Extremity, but none more than the last one.
None more than the humanoid visage of stellar appearance before them!

Phos and other Unequaled Reverend Emperors also felt a heavy feeling of oppression that they could only feel emanating from the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution from afar- the 8 prior manifestations only expressing an aura close to it as this one...it felt genuine!
Humanoid in appearance.
Skin shining with the luster of Cosmos and reality as he seemed celestial in nature, his whole body radiating purple blue stellar waves of light.
A sculpted musculature with a head emanating devilish handsomeness that only displayed two bright eyes. Eyes that within their pupils, lemniscate symbols rotated with extreme power and wonder!
Behind him, an aurora of wings of multicolored stellar light radiated glory and power.
He seemed like a life form who only came to be through countless possibilities, his aura alone dwarfing everything as his face was Noah's face...only more Quintessential!
The Reified Source of Quintessence was simply Noah in a more dazzling form.
And the moment the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared, he stared at all the Reverend Emperors around him coldly as their bodies unconsciously buzzed with defensive layers.
But he didn't make a move.
He actually turned around from them and stared at the far distance.
Towards the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
Towards the massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution!
He gazed towards this direction as he was the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity.
To make his name true as it was, his search for Extremity was something other Sources couldn't even compare to!
And towards the distance, he sensed tools to take him ever closer towards Extremity.
Noah's will and Soul were fully infused into this manifested concept as he understood everything with utter clarity.
So...
The hand of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity rose as he instantly took control, ready to command the other Reified Sources of Extremity!
The True Sanguine Clone that was holding an Aegis and Xyston who had called him out actually took a backseat.
Noah's soul fully resonated with the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity as a dreadfully magnetic voice emanated from him.
[I was never alone.]

One Reified Source of Extremity after another unfolded to reveal shocking forms as there was one last Singularity that bloomed to eclipse every single one of them.
It was the last name to be called.
It was the last Reified Source of Extremity to manifest, and yet it stood at the forefront of the other 8 that all lined up beside it.I think you should take a look at
[The Quintessential Emperor of Extremity has been Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
BZZZT!
[You have called out the Source of an Unprecedented Lifeform!]
From a distance away, Ayame's expression became grim as she looked towards the manifested constructs of Extremity, but none more than the last one.
None more than the humanoid visage of stellar appearance before them!

Phos and other Unequaled Reverend Emperors also felt a heavy feeling of oppression that they could only feel emanating from the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution from afar- the 8 prior manifestations only expressing an aura close to it as this one...it felt genuine!
Humanoid in appearance.
Skin shining with the luster of Cosmos and reality as he seemed celestial in nature, his whole body radiating purple blue stellar waves of light.
A sculpted musculature with a head emanating devilish handsomeness that only displayed two bright eyes.
Eyes that within their pupils, lemniscate symbols rotated with extreme power and wonder!
Behind him, an aurora of wings of multicolored stellar light radiated glory and power.
He seemed like a life form who only came to be through countless possibilities, his aura alone dwarfing everything as his face was Noah's face...only more Quintessential!
The Reified Source of Quintessence was simply Noah in a more dazzling form.
And the moment the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared, he stared at all the Reverend Emperors around him coldly as their bodies unconsciously buzzed with defensive layers.
But he didn't make a move.
He actually turned around from them and stared at the far distance.
Towards the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
Towards the massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution!
He gazed towards this direction as he was the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity.
To make his name true as it was, his search for Extremity was something other Sources couldn't even compare to!
And towards the distance, he sensed tools to take him ever closer towards Extremity.
Noah's will and Soul were fully infused into this manifested concept as he understood everything with utter clarity.
So...
The hand of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity rose as he instantly took control, ready to command the other Reified Sources of Extremity!
The True Sanguine Clone that was holding an Aegis and Xyston who had called him out actually took a backseat.
Noah's soul fully resonated with the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity as a dreadfully magnetic voice emanated from him.
[I was never alone.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2378 The First Radiance I
paragraphs: He shone gloriously with stellar purple blue luster as his very skin looked cosmic, his sculpted humanoid form laying itself bare as he seemed like an amalgamation of countless singularities and Realities!

His pupils shone with radiant blue spinning Infinity symbols that seemed to draw in the surrounding essence, the aurora of multicolored wings behind his back radiating pure light while he simply floated there.

He only had the terrifying eyes of spinning Infinity symbol singularities on his face and no mouth or nose, yet his voice still reverberated outwards as it caused the gazes of the Unequaled Reverend Emperors from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity to turn sharp!
[I was never alone.]
He never was alone.
He had a myriad of versions of himself he could call upon as the moment that the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity was called out, he took center stage!

The True Sanguine Clone that had called out the feature of the Unrecorded Aeonic Extremity Reification seemed dim in comparison as his leading position instantly disappeared, Noah's reified Source of Quintessence taking the lead as what exactly was its power?
The others already had fantastic variations in their Damage and Defense Values along with unique capabilities to their nature, but Quintessence...
[The Quintessential Emperor of Extremity has been born from the Source of Quintessence as it can exhibit 9x your main body's Aeonic Soul Damage Values and 9x of your Aeonic Soul Defense Values.]
[The Quintessential Emperor of Extremity can commandeer the unique aspects of any active Reified Sources of Extremity, copy it, and display it outwardly with the full effect.]

[The Quintessential Emperor of Extremity has the capability to initiate the fusion of all current Reified Sources of Extremity- this being the only ability that will pull upon the Aeonic Soul Values of the Main Body. To maintain this state of fusion between all active Reified Sources of Extremity, it will currently take 98% of your Aeonic Soul Values every nanosecond.]
[You have obtained the Title of the Arcane Haven Source Engine.]
[You have obtained the Title of the Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin.]
[You have obtained the Title of the Nullified Phoenix of Cataclysm.]
[You have obtained the Title of the Dreamer of Extremity...]
Utterly dreadful prompts rose up as at the same time...Noah was reminded of something.

He was reminded that even though he was rising ridiculously fast in a short period of time, his Soul was still very, very young and barely being launched upwards exponentially in power with all the different transformations he went through!
But...it was still not the strongest it could be.

And this was shown more clearly at this juncture as just the act of fusing all active Reified Sources of Extremity took 98% of all of his current reserves of Aeonic Soul Values just for a single nanosecond!
But what did this temporary fusion of the Sources of Extremity mean?
Wasn't that...exactly the path to attain Dynamis of Extremity? One that didn't just involve 2 Boundaries, but the Source of multiple!
It caused Noah's stellar heart to beat with countless possibilities as his hand rose up.I think you should take a look at
OOOOH!

The moment it did, the 8 other Reified Sources of Extremity buzzed with mad waves of power towards the Unequaled Reverend Emperors encircling them, their size being a hundred times larger or even more compared to the restricted 2 meter average from the Authority of Dissolution as they were a force to be reckoned with!
As for the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity himself...
His aurora of wings buzzed as he began to float towards the deeper region of this domain.
Towards the Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution and the barely discernible pulsing Vein of Dissolution in the far distance!
Such a development caused the eyes of many observing existences to react differently.

Seeing the massive statures of creatures called out from the mysterious being holding a shield and spear and the feeling that these beings gave off was enough to allow some beings to form their ideas and opinions relatively quickly!
It was enough to cause many to turn serious, but there was a significant number of beings that still looked at this with curious smiles.
Such beings were those with Mutated Aspects of Existence as they held terrifying confidence and power, or they were simply stemming from utterly dreadful Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity.
Then...there was one particular existence situated on a far floating silver obelisk on the left side.
Other forces that had appeared on the same obelisk as him all moved away when they noticed him, this including those from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity as he was a being known across the Havens!
An existence that placed among the positions of the top 10 in the last few Centennial Exchanges of Extremity.
Even though there were a great number of distinctive beings who didn't participate in the Centennial Exchange of Extremity over the years, those who did were still distinguished.

And he was such an existence who bulldozed many Unequaled Reverends of Extremity as even though it wasn't confirmed...Inheritances had heard rumors that this being sparred with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the immeasurably deep and ancient faction he stemmed from!
He laid back on a malleable crystalline white throne as auras of powerful Unequaled Reverend Emperors surrounded his left and right.

His visage seemed towering as even though the authority of Dissolution pressed down to limit all beings to 2 meters, his figure seemed a level bigger than the rest as he was at least 4 meters in stature!

His epidermis was tan as uniquely, white slippers could be seen on his feet as he donned loose stellar white shorts and a blue beach shirt as if he was on a vacation inside a reality made up entirely of cerulean waves of seas!
"What do you think?"
His voice was commanding as he spoke to those around him with a smile.

The Unequaled Reverend Emperors to his left and right were decorated in crisp black and white suits that released ancient waves of power that seemed to be at the Apex Aeonic Relic level at the very minimum!

chapters.title: Chapter 2379 The First Radiance II
paragraphs: Among the Reverend Emperors donned in crisp suits, a particularly dazzling woman moved Apex Aeonic Relic glasses closer towards her eyes as she spoke calmly while looking towards Noah's manifestations!

"Definitely a Mutated Entity, the potency of Extremity he is currently showing is enough to rival or exceed what the Disciples of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity can bring out due to their Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi. Depending on how much more of his power he is hiding, he could possibly give you a fight...Master Erikson."
WAA!
Her eyes were astute as they captured everything, the imposing visage of the man in beach wear increasing in pressure as his smile became ever brighter.
His face was one of utmost beauty and power as dark hair wildly vibrated akin to obsidian Realities, his eyes shining with majesty as he nodded.
"Possibly, and it seems he caught onto what is to come as well..."

His magnetic voice rang out again as Master Erikson looked towards the stellar figure of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity whose gaze crossed the far reaches of space towards the region holding the mere glimpse of a pulsing Vein submerged in obsidian darkness.
On the surface of this Vein that seemed to constantly change in structure, a point of singularity suddenly bloomed from it.

A point of singularity. This was how it could best be described as it truly seemed like a budding point of Infinite mass and density- a myriad of lights erupting around it as the dense aura of Extremity could be felt!
And from the budding light...the structure of a flower bloomed.
Immense life force and an ancient air of Extremity spread out from it as at such a juncture, the massive Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution finally began to stir.

"The budding of the First Extremity Panacea...you all remember the words of The Extremity of Fate on how special the First and Last Extremity Panaceas to bloom are. It appears the quickest, and yet it's the one that is hardest to take a hold of...shall we go fight for it?"
A smile of power and majesty became ever wider on the imposing stature of Master Erikson as in his laid back attire, he moved forward!
The eyes of many others followed, but one of the first beings who had sensed what had just occurred before it did was already on his way to the very forefront.
It was the stellar being radiating a profound source of Extremity- it was the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity!

As he went towards one direction, 8 other Sources of Extremity staunchly stood before dozens of Unequaled Reverend Emperors who also gazed fervently towards the first radiance of an Extremity Panacea that was surrounded by Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution, but before they could even move towards it...
"Since you so readily wanted to be first to obtain an Extremity Panacea over all others, let me ensure that you and your Extremity of Light don't even catch their glimpse."

From the mouth of the Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus, terrifying words were addressed to none other than Phos and those behind him as these existences from an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity had their bodies visibly burn with a singular power!

The expression on Phos was a dark and cold one as he was forced to look away from the radiance of the First Extremity Panacea to focus on the 8 manifestations before him, their auras not being something he could ignore as he spoke out powerfully while his body disappeared into glimmers of light.

"For those who aid us in quickly bypassing and reigning in these enemies before us...the Extremity of Light will not forget your efforts as we will fully support your Apexification through the countless methods on our hands!"
If a blade wasn't sharp enough to quickly cut something, one could only try to make it sharper as Phos did just this in order to achieve his aims! I think you should take a look at
The spark of the Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution had just begun as already, a great number of beings were drawn towards it.
New powers expanded into the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution as the Initiation was merely that- the first step!

Many more steps followed as the Aboriginals who were most influenced by this Haven over the years held slightly more sway in its Destiny, and this was especially so for the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that underwent Apexification in this Haven.
They were linked inexplicably to Dissolution in ways that normal beings couldn't even fathom!

In time, it wouldn't just be Reverend Emperors participating for the waking Vein of Dissolution as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would get involved sooner rather than later, and due to this...the Lineages within the Haven of Dissolution were experiencing more pressure to join am Inheritance if they weren't already closely interlinked with one already.

The mysterious and powerful Planeswalkers already had a Behemoth supporting them as now, even the Ancestral Lernaeans received word through their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of contact with different Inheritances who sought to absorb them into their folds!
It was a give and take relationship as in exchange for a great deal of boons, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of their Lineage would work for the linked Inheritance in the times to come.
"And in the midst of all this...a being rises from our Descendants who wishes to destabilize the unity of Lerneans?"
A calm voice boomed out from a being who stared towards a far away Abecedarian Sacrarium.

This being was situated in a massive bone armored carriage that was being pulled by a silver feathered Chaoticus Three-Legged Crow, dozens of potent Reverend Emperors accompanying him even though he was only an Aeonic Soul Clone!
Only an Aeonic Soul Clone...but he was a distinguished being that was forced to make a move as the knowledge about the True Emperor of Quintessence spread among the Ancestral Lernaeans.
He was the Soul Clone of the Interim Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor- a being that represented the Wills of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of their Lineage!
And he came here today accompanied by the many advisors and Seers of their Lineage as they had to face a headache inducing being that rose out of nowhere.
"You're sure of your findings?"
The Interim Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor spoke out calmly towards a few aged Seers behind him who nodded with clear eyes.
"Enticements won't work on him, brute force may just result in mutual destruction...with the only possibility of gaining the Consummate Boundaries he holds lying in him getting what he wants."
An aged Seer spoke out with grim eyes as silence reigned in the surroundings.

"Haha, it really seems like you all are telling me to relinquish the seat I took not too long ago. He wants the distinction of the Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor that easily...let's go meet this True Emperor of Quintessence and see where Fate leads."

A group of the most potent and authoritative existences in the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage below their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms went towards the Abecedarian Sacrarium where the Last True Emperor lay in wait!
